function detectState(input) {
    if (!input || typeof input !== 'string') return "neutral";
    const msg = input.toLowerCase();
    if (msg.includes("overwhelmed")) return "overwhelmed";
    if (msg.includes("tired")) return "low";
    if (msg.includes("ready")) return "focused";
    return "neutral";
}

function applyAlignment(response, state) {
    const user = getUserModel();
    let final = response;
    
    if (user?.tone === "calm") final = "Take it slowly. " + final;
    if (user?.tone === "direct") final = "Focus. " + final;
    if (state === "overwhelmed") final = "It’s okay. " + final;
    if (state === "low") final = "Start small. " + final;
    
    if (final.length > 120) {
        final = final.slice(0, 120) + "...";
    }
    
    return final;
}

module.exports = {
    detectState,
    applyAlignment
};

    FOUNDER: 'founder',
    PRODUCT: 'product'
});

function getChronoLayer() {
    const configured = (process.env.CHRONO_LAYER || '').toLowerCase();
    if (configured === LAYERS.PRODUCT) return LAYERS.PRODUCT;
    return LAYERS.FOUNDER;
}

function isFounderLayer() {
    return getChronoLayer() === LAYERS.FOUNDER;
}

function requireFounderLayer(featureName) {
    if (!isFounderLayer()) {
        return {
            unavailable: true,
            feature: featureName,
            reason: 'This is an Original Chrono founder-layer feature and is disabled in Public Chrono.'
        };
    }
    return null;
}

module.exports = {
    LAYERS,
    getChronoLayer,
    isFounderLayer,
    requireFounderLayer
};

 * 📅 CALENDAR INTELLIGENCE ENGINE
 * Handles algorithmic spaced study block scheduling and calendar constraint validation.
 */

function generateSpacedStudyBlocks(subject, examDateStr) {
    const examDate = new Date(examDateStr);
    const studyProposals = [];

    // Helper to format date
    const formatDate = (d) => d.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // Add main Exam task
    studyProposals.push({
        type: 'add',
        text: `Exam: ${subject}`,
        date: examDateStr,
        calendar: 'personal',
        start_time: '09:00',
        duration_min: 120
    });

    // 1. Spaced Block A: 4 Days Before (Core Comprehension Focus - 120 mins)
    const dateA = new Date(examDate);
    dateA.setDate(dateA.getDate() - 4);
    studyProposals.push({
        type: 'add',
        text: `Study Core: ${subject}`,
        date: formatDate(dateA),
        calendar: 'study',
        start_time: '15:00',
        duration_min: 120
    });

    // 2. Spaced Block B: 2 Days Before (Active Recall / Practice - 90 mins)
    const dateB = new Date(examDate);
    dateB.setDate(dateB.getDate() - 2);
    studyProposals.push({
        type: 'add',
        text: `Active Practice: ${subject}`,
        date: formatDate(dateB),
        calendar: 'study',
        start_time: '16:00',
        duration_min: 90
    });

    // 3. Spaced Block C: 1 Day Before (Final Review / Micro revision - 60 mins)
    const dateC = new Date(examDate);
    dateC.setDate(dateC.getDate() - 1);
    studyProposals.push({
        type: 'add',
        text: `Final Review: ${subject}`,
        date: formatDate(dateC),
        calendar: 'study',
        start_time: '16:00',
        duration_min: 60
    });

    // 4. Protected Rest Block on Exam Day Afternoon
    studyProposals.push({
        type: 'add',
        text: `Post-Exam Rest & Recharge`,
        date: examDateStr,
        calendar: 'focus',
        start_time: '14:00',
        duration_min: 90
    });

    return studyProposals;
}

module.exports = {
    generateSpacedStudyBlocks
};

const path = require('path');

// Load environment variables from root directory .env
require('dotenv').config({ path: path.join(__dirname, '../.env') });

const supabaseUrl = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

let supabase = null;

try {
    if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
        throw new Error('Supabase cloud settings are not configured.');
    }
    supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
        auth: {
            persistSession: false,
            autoRefreshToken: true
        }
    });
    console.log("⚡ Supabase Cloud Client initialized successfully.");
} catch (e) {
    console.error("⚠️ Failed to initialize Supabase Client:", e.message);
}

let currentClient = supabase;

const proxy = new Proxy({}, {
    get(target, prop) {
        if (prop === '_switchToSandbox') {
            return (mockClient) => {
                currentClient = mockClient;
            };
        }
        if (prop === '_isSandboxMock') {
            return (currentClient && currentClient._isSandboxMock) || false;
        }
        return currentClient ? currentClient[prop] : null;
    },
    set(target, prop, value) {
        if (currentClient) {
            currentClient[prop] = value;
        }
        return true;
    }
});

module.exports = proxy;

const observatory = require('./observatory');

/**
 * Direct-to-Supabase Sync Service running in the Electron Main process (Chrono 2.0).
 */
async function pull({ lastSyncTime, deviceId, userId }) {
    if (!cloudDb) {
        throw new Error("Supabase cloud database is not configured.");
    }

    const startTime = Date.now();

    const lastSync = lastSyncTime || 0;
    const devId = deviceId || '';

    // 1. Pull events (relying on RLS to filter by user memberships)
    const { data: events, error: eventError } = await cloudDb
        .from('events')
        .select('*')
        .gt('updated_at', lastSync);

    if (eventError) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to pull events: ${eventError.message}`);
    }

    // Filter events by device_id in JS
    const filteredEvents = (events || []).filter(e => e.device_id !== devId);

    const mappedEvents = filteredEvents.map(e => ({
        id: e.id,
        calendar: e.calendar_id,
        text: e.text,
        date: e.date,
        completed: e.completed,
        start_time: e.start_time,
        duration_min: e.duration_min,
        updated_at: Number(e.updated_at),
        device_id: e.device_id,
        deleted: e.deleted
    }));

    // 2. Pull calendars
    const { data: calendars, error: calError } = await cloudDb
        .from('calendars')
        .select('*')
        .gt('updated_at', lastSync);

    if (calError) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to pull calendars: ${calError.message}`);
    }

    const filteredCalendars = (calendars || []).filter(c => c.device_id !== devId);

    const mappedCalendars = filteredCalendars.map(c => ({
        id: c.id,
        name: c.name,
        owner_id: c.owner_id,
        layer_type: c.layer_type,
        updated_at: Number(c.updated_at),
        device_id: c.device_id,
        deleted: c.deleted
    }));

    // 3. Pull calendar members
    const { data: members, error: memError } = await cloudDb
        .from('calendar_members')
        .select('*')
        .gt('updated_at', lastSync);

    if (memError) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to pull calendar members: ${memError.message}`);
    }

    const filteredMembers = (members || []).filter(m => m.device_id !== devId);

    const mappedMembers = filteredMembers.map(m => ({
        calendar_id: m.calendar_id,
        user_id: m.user_id,
        role: m.role,
        updated_at: Number(m.updated_at),
        device_id: m.device_id,
        deleted: m.deleted
    }));

    // 4. Pull chat history
    const lastSyncIso = new Date(lastSync).toISOString();
    const { data: chats, error: chatError } = await cloudDb
        .from('chat_history')
        .select('*')
        .gt('created_at', lastSyncIso);

    if (chatError) {
        console.error(`Failed to pull chat history: ${chatError.message}`);
    }

    const mappedChats = (chats || []).map(ch => ({
        id: ch.id,
        user_input: ch.user_input,
        ai_response: ch.ai_response,
        timestamp: new Date(ch.created_at).getTime(),
        updated_at: new Date(ch.created_at).getTime(),
        device_id: 'server',
        synced: 1
    }));

    // 5. Pull cognitive memories
    const { data: memories, error: cogMemError } = await cloudDb
        .from('cognitive_memories')
        .select('*')
        .gt('created_at', lastSyncIso);

    if (cogMemError) {
        console.error(`Failed to pull cognitive memories: ${cogMemError.message}`);
    }

    const mappedMemories = (memories || []).map(m => ({
        id: m.id,
        user_id: m.user_id,
        memory_type: m.memory_type,
        content: m.content,
        importance_score: m.importance_score,
        created_at: new Date(m.created_at).getTime(),
        updated_at: new Date(m.created_at).getTime(),
        device_id: 'server',
        synced: 1,
        deleted: 0
    }));

    const latency = Date.now() - startTime;
    observatory.recordSyncPull(latency);

    return {
        serverTime: Date.now(),
        events: mappedEvents,
        calendars: mappedCalendars,
        calendar_members: mappedMembers,
        chats: mappedChats,
        cognitive_memories: mappedMemories
    };
}

async function push({ deviceId, userId, events, calendars, calendar_members, chats, cognitive_memories }) {
    if (!cloudDb) {
        throw new Error("Supabase cloud database is not configured.");
    }

    const startTime = Date.now();

    // 1. Reconcile calendars
    if (calendars && calendars.length > 0) {
        for (const cal of calendars) {
            const { data: existing, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('calendars')
                .select('id, updated_at')
                .eq('id', cal.id)
                .maybeSingle();

            if (error) console.error(`Error querying calendar: ${error.message}`);

            if (!existing) {
                const { error: insErr } = await cloudDb
                    .from('calendars')
                    .insert({
                        id: cal.id,
                        name: cal.name,
                        owner_id: cal.owner_id || userId,
                        layer_type: cal.layer_type || 'personal',
                        updated_at: cal.updated_at,
                        device_id: cal.device_id,
                        deleted: cal.deleted ? 1 : 0
                    });
                if (insErr) console.error(`Error inserting calendar: ${insErr.message}`);
            } else {
                observatory.recordConflictResolved();
                if (cal.updated_at > (existing.updated_at || 0)) {
                    const { error: updErr } = await cloudDb
                        .from('calendars')
                        .update({
                            name: cal.name,
                            owner_id: cal.owner_id || userId,
                            layer_type: cal.layer_type || 'personal',
                            updated_at: cal.updated_at,
                            device_id: cal.device_id,
                            deleted: cal.deleted ? 1 : 0
                        })
                        .eq('id', cal.id);
                    if (updErr) console.error(`Error updating calendar: ${updErr.message}`);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Reconcile calendar members
    if (calendar_members && calendar_members.length > 0) {
        for (const mem of calendar_members) {
            const { data: existing, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('calendar_members')
                .select('updated_at')
                .eq('calendar_id', mem.calendar_id)
                .eq('user_id', mem.user_id)
                .maybeSingle();

            if (error) console.error(`Error querying member: ${error.message}`);

            if (!existing) {
                const { error: insErr } = await cloudDb
                    .from('calendar_members')
                    .insert({
                        calendar_id: mem.calendar_id,
                        user_id: mem.user_id,
                        role: mem.role || 'viewer',
                        updated_at: mem.updated_at,
                        device_id: mem.device_id,
                        deleted: mem.deleted ? 1 : 0
                    });
                if (insErr) console.error(`Error inserting member: ${insErr.message}`);
            } else {
                observatory.recordConflictResolved();
                if (mem.updated_at > (existing.updated_at || 0)) {
                    const { error: updErr } = await cloudDb
                        .from('calendar_members')
                        .update({
                            role: mem.role || 'viewer',
                            updated_at: mem.updated_at,
                            device_id: mem.device_id,
                            deleted: mem.deleted ? 1 : 0
                        })
                        .eq('calendar_id', mem.calendar_id)
                        .eq('user_id', mem.user_id);
                    if (updErr) console.error(`Error updating member: ${updErr.message}`);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 3. Reconcile events
    if (events && events.length > 0) {
        for (const ev of events) {
            const { data: existing, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('events')
                .select('id, updated_at')
                .eq('id', ev.id)
                .maybeSingle();

            if (error) console.error(`Error querying event: ${error.message}`);

            const calId = ev.calendar_id || ev.calendar;
            if (!existing) {
                const { error: insErr } = await cloudDb
                    .from('events')
                    .insert({
                        id: ev.id,
                        calendar_id: calId,
                        text: ev.text,
                        date: ev.date,
                        completed: ev.completed,
                        start_time: ev.start_time || null,
                        duration_min: ev.duration_min || 60,
                        created_by: userId,
                        updated_at: ev.updated_at,
                        device_id: ev.device_id,
                        deleted: ev.deleted ? 1 : 0
                    });
                if (insErr) console.error(`Error inserting event: ${insErr.message}`);
            } else {
                observatory.recordConflictResolved();
                if (ev.updated_at > (existing.updated_at || 0)) {
                    const { error: updErr } = await cloudDb
                        .from('events')
                        .update({
                            calendar_id: calId,
                            text: ev.text,
                            date: ev.date,
                            completed: ev.completed,
                            start_time: ev.start_time || null,
                            duration_min: ev.duration_min || 60,
                            updated_at: ev.updated_at,
                            device_id: ev.device_id,
                            deleted: ev.deleted ? 1 : 0
                        })
                        .eq('id', ev.id);
                    if (updErr) console.error(`Error updating event: ${updErr.message}`);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 4. Reconcile chat history
    if (chats && chats.length > 0) {
        for (const ch of chats) {
            const { data: existing, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('chat_history')
                .select('id')
                .eq('id', ch.id)
                .maybeSingle();

            if (error) console.error(`Error querying chat: ${error.message}`);

            if (!existing) {
                const { error: insErr } = await cloudDb
                    .from('chat_history')
                    .insert({
                        id: ch.id,
                        user_id: userId,
                        user_input: ch.user_input,
                        ai_response: ch.ai_response,
                        model_used: ch.model_used || 'chrono-coordinator-1.0',
                        latency_ms: ch.latency_ms || 0,
                        created_at: new Date(ch.timestamp).toISOString()
                    });
                if (insErr) console.error(`Error inserting chat: ${insErr.message}`);

    // 5. Reconcile cognitive memories
    if (cognitive_memories && cognitive_memories.length > 0) {
        for (const m of cognitive_memories) {

    const latency = Date.now() - startTime;

 * 🔍 COGNITIVE DIAGNOSTICS
 * 
 * Real-time aggregation of all cognitive state for debugging.
 * This is THE tool for understanding Chrono's behavior.
 * 
 * Tracks:
 * - Emotional trajectory
 * - Memory state and weights
 * - Orchestration decisions
 * - Identity consistency
 * - Loop detection status
 * - Presence state
 * - Response synthesis path
 * - Compression summary
 */

const orchestrator = require('./cognitiveOrchestrator');
const emotionalContinuity = require('./emotionalContinuity');
const identityStability = require('./identityStability');
const memory = require('./memoryEngine');
const presence = require('./presenceEngine');
const recursiveLoopProtection = require('./recursiveLoopProtection');
const contextCompression = require('./contextCompression');

// ========================================
// 📊 DIAGNOSTIC STATE
// ========================================

let diagnosticState = {
    lastUpdate: Date.now(),
    sessionStart: Date.now(),
    totalInteractions: 0,
    diagnosticHistory: [],
    maxHistory: 100,
    warnings: [],
    errors: []
};

/**
 * MAIN DIAGNOSTIC AGGREGATOR
 * Call this to get complete cognitive state snapshot
 */
function getCompleteDiagnostics() {
    diagnosticState.lastUpdate = Date.now();
    diagnosticState.totalInteractions++;

    const diagnostics = {
        // Time info
        timestamp: new Date(Date.now()).toISOString(),
        sessionDuration: Date.now() - diagnosticState.sessionStart,
        totalInteractions: diagnosticState.totalInteractions,

        // 🧠 ORCHESTRATOR STATE
        orchestrator: {
            ...orchestrator.getState(),
            state: orchestrator.getCognitiveState()
        },

        // 💔 EMOTIONAL STATE
        emotional: {
            ...emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState(),
            allEmotions: emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState().history || []
        },

        // 🛡️ IDENTITY STATE
        identity: {
            ...identityStability.getIdentityState(),
            boundaries: identityStability.getChronoIdentity().boundaries,
            lastContradictions: identityStability.getChronoIdentity().contradictions.slice(-3)
        },

        // 💾 MEMORY STATE
        memory: {
            hierarchy: summarizeMemoryHierarchy(),
            recent: memory.getRecentChats(5),
            emotionalMemories: memory.getEmotionalMemories(3),
            patterns: memory.getPatterns(),
            totalMemories: countTotalMemories()
        },

        // 👁️ PRESENCE STATE
        presence: presence.getPresenceState(),

        // 🔐 RECURSION STATE
        recursion: {
            currentDepth: recursiveLoopProtection.getRecursionDepth(),
            maxAllowed: 5,
            responseLoop: recursiveLoopProtection.detectResponseLoop(''),
            emotionalStability: calculateEmotionalStability()
        },

        // 📦 COMPRESSION STATE
        compression: contextCompression.getCompressionMetrics(),

        // ⚠️ SYSTEM HEALTH
        health: {
            warnings: diagnosticState.warnings.slice(-5),
            errors: diagnosticState.errors.slice(-5),
            overallRisk: assessSystemRisk()
        },

        // 🔍 DEBUGGING INFO
        debug: {
            cognitiveMode: getCognitiveMode(),
            nextRecommendedAction: getNextRecommendation(),
            potentialIssues: detectPotentialIssues()
        }
    };

    recordDiagnosticSnapshot(diagnostics);
    return diagnostics;
}

/**
 * Summarize memory hierarchy
 */
function summarizeMemoryHierarchy() {
    const fullState = memory.getMemoryHierarchy?.() || {};

    return {
        coreIdentity: {
            count: fullState.coreIdentity?.length || 0,
            weight: 1.0
        },
        emotional: {
            count: fullState.emotional?.length || 0,
            weight: 0.8
        },
        longTerm: {
            count: fullState.longTerm?.length || 0,
            weight: 0.6
        },
        shortTerm: {
            count: fullState.shortTerm?.length || 0,
            weight: 0.3
        },
        ephemeral: {
            count: fullState.ephemeral?.length || 0,
            weight: 0.1
        }
    };
}

/**
 * Count total memories
 */
function countTotalMemories() {
    const fullState = memory.getMemoryHierarchy?.() || {};
    return Object.values(fullState).reduce((sum, arr) => sum + (arr?.length || 0), 0);
}

/**
 * Calculate emotional stability
 */
function calculateEmotionalStability() {
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    return {
        stability: emotionalState.stability,
        intensity: emotionalState.intensity,
        trend: emotionalState.emotional?.trend || 'stable'
    };
}

/**
 * Assess overall system risk
 */
function assessSystemRisk() {
    let riskScore = 0;
    const issues = [];

    // Check emotional stability
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    if (emotionalState.stability < 0.6) {
        riskScore += 2;
        issues.push('Low emotional stability');
    }

    // Check consistency
    const identityState = identityStability.getIdentityState();
    if (identityState.consistency < 0.7) {
        riskScore += 2;
        issues.push('Identity consistency below threshold');
    }

    // Check recursion depth
    const depth = recursiveLoopProtection.getRecursionDepth();
    if (depth > 3) {
        riskScore += 1;
        issues.push(`High recursion depth (${depth}/5)`);
    }

    // Check memory size
    const totalMemories = countTotalMemories();
    if (totalMemories > 1000) {
        riskScore += 1;
        issues.push('Memory size exceeding optimal range');
    }

    const riskLevel = riskScore <= 1 ? 'low' : riskScore <= 3 ? 'medium' : 'high';

    return {
        score: riskScore,
        level: riskLevel,
        issues
    };
}

/**
 * Determine cognitive mode
 */
function getCognitiveMode() {
    const orchestratorState = orchestrator.getState();
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    const presenceState = presence.getPresenceState();

    if (!presenceState.active) {
        return 'idle';
    }

    if (orchestratorState.focus === 'focused') {
        return 'deep_focus';
    }

    if (emotionalState.intensity > 0.7) {
        return 'emotional_heightened';
    }

    if (orchestratorState.continuity > 20) {
        return 'engaged_session';
    }

    return 'receptive';
}

/**
 * Get next recommended action based on state
 */
function getNextRecommendation() {
    const systemRisk = assessSystemRisk();

    if (systemRisk.level === 'high') {
        return 'WARNING: Consider system reset or user break';
    }

    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    if (emotionalState.intensity > 0.85) {
        return 'De-escalate emotional intensity with grounding response';
    }

    const totalMemories = countTotalMemories();
    if (totalMemories > 500) {
        return 'Consider memory compression and pruning';
    }

    return 'System operating normally';
}

/**
 * Detect potential issues before they become problems
 */
function detectPotentialIssues() {
    const issues = [];

    // Check for emotional drift
    const emotionalHistory = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState().history || [];
    if (emotionalHistory.length > 3) {
        const recentEmotions = emotionalHistory.slice(-5);
        const uniqueEmotions = new Set(recentEmotions.map(e => e.from || e.current));
        if (uniqueEmotions.size > 3) {
            issues.push({
                severity: 'medium',
                issue: 'Rapid emotional transitions detected',
                recommendation: 'May indicate instability - monitor closely'
            });
        }
    }

    // Check for memory loop patterns
    const recentMemories = memory.getRecentChats(10);
    const topics = recentMemories.map(m => m.userInput?.slice(0, 20) || '');
    const uniqueTopics = new Set(topics);
    if (topics.length > 8 && uniqueTopics.size < 3) {
        issues.push({
            severity: 'medium',
            issue: 'Repetitive topic pattern detected',
            recommendation: 'Consider introducing new conversational direction'
        });
    }

    // Check for identity drift
    const identityState = identityStability.getIdentityState();
    if (identityState.recentContradictions > 2) {
        issues.push({
            severity: 'high',
            issue: 'Recent contradictions in identity',
            recommendation: 'Run identity enforcement and check response consistency'
        });
    }

    // Check for abandoned themes
    const abandonedTheme = emotionalContinuity.getAbandonedTheme?.();
    if (abandonedTheme && Date.now() - abandonedTheme.timestamp > 300000) {
        issues.push({
            severity: 'low',

            recommendation: 'Consider circle back to earlier conversation'
        });
    }

}

/**

 */
function recordDiagnosticSnapshot(diagnostics) {

        mode: diagnostics.debug.cognitiveMode,

        emotionalIntensity: diagnostics.emotional.intensity,

    });

    }
}

function addWarning(warning) {

    }
}

 */
function addError(error) {

    });

    if (diagnosticState.errors.length > 10) {
        diagnosticState.errors.shift();
    }
}

/**

 */
function getDiagnosticHistory(limit = 50) {

}

/**

 */
function getQuickSummary() {

    };

/**
 * Detect emotional context from user input
 */
function detectEmotionalContext(input) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();

    const emotionalSignals = {
        overwhelmed: ['overwhelmed', 'stressed', 'anxious', 'panic', 'help'],
        frustrated: ['frustrated', 'angry', 'annoyed', 'tired of', 'ugh'],
        tired: ['tired', 'exhausted', 'burned out', 'need break', 'sleep'],
        energetic: ['excited', 'ready', 'let\'s go', 'motivated', 'pumped'],
        sad: ['sad', 'down', 'depressed', 'lonely', 'alone'],
        confused: ['confused', 'don\'t understand', 'lost', 'unclear']
    };

    for (const [emotion, keywords] of Object.entries(emotionalSignals)) {
        if (keywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
            return emotion;
        }
    }

    return 'neutral';
}

/**
 * Update emotional state with continuity
 */
function updateEmotionalState(newEmotion, intensity) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const previousEmotion = cognitiveState.emotional.current;

    // Store emotional memory
    cognitiveState.emotional.memory.push({
        emotion: previousEmotion,
        intensity: cognitiveState.emotional.intensity,
        timestamp: now
    });

    // Keep bounded
    if (cognitiveState.emotional.memory.length > 20) {
        cognitiveState.emotional.memory.shift();
    }

    // Determine transition
    if (previousEmotion === newEmotion) {
        cognitiveState.emotional.trend = 'stable';
        cognitiveState.emotional.intensity = Math.min(1, cognitiveState.emotional.intensity + 0.1);
    } else {
        cognitiveState.emotional.trend = 'shifting';
        cognitiveState.emotional.intensity = intensity;
        cognitiveState.emotional.lastShift = now;
    }

    cognitiveState.emotional.current = newEmotion;
}

/**
 * Check for behavioral inconsistencies
 * Prevent Chrono from contradicting itself
 */
function checkConsistency(proposedResponse) {
    const lastResponses = cognitiveState.continuity.lastResponses.slice(-5);

    // Simple contradiction detection
    const contradictions = {
        'i\'m always here': ['i\'m busy', 'i\'m away'],
        'focused': ['scattered', 'distracted'],
        'you\'re doing great': ['you\'re failing'],
        'stay calm': ['panic', 'rush']
    };

    for (const [statement, contradicts] of Object.entries(contradictions)) {
        const hasStatement = lastResponses.some(r => r.includes(statement));
        const hasContradiction = contradicts.some(c => proposedResponse.toLowerCase().includes(c));

        if (hasStatement && hasContradiction) {
            cognitiveState.continuity.inconsistencyScore += 0.3;
            return {
                consistent: false,
                reason: 'contradiction_detected'
            };
        }
    }

    cognitiveState.continuity.inconsistencyScore = Math.max(0, cognitiveState.continuity.inconsistencyScore - 0.1);

    return { consistent: true };
}

/**

    }, 5000);

    return recovery[Math.floor(Math.random() * recovery.length)];
}

// ========================================
// 📊 STATE INSPECTION & DEBUG
// ========================================

function getState() {
    return {
        emotion: cognitiveState.emotional.current,
        focus: cognitiveState.attention.focus,
        priority: cognitiveState.attention.priority,
        interactions: cognitiveState.continuity.interactionCount,
        consistency: (1 - cognitiveState.continuity.inconsistencyScore).toFixed(2),
        recoveryMode: cognitiveState.continuity.recoveryMode,
        emotionalTrend: cognitiveState.emotional.trend,
        emotionalIntensity: cognitiveState.emotional.intensity.toFixed(2)
    };
}

function resetState() {
    cognitiveState.continuity.interactionCount = 0;
    cognitiveState.attention.contextWindow = [];
    cognitiveState.emotional.memory = [];
    cognitiveState.continuity.lastResponses = [];
}

// ========================================
// 📤 EXPORTS
// ========================================

module.exports = {
    generateOrchestratedResponse,
    updateCognitiveState,
    updateEmotionalState,
    getState,
    resetState,
    checkConsistency,
    getCognitiveState: () => cognitiveState,
    arbitrateProposals,
    applyIntentProposals,
    undoCognitiveAction
};

// ========================================
// ⚖️ PROPOSAL CONFLICT RESOLVER
// ========================================

function arbitrateProposals(intentResult, slippedResult, today, goalProposal) {
    const todayStr = today || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // 1. Stress Overwhelm Arbiter: takes highest priority
    if (intentResult && intentResult.hasProposal && intentResult.proposal.type === 'overwhelm_restructure') {
        console.log("⚖️ Conflict Resolver: Overwhelm proposal detected. Suppressing all other proposals to protect focus.");
        return intentResult.proposal;
    }

    // 2. Goal-based prioritization takes priority over normal study planning and task slippage
    if (goalProposal) {
        console.log("⚖️ Conflict Resolver: Goal-prioritized action recommendation selected.");
        return goalProposal;
    }

    // 3. Combine and resolve spaced study vs slipped tasks
    if (intentResult && intentResult.hasProposal) {
        if (slippedResult && slippedResult.hasSlipped) {
            console.log("⚖️ Conflict Resolver: Study planning colliding with slipped tasks.");
            const studyActions = intentResult.proposal.actions;
            const slippedActions = slippedResult.proposal.actions;
            
            // Calculate total workload duration
            const studyDuration = studyActions.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (a.duration_min || 0), 0);
            const slippedDuration = slippedActions.length * 60; // 60 mins each assumed
            
            const studyBullets = intentResult.proposal.reasoning_bullets || [];
            const slippedBullets = slippedResult.proposal.reasoning_bullets || [];
            
            if (studyDuration + slippedDuration > 240) { // Over 4 hours focus
                console.log("⚖️ Conflict Resolver: Workload bounds exceeded. Deferring slipped tasks to tomorrow.");
                const tomorrow = new Date(new Date(todayStr).getTime() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
                const adjustedSlippedActions = slippedActions.map(a => ({
                    ...a,
                    newDate: tomorrow
                }));
                
                return {
                    type: 'coordinated_planning',
                    confidence: 0.90,
                    reason: 'Coordinating high study workload by deferring overdue items to tomorrow.',
                    explanation: `${intentResult.proposal.explanation} I also noticed some overdue items, but to protect your focus, I propose postponing those overdue tasks until tomorrow.`,
                    reasoning_bullets: [
                        ...studyBullets,
                        "Today's total workload exceeds 4 hours, deferring slipped tasks to tomorrow to avoid burnout"
                    ],
                    actions: [...studyActions, ...adjustedSlippedActions]
                };
            } else {
                return {
                    type: 'coordinated_planning',
                    confidence: 0.88,
                    reason: 'Merging study planning and slipped task rescheduling within safe focus bounds.',
                    explanation: `${intentResult.proposal.explanation} Let's also bring forward yesterday's overdue tasks to today's queue since your schedule has space.`,
                    reasoning_bullets: [
                        ...studyBullets,
                        ...slippedBullets,
                        "Focus load is within safe limits (under 4 hours), merging tasks"
                    ],
                    actions: [...studyActions, ...slippedActions]
                };
            }
        }
        return intentResult.proposal;
    }

    if (slippedResult && slippedResult.hasSlipped) {
        return slippedResult.proposal;
    }

    return null;
}

function applyIntentProposals(actions) {
    const rawDb = mainDb.db;
    const deviceId = mainDb.getDeviceId();
    const now = Date.now();
    const actionGroupId = 'act_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);

    const undoData = [];

    rawDb.transaction((actionList) => {
        for (const action of actionList) {
            if (action.type === 'move') {
                const currentTask = rawDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(action.taskId);
                if (currentTask) {
                    undoData.push({
                        type: 'move',
                        taskId: action.taskId,
                        originalDate: currentTask.date,
                        originalStartTime: currentTask.start_time
                    });
                }
                
                const updateStmt = rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET date = ?, start_time = COALESCE(?, start_time), updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `);
                updateStmt.run(action.newDate, action.newStartTime || null, now, deviceId, action.taskId);
            } else if (action.type === 'shrink') {
                const currentTask = rawDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(action.taskId);
                if (currentTask) {
                    undoData.push({
                        type: 'shrink',
                        taskId: action.taskId,
                        originalDuration: currentTask.duration_min
                    });
                }

                const updateStmt = rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET duration_min = ?, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `);
                updateStmt.run(action.newDuration, now, deviceId, action.taskId);
            } else if (action.type === 'delete') {
                const currentTask = rawDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(action.taskId);
                if (currentTask) {
                    undoData.push({
                        type: 'delete',
                        taskId: action.taskId
                    });
                }

                const deleteStmt = rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET deleted = 1, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `);
                deleteStmt.run(now, deviceId, action.taskId);
            } else if (action.type === 'add') {
                const newTaskId = action.id || 'e_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
                undoData.push({
                    type: 'add',
                    taskId: newTaskId
                });

                const insertStmt = rawDb.prepare(`
                    INSERT INTO tasks (id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)
                `);
                insertStmt.run(newTaskId, action.text, action.date, action.calendar || 'personal', action.start_time || null, action.duration_min || 60, now, deviceId);
            }
        }

        rawDb.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO cognitive_actions (id, timestamp, action_type, source_engine, rationale, applied, undo_data)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)
        `).run(actionGroupId, now, 'restructure', 'orchestrator', 'User applied cognitive proposal', JSON.stringify(undoData));

    })(actions);

    return { success: true, actionId: actionGroupId };
}

function undoCognitiveAction(actionId) {
    const rawDb = mainDb.db;
    const now = Date.now();
    
    let row;
    if (actionId) {
        row = rawDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM cognitive_actions WHERE id = ?").get(actionId);
    } else {
        row = rawDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM cognitive_actions WHERE applied = 1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1").get();
    }

    if (!row) {
        return { success: false, error: 'No applied actions found to undo.' };
    }

    const undoData = JSON.parse(row.undo_data);
    rawDb.transaction(() => {
        for (const item of undoData) {
            if (item.type === 'move') {
                rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET date = ?, start_time = ?, updated_at = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `).run(item.originalDate, item.originalStartTime || null, now, item.taskId);
            } else if (item.type === 'shrink') {
                rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET duration_min = ?, updated_at = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `).run(item.originalDuration, now, item.taskId);
            } else if (item.type === 'add') {
                rawDb.prepare(`
                    DELETE FROM tasks 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `).run(item.taskId);
            } else if (item.type === 'delete') {
                rawDb.prepare(`
                    UPDATE tasks 
                    SET deleted = 0, updated_at = ?, synced = 0 
                    WHERE id = ?
                `).run(now, item.taskId);
            }
        }
        rawDb.prepare("UPDATE cognitive_actions SET applied = 0 WHERE id = ?").run(row.id);
    })();

    console.log(`✅ Undo executed successfully for action group ${row.id}.`);
    return { success: true, actionId: row.id };
}

```\n\n## main/cognitiveProfile.js\n\n- **Size:** 6182 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./main_db\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** calculateCognitiveProfile, formatHour, getCognitiveProfile\n\n```js\nconst mainDb = require('./main_db');
const db = mainDb.db;

/**
 * 🧠 COGNITIVE PROFILE ENGINE
 * Analyzes historical tasks and schedules to dynamically compute best focus windows,
 * low-energy slumps, average task duration, and weekday success cycles.
 */

function calculateCognitiveProfile(userId) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cutoff = now - 14 * 86400000; // Look back 14 days

    // Query tasks updated/created in the last 14 days
    let tasks = [];
    try {
        tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM tasks 
            WHERE updated_at >= ? AND deleted = 0
        `).all(cutoff);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("cognitiveProfile: Failed to fetch task history:", e.message);
        return null;
    }

    // Group completion densities by hour (0 to 23)
    const completionsByHour = Array(24).fill(0);
    const totalByHour = Array(24).fill(0);

    // Group completion rates by day of week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ...)
    const completionsByDay = Array(7).fill(0);
    const totalByDay = Array(7).fill(0);

    tasks.forEach(task => {
        if (!task.start_time) return;
        const [hourStr] = task.start_time.split(':');
        const hour = parseInt(hourStr, 10);
        if (isNaN(hour) || hour < 0 || hour > 23) return;

        const dateObj = new Date(task.date);
        const dayOfWeek = dateObj.getDay();

        totalByHour[hour]++;
        totalByDay[dayOfWeek]++;

        if (task.completed === 1) {
            completionsByHour[hour]++;
            completionsByDay[dayOfWeek]++;
        }
    });

    // 1. Calculate best 2-hour focus window
    let bestFocusStart = 9;
    let maxCompletionRate = 0.0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 23; i++) {
        const total = totalByHour[i] + totalByHour[i + 1];
        const completed = completionsByHour[i] + completionsByHour[i + 1];
        const rate = total > 0 ? completed / total : 0.0;
        
        if (rate > maxCompletionRate && total >= 1) {
            maxCompletionRate = rate;
            bestFocusStart = i;
        }
    }

    // 2. Calculate low energy 2-hour window during waking hours (08:00 to 22:00)
    let lowEnergyStart = 16;
    let minCompletionRate = 1.0;
    for (let i = 8; i < 21; i++) {
        const total = totalByHour[i] + totalByHour[i + 1];
        const completed = completionsByHour[i] + completionsByHour[i + 1];
        const rate = total > 0 ? completed / total : 1.0;

        if (rate < minCompletionRate && total >= 1) {
            minCompletionRate = rate;
            lowEnergyStart = i;
        }
    }

    // 3. Compute preferred focus session length (average of completed study/focus blocks)
    const focusDurations = tasks
        .filter(t => t.completed === 1 && (t.calendar === 'study' || t.calendar === 'focus' || t.calendar === 'work'))
        .map(t => t.duration_min);
    
    let preferredLength = 45;
    if (focusDurations.length > 0) {
        const sum = focusDurations.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr, 0);
        preferredLength = Math.round(sum / focusDurations.length);
    }

    // Format times as HH:MM strings
    const formatHour = (h) => String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':00';
    const bestFocusTime = `${formatHour(bestFocusStart)}-${formatHour(bestFocusStart + 2)}`;
    const lowEnergyTime = `${formatHour(lowEnergyStart)}-${formatHour(lowEnergyStart + 2)}`;

    // 4. Calculate day of week success rate
    const dayNames = ['sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'];
    const weeklyRates = {};
    dayNames.forEach((name, idx) => {
        const total = totalByDay[idx];
        const completed = completionsByDay[idx];
        weeklyRates[name] = total > 0 ? Math.round((completed / total) * 100) : 100;
    });

    const stressTriggers = ['overloaded calendar', 'multiple exam overlaps'];

    const profile = {
        user_id: userId,
        best_focus_time: bestFocusTime,
        low_energy_time: lowEnergyTime,
        preferred_session_length: preferredLength,
        stress_triggers: JSON.stringify(stressTriggers),
        weekly_completion_rates: JSON.stringify(weeklyRates),
        updated_at: now
    };

    try {
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cognitive_profiles (user_id, best_focus_time, low_energy_time, preferred_session_length, stress_triggers, weekly_completion_rates, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(
            profile.user_id,
            profile.best_focus_time,
            profile.low_energy_time,
            profile.preferred_session_length,
            profile.stress_triggers,
            profile.weekly_completion_rates,
            profile.updated_at
        );
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("cognitiveProfile: Failed to save computed profile:", e.message);
    }

    return {
        ...profile,
        stress_triggers: stressTriggers,
        weekly_completion_rates: weeklyRates
    };
}

function getCognitiveProfile(userId) {
    try {
        const row = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM cognitive_profiles WHERE user_id = ?").get(userId);
        if (row) {
            return {
                user_id: row.user_id,
                best_focus_time: row.best_focus_time,
                low_energy_time: row.low_energy_time,
                preferred_session_length: row.preferred_session_length,
                stress_triggers: JSON.parse(row.stress_triggers),
                weekly_completion_rates: JSON.parse(row.weekly_completion_rates),
                updated_at: row.updated_at
            };
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("cognitiveProfile: Failed to fetch profile from DB:", e.message);
    }

    // Default profile fallback
    return {
        user_id: userId,
        best_focus_time: "09:00-11:00",
        low_energy_time: "15:00-17:00",
        preferred_session_length: 45,
        stress_triggers: ["overloaded calendar"],
        weekly_completion_rates: {
            sunday: 100, monday: 100, tuesday: 100, wednesday: 100, thursday: 100, friday: 100, saturday: 100
        },
        updated_at: Date.now()
    };
}

module.exports = {
    calculateCognitiveProfile,
    getCognitiveProfile
};

```\n\n## main/contextCompression.js\n\n- **Size:** 11780 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./memoryEngine, ./main_db\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** createAbstraction, extractThemes, extractKeywords, extractPatterns, getEmotionalTrajectory, generateSummary, compressOldMemories, getCompressedContext, selectiveRecall, estimate\n\n```js\n/**
 * 📦 CONTEXT COMPRESSION SYSTEM
 * 
 * Handles memory compression and abstraction to prevent
 * token overflow and maintain coherence over long conversations.
 * 
 * Summarizes, abstracts, and compresses memories for efficiency.
 */

const memory = require('./memoryEngine');

// ========================================
// 🔍 CONTEXT COMPRESSION
// ========================================

let compressionState = {
    totalSessions: 0,
    compressionRatio: 0,
    lastCompression: Date.now(),
    abstractions: []
};

/**
 * Create abstraction (high-level summary) from memories
 */
function createAbstraction(memories = []) {
    if (memories.length === 0) return null;

    // Extract themes
    const themes = extractThemes(memories);

    // Extract patterns
    const patterns = extractPatterns(memories);

    // Emotional trajectory
    const emotionalTrajectory = getEmotionalTrajectory(memories);

    const abstraction = {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        themes,
        patterns,
        emotionalTrajectory,
        memoryCount: memories.length,
        summary: generateSummary(themes, patterns)
    };

    compressionState.abstractions.push(abstraction);

    // Keep bounded
    if (compressionState.abstractions.length > 50) {
        compressionState.abstractions.shift();
    }

    return abstraction;
}

/**
 * Extract key themes from conversation
 */
function extractThemes(memories = []) {
    const themes = {};

    for (const mem of memories) {
        const input = mem.userInput || '';
        const keywords = extractKeywords(input);

        for (const keyword of keywords) {
            themes[keyword] = (themes[keyword] || 0) + 1;
        }
    }

    // Return top themes
    return Object.entries(themes)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
        .slice(0, 5)
        .map(([theme]) => theme);
}

/**
 * Extract keywords from text
 */
function extractKeywords(text) {
    if (!text) return [];

    const stopWords = new Set([
        'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at',
        'to', 'for', 'of', 'with', 'from', 'is', 'are', 'be',
        'it', 'this', 'that', 'i', 'you', 'we', 'they', 'me'
    ]);

    const words = text.toLowerCase()
        .split(/[\s\-_\.,:;!?()]+/)
        .filter(w => w.length > 3 && !stopWords.has(w));

    return [...new Set(words)]; // Unique words
}

/**
 * Extract patterns (behavioral or conversational)
 */
function extractPatterns(memories = []) {
    const patterns = [];

    // Look for recurring topics
    const topicCounts = {};
    for (const mem of memories) {
        const topics = extractKeywords(mem.userInput);
        for (const topic of topics) {
            topicCounts[topic] = (topicCounts[topic] || 0) + 1;
        }
    }

    // Recurring topics are patterns
    for (const [topic, count] of Object.entries(topicCounts)) {
        if (count >= 2) {
            patterns.push({
                type: 'recurring_topic',
                value: topic,
                frequency: count
            });
        }
    }

    // Check for emotional patterns
    const emotions = memories
        .map(m => m.emotion)
        .filter(Boolean);

    if (emotions.length > 0) {
        const mostCommon = emotions.reduce((a, b) =>
            emotions.filter(e => e === a).length >
            emotions.filter(e => e === b).length ? a : b
        );

        patterns.push({
            type: 'dominant_emotion',
            value: mostCommon,
            frequency: emotions.filter(e => e === mostCommon).length
        });
    }

    return patterns;
}

/**
 * Track emotional trajectory
 */
function getEmotionalTrajectory(memories = []) {
    const emotions = memories
        .map(m => m.emotion)
        .filter(Boolean);

    if (emotions.length < 2) return null;

    const start = emotions[0];
    const end = emotions[emotions.length - 1];

    const transitions = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < emotions.length; i++) {
        if (emotions[i] !== emotions[i - 1]) {
            transitions.push({
                from: emotions[i - 1],
                to: emotions[i]
            });
        }
    }

    return {
        start,
        end,
        transitionCount: transitions.length,
        stability: 1 - (transitions.length / emotions.length)
    };
}

/**
 * Generate natural language summary
 */
function generateSummary(themes = [], patterns = []) {
    let summary = 'Theme: ';

    if (themes.length > 0) {
        summary += themes.slice(0, 3).join(', ');
    } else {
        summary += 'General conversation';
    }

    if (patterns.length > 0) {
        const emotionalPattern = patterns.find(p => p.type === 'dominant_emotion');
        if (emotionalPattern) {
            summary += `. Tone: ${emotionalPattern.value}.`;
        }
    }

    return summary;
}

// ========================================
// 🗜️ MEMORY COMPRESSION
// ========================================

/**
 * Compress old memories into abstractions
 */
function compressOldMemories(daysOld = 7) {
    const threshold = Date.now() - (daysOld * 86400000);
    const oldMemories = memory.getHierarchicalMemories(1000)
        .filter(m => m.timestamp < threshold);

    if (oldMemories.length > 10) {
        const abstraction = createAbstraction(oldMemories);
        compressionState.compressionRatio = abstraction.memoryCount / (abstraction.summary.length);
        compressionState.lastCompression = Date.now();
        return abstraction;
    }

    return null;
}

/**
 * Generate compressed context from abstractions
 */
function getCompressedContext(limit = 5) {
    const recent = compressionState.abstractions.slice(-limit);

    return recent.map(abs => ({
        period: new Date(abs.timestamp).toLocaleDateString(),
        themes: abs.themes,
        summary: abs.summary,
        emotionalState: abs.emotionalTrajectory?.end || 'unknown'
    }));
}

// ========================================
// 📊 SELECTIVE RECALL
// ========================================

/**
 * Recall only relevant memories for context
 * Prevents token bloat with smart filtering
 */
function selectiveRecall(currentTopic, maxTokens = 500) {
    const allMemories = memory.getHierarchicalMemories(100);

    // Rank by relevance to current topic
    const topicKeywords = extractKeywords(currentTopic);
    const scored = allMemories.map(mem => {
        const memKeywords = extractKeywords(mem.userInput);
        const overlap = topicKeywords.filter(k => memKeywords.includes(k)).length;
        return {
            ...mem,
            relevanceScore: overlap / Math.max(topicKeywords.length, 1)
        };
    });

    // Sort by relevance
    scored.sort((a, b) => b.relevanceScore - a.relevanceScore);

    // Select until token limit
    let tokenCount = 0;
    const selected = [];

    for (const mem of scored) {
        const estimate = (mem.userInput?.length || 0) / 4; // rough token estimate
        if (tokenCount + estimate < maxTokens) {
            selected.push(mem);
            tokenCount += estimate;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    return selected;
}

// ========================================
// 🔄 SYMBOLIC INDEXING
// ========================================

/**
 * Create symbolic anchors for quick memory retrieval
 */
function createSymbolicAnchor(theme, memory) {
    const anchor = {
        symbol: theme.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase(),
        theme,
        memory: memory.slice(0, 100),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        weight: 1.0
    };

    return anchor;
}

/**
 * Find memories by symbolic anchor
 */
function findBySymbol(symbol) {
    const memories = memory.getHierarchicalMemories(200);

    return memories.filter(mem => {
        const input = mem.userInput.toUpperCase();
        return input.includes(symbol);
    });
}

// ========================================
// 📈 COMPRESSION METRICS
// ========================================

function getCompressionMetrics() {
    return {
        totalAbstractions: compressionState.abstractions.length,
        lastCompression: new Date(compressionState.lastCompression).toISOString(),
        compressionRatio: compressionState.compressionRatio.toFixed(2),
        abstractionsInMemory: compressionState.abstractions.slice(-5).map(a => ({
            summary: a.summary,
            memoryCount: a.memoryCount
        }))
    };
}

// ========================================
// 🗜️ SIGNIFICANCE DB CLEANUP
// ========================================

function compressAndCleanDb() {
    const mainDb = require('./main_db');
    const db = mainDb.db;
    const now = Date.now();
    const fourteenDaysAgo = now - 14 * 86400000;

    try {
        // 1. Delete tasks that are marked deleted and are older than 14 days
        const deleteCount = db.prepare("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 1 AND updated_at < ?").run(fourteenDaysAgo).changes;

        // 2. Count low-significance tasks (e.g. calendar = 'personal' or 'family', importance_score < 5, completed = 1, not linked to goals/projects) older than 14 days
        const lowSigRows = db.prepare(`
            SELECT id, text, calendar FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 
              AND deleted = 0 
              AND updated_at < ? 
              AND importance_score < 5 
              AND goal_id IS NULL 
              AND project_id IS NULL
        `).all(fourteenDaysAgo);

        if (lowSigRows.length > 0) {
            // Aggregate counts by calendar
            const counts = {};
            lowSigRows.forEach(r => {
                counts[r.calendar] = (counts[r.calendar] || 0) + 1;
            });

            // Create an abstraction string
            const summaryParts = Object.entries(counts).map(([cal, count]) => `${count} minor ${cal} tasks`);
            const summaryText = `Archived/compressed: completed ${summaryParts.join(', ')} older than 14 days.`;

            // Insert this rollup summary as a cognitive memory
            const rollupId = `rollup_${now}`;
            db.prepare(`
                INSERT INTO cognitive_memories (id, user_id, memory_type, content, importance_score, created_at, updated_at, device_id, synced)
                VALUES (?, 'local_user', 'rollup_summary', ?, 2, ?, ?, ?, 0)
            `).run(rollupId, summaryText, now, now, mainDb.getDeviceId());

            // Delete the low-significance tasks we just rolled up
            const idsToDelete = lowSigRows.map(r => `'${r.id}'`).join(',');
            db.prepare(`DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id IN (${idsToDelete})`).run();
            
            console.log(`[Compression] Rolled up and purged ${lowSigRows.length} low-significance tasks: "${summaryText}"`);
        }

        return {
            success: true,
            purgedDeleted: deleteCount,
            rolledUpTasks: lowSigRows.length
        };
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Compression: database cleanup failed:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

// ========================================
// 📤 EXPORTS
// ========================================

module.exports = {
    createAbstraction,
    compressOldMemories,
    getCompressedContext,
    selectiveRecall,
    createSymbolicAnchor,
    findBySymbol,
    getCompressionMetrics,
    extractThemes,
    extractPatterns,
    extractKeywords,
    compressAndCleanDb
};

const db = mainDb.db;
