/**
 * Context Resurrection Service
 * Compiles state differences, open loops, and peer milestones completed since the user's last session.
 */
async function getContextResurrection(userId = 'local_user') {
    const now = Date.now();
    const lastActiveStr = mainDb.getSyncMeta('last_active_time');
    const userName = mainDb.getSyncMeta('user_name') || 'Planner';
    
    let elapsedDays = 0;
    let lastActiveTime = now;
    if (lastActiveStr) {
        lastActiveTime = parseInt(lastActiveStr, 10) || now;
        elapsedDays = Math.round((now - lastActiveTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    }
    
    // 1. Fetch Decayed Study Subjects (last_recalled > 5 days ago)
    const fiveDaysAgo = now - 5 * 86400000;
    const decayedSubjects = [];
    try {
        const rows = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.mastery, m.last_recalled
            FROM subjects s
            JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            WHERE m.last_recalled < ? OR m.last_recalled IS NULL
        `).all(fiveDaysAgo);
        rows.forEach(r => {
            decayedSubjects.push(r.name);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Resurrection: Failed to fetch decayed subjects:", e.message);
    }

    // 2. Fetch Open Loops (cognitive_loops where status = 'active' or 'no_new_development')
    const openLoops = [];
    try {
        const rows = db.prepare("SELECT topic, revisited_count FROM cognitive_loops WHERE status = 'active' OR status = 'no_new_development' ORDER BY revisited_count DESC LIMIT 3").all();
        rows.forEach(r => {
            openLoops.push(r.topic);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Resurrection: Failed to fetch open loops:", e.message);
    }

    // 3. Fetch Completed Milestones since last session (local SQLite first)
    const completedMilestones = [];
    try {
        const rows = db.prepare("SELECT title, peer_id FROM shared_milestones WHERE status = 'completed' AND updated_at > ?").all(lastActiveTime);
        rows.forEach(r => {
            let peerName = 'a peer';
            if (r.peer_id) {
                const peerRow = db.prepare("SELECT name FROM relationships WHERE id = ?").get(r.peer_id);
                if (peerRow) peerName = peerRow.name;
            }
            completedMilestones.push(`"${r.title}" (completed by ${peerName})`);
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Resurrection: Failed to fetch local milestones:", e.message);
    }

    // Fetch Completed Milestones from Supabase Cloud if connected
    const useCloud = mainDb.getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    const authToken = mainDb.getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    if (cloudDb && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('shared_milestones')
                .select('title, peer_id')
                .eq('status', 'completed')
                .gt('updated_at', new Date(lastActiveTime).toISOString());
            if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
                for (const item of data) {
                    const exists = completedMilestones.some(m => m.includes(item.title));
                    if (!exists) {
                        let peerName = 'a peer';
                        if (item.peer_id) {
                            const peerRow = db.prepare("SELECT name FROM relationships WHERE id = ?").get(item.peer_id);
                            if (peerRow) peerName = peerRow.name;
                        }
                        completedMilestones.push(`"${item.title}" (completed by ${peerName})`);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Could not fetch remote milestones on resurrection:", e.message || e);
        }
    }

    // Load Cognitive State (Thinking phase & Focus Profile)
    let activePhase = "Deep Focus / Spaced Learning";
    let activeProfileLabel = "Adaptive Pacing";
    try {
        const activeProfileRow = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM memory_behavior WHERE type = 'active_profile' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1").get();
        if (activeProfileRow) {
            const labelMap = {
                architect: "Systems Architect (layered, analytical focus)",
                companion: "Guided Scaffold (relational support pacing)",
                adaptive: "Adaptive Pacing (dynamic focus adaptation)",
                observer: "Neutral Observer (coherence telemetry and patterns)"
            };
            activeProfileLabel = labelMap[activeProfileRow.value] || activeProfileLabel;
        }

        // Infer active thinking phase from the most common category of active projects or tasks
        const activeProjectRow = db.prepare("SELECT title FROM projects WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1").get();
        if (activeProjectRow) {
            activePhase = `sprint focus on "${activeProjectRow.title}"`;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Resurrection: Failed to infer cognitive state:", e.message);
    }

    // 4. Synthesize Story-Oriented Narrative Greeting
    let greetingText = `Welcome back, ${userName}. `;
    if (elapsedDays > 0) {
        greetingText += `Restoring your persistent context after a ${elapsedDays}-day period of absence. `;
    } else {
        greetingText += `Re-anchoring your active focus. `;
    }

    greetingText += `You are currently returning to your cognitive phase of: ${activePhase}, operating under the ${activeProfileLabel} layer.\n\n`;

    let storyNarrative = '';
    if (completedMilestones.length > 0) {
        storyNarrative += `While you were away, the collaborative landscape evolved: peers finalized key milestones, including ${completedMilestones.join(', ')}. `;
    }
    if (decayedSubjects.length > 0) {
        storyNarrative += `Inside your learning chapters, retention decay has been detected for ${decayedSubjects.join(', ')}. We should prioritize active recall sessions to stabilize these mastery traces. `;
    }
    if (openLoops.length > 0) {
        storyNarrative += `Additionally, you have unresolved cognitive loops on: ${openLoops.join(', ')}. `;
    }

    if (storyNarrative.length > 0) {
        greetingText += `Current Chapter Status:\n${storyNarrative}`;
    } else {
        greetingText += `All collaborative projects, milestones, and focus chapters remain stable and in alignment.`;
    }

    return {
        elapsedDays,
        decayedSubjects,
        openLoops,
        completedMilestones,
        greeting: greetingText
    };
}

module.exports = {
    getContextResurrection
};

```\n\n## main/continuityStability.js\n\n- **Size:** 35775 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./main_db, ./cognitiveProfile, fs, path\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** getCognitiveFronts, cal, text, getExpansionMetrics, getRelationshipContinuity, getMeaningfulMilestones, getLoopDetections, processText, resolveLoopIntervention, getInterventionAdherence\n\n```js\nconst mainDb = require('./main_db');
const db = mainDb.db;

/**
 * 1. Cognitive Fronts Monitor
 * Evaluates activity densities to track active & high-load fronts.
 */
function getCognitiveFronts(userId = 'local_user') {
    const activeFronts = [];
    let highLoadFrontsCount = 0;
    const now = Date.now();
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(now - 7 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

    try {
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT calendar, goal_id, project_id, text, visibility 
            FROM tasks 
            WHERE date >= ? AND deleted = 0
        `).all(sevenDaysAgo);

        const counts = {
            Academic: 0,
            Project: 0,
            Relationship: 0,
            Health: 0,
            Personal: 0
        };

        tasks.forEach(t => {
            const cal = (t.calendar || 'personal').toLowerCase();
            const text = (t.text || '').toLowerCase();
            
            if (cal === 'study' || cal === 'focus') {
                counts.Academic++;
            }
            if (t.goal_id || t.project_id || cal === 'project') {
                counts.Project++;
            }
            if (cal === 'family' || t.visibility === 'shared_specific' || t.visibility === 'shared_group' || /princess|rayhaan|sana|tara|anwesha/.test(text)) {
                counts.Relationship++;
            }
            if (cal === 'routine') {
                counts.Health++;
            }
            if (cal === 'personal') {
                counts.Personal++;
            }
        });

        Object.entries(counts).forEach(([front, count]) => {
            if (count > 0) {
                const isHigh = count >= 8;
                if (isHigh) highLoadFrontsCount++;
                activeFronts.push({
                    name: front,
                    loadScore: count,
                    status: isHigh ? 'High Load' : 'Active'
                });
            }
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to get cognitive fronts:", e.message);
    }

    return {
        activeFronts,
        highLoadFrontsCount
    };
}

/**
 * 2. Expansion vs Completion Monitor
 * Computes Creation Rate vs Completion Rate.
 */
function getExpansionMetrics(userId = 'local_user') {
    const now = Date.now();
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(now - 30 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const thirtyDaysAgoTime = now - 30 * 86400000;

    let createdCount = 0;
    let completedCount = 0;
    let risk = 'Low';

    try {
        // Query tasks created in last 30 days
        // (Since tasks.updated_at is updated on edit, we look at created_at if we had it,
        // or approximate by tasks with date in last 30 days)
        const totalTasks30 = db.prepare(`
            SELECT completed FROM tasks 
            WHERE date >= ? AND deleted = 0
        `).all(thirtyDaysAgo);

        createdCount = totalTasks30.length;
        completedCount = totalTasks30.filter(t => t.completed === 1).length;

        // Query new projects
        const newProj = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM projects WHERE created_at >= ?").get(thirtyDaysAgoTime);
        createdCount += (newProj ? newProj.count : 0);

        const ratio = createdCount / (completedCount + 1);
        if (ratio >= 3.0) {
            risk = 'High';
        } else if (ratio >= 1.5) {
            risk = 'Moderate';
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to get expansion metrics:", e.message);
    }

    return {
        createdCount,
        completedCount,
        expansionRisk: risk
    };
}

/**
 * 3. Relationship Continuity Meter
 * Calculates active shared events/goals to reconcile perceived state with actual state.
 */
function getRelationshipContinuity(userId = 'local_user') {
    const list = [];
    try {
        const peers = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE user_id = ?").all(userId);
        peers.forEach(peer => {
            const countRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM shared_activities WHERE relationship_id = ?").get(peer.id);
            const count = countRow ? countRow.count : 0;
            
            // Shared Goals count
            const goalsRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM shared_activities WHERE relationship_id = ? AND activity_type = 'goal'").get(peer.id);
            const sharedGoalsCount = goalsRow ? goalsRow.count : 0;

            // Frequency: Interactions in database last 30 days
            const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const interactionRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE date >= ? AND text LIKE ? AND completed = 1").get(thirtyDaysAgo, `%${peer.name}%`);
            const frequency = interactionRow ? interactionRow.count : 0;

            // Reciprocity (ratio of tasks scheduled by user vs shared - mock metric or simple ratio)
            const reciprocity = frequency > 0 ? (frequency >= 3 ? 'Balanced' : 'Receiving') : 'Initiating';

            // Continuity Trend: growing or declining based on interaction frequency changes
            const prev30 = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const prevRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE date >= ? AND date < ? AND text LIKE ? AND completed = 1").get(prev30, thirtyDaysAgo, `%${peer.name}%`);
            const prevFrequency = prevRow ? prevRow.count : 0;

            let continuityTrend = 'Stable';
            if (frequency > prevFrequency) {
                continuityTrend = 'Growing';
            } else if (frequency < prevFrequency && frequency < 2) {
                continuityTrend = 'Declining';
            }

            let status = 'Low Interaction';
            if (count >= 5 || frequency >= 4) {
                status = 'Active';
            } else if (count >= 2 || frequency >= 1) {
                status = 'Moderate';
            }

            list.push({
                name: peer.name,
                role: peer.role,
                sharedCount: count,
                sharedGoalsCount,
                frequency,
                reciprocity,
                continuityTrend,
                status
            });
        });
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Failed to get relationship continuity:", e.message);
    }
    return list;
}

/**
 * 4. Meaning vs Activity Engine
 * Highlights meaningful milestones (high significance completions).
 */
function getMeaningfulMilestones(userId = 'local_user') {
    const milestones = [];
    try {
        // High importance tasks completed
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text, date, calendar FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND importance_score >= 7
            ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5
        `).all();

        tasks.forEach(t => {
            milestones.push(`Meaningful Milestone: Completed "${t.text}" on ${t.date} (${t.calendar} focus).`);
        });

        // High importance notes
        const notes = db.prepare(`
            SELECT title, created_at FROM notes 
            WHERE importance_score >= 7 
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
        `).all();

        notes.forEach(n => {
            const dateStr = new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleDateString();
            milestones.push(`Meaningful Thought: Captured "${n.title}" on ${dateStr}.`);
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to get meaningful milestones:", e.message);
    }
    return milestones;
}

/**
 * 5. Loop Detector & Continuity Intervention Engine
 * Detects keywords repeated in notes, tasks, or chats and classifies loop status/resolution action.
 */
function getLoopDetections(userId = 'local_user') {
    const detections = [];
    try {
        const notes = db.prepare("SELECT title, content FROM notes").all();
        const chats = db.prepare("SELECT user_input FROM memory_chat").all();

        const wordsFreq = {};
        const stopWords = new Set(['about', 'their', 'there', 'would', 'could', 'should', 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'study', 'focus', 'notes', 'tasks', 'needs', 'style', 'class', 'const', 'where', 'select', 'where']);

        const processText = (text) => {
            if (!text) return;
            const words = text.toLowerCase()
                .replace(/[^\w\s]/g, '')
                .split(/\s+/)
                .filter(w => w.length > 4 && !stopWords.has(w));
            
            // Unique words per document to track document frequency
            const unique = new Set(words);
            unique.forEach(w => {
                wordsFreq[w] = (wordsFreq[w] || 0) + 1;
            });
        };

        notes.forEach(n => processText(`${n.title} ${n.content || ''}`));
        chats.forEach(c => processText(c.user_input));

        const now = Date.now();
        Object.entries(wordsFreq).forEach(([word, freq]) => {
            if (freq >= 5) {
                const topic = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);
                
                // Insert or update DB loop state
                const existing = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM cognitive_loops WHERE topic = ?").get(topic);
                if (existing) {
                    db.prepare("UPDATE cognitive_loops SET revisited_count = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE topic = ?")
                      .run(freq, now, topic);
                } else {
                    db.prepare("INSERT INTO cognitive_loops (topic, revisited_count, status, resolution_action, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'no_new_development', 'continue_reflection', ?)")
                      .run(topic, freq, now);
                }
            }
        });

        // Read back from DB to return complete list including user statuses
        const rows = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM cognitive_loops WHERE revisited_count >= 5 AND status != 'archived' ORDER BY revisited_count DESC").all();
        rows.forEach(r => {
            detections.push({
                topic: r.topic,
                revisitedCount: r.revisited_count,
                status: r.status,
                resolutionAction: r.resolution_action,
                promptText: `You have revisited "${r.topic.toLowerCase()}" ${r.revisited_count} times. Status: ${r.status}. Action: ${r.resolution_action}.`
            });
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Loop detector failed:", e.message);
    }
    return detections;
}

function resolveLoopIntervention(topic, status, action) {
    try {
        db.prepare("UPDATE cognitive_loops SET status = ?, resolution_action = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE topic = ?")
          .run(status, action, Date.now(), topic);

        // Log loop resolution event in the adherence tracking table
        const id = 'ad_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO cognitive_loop_adherence (id, topic, action, date_resolved, completed_review)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
        `).run(id, topic, action, Date.now());

        if (action === 'schedule_review') {
            const mainDb = require('./main_db');
            const tomorrowStr = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
            mainDb.addTask({
                text: `Review Repeating Topic: ${topic}`,
                date: tomorrowStr,
                calendar: 'focus',
                duration_min: 45
            });
        }
        return { success: true };
    } catch(e) {
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

function getInterventionAdherence(userId = 'local_user') {
    try {
        const totalRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM cognitive_loop_adherence").get();
        const completedRow = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM cognitive_loop_adherence WHERE completed_review = 1").get();
        
        const total = totalRow ? totalRow.count : 0;
        const completed = completedRow ? completedRow.count : 0;
        const ratio = total > 0 ? parseFloat((completed / total).toFixed(2)) : 1.0;
        
        return {
            totalInterventions: total,
            completedReviews: completed,
            adherenceRatio: ratio,
            adherencePercentage: Math.round(ratio * 100)
        };
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to calculate intervention adherence:", err.message);
        return {
            totalInterventions: 0,
            completedReviews: 0,
            adherenceRatio: 1.0,
            adherencePercentage: 100
        };
    }
}

/**
 * 6. Memory Compression Engine
 * Group items into core universal themes.
 */
function getMemoryCompressionThemes(userId = 'local_user') {
    const themes = {
        Learning: [],
        Relationships: [],
        Projects: [],
        Health: [],
        Growth: []
    };

    try {
        // Learning: subjects and mastery
        const subjects = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.mastery 
            FROM subjects s
            JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            ORDER BY m.mastery DESC LIMIT 3
        `).all();
        subjects.forEach(s => {
            themes.Learning.push(`Mastery in ${s.name} reached ${Math.round(s.mastery * 100)}%`);
        });

        // Relationships: active peer checkins
        const peers = db.prepare("SELECT name, role FROM relationships LIMIT 3").all();
        peers.forEach(p => {
            themes.Relationships.push(`Collaborated with ${p.name} (${p.role})`);
        });

        // Projects: active goals/projects
        const activeGoals = db.prepare("SELECT title FROM goals WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 3").all();
        activeGoals.forEach(g => {
            themes.Projects.push(`Active Anchor: ${g.title}`);
        });

        // Health: routine tasks completed
        const routines = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text FROM tasks 
            WHERE calendar = 'routine' AND completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 
            LIMIT 3
        `).all();
        routines.forEach(r => {
            themes.Health.push(`Maintained: ${r.text}`);
        });

        // Growth: daily reflection logs
        const reflections = db.prepare(`
            SELECT content FROM cognitive_memories 
            WHERE memory_type = 'daily_reflection' AND deleted = 0 
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2
        `).all();
        reflections.forEach(ref => {
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(ref.content);
                themes.Growth.push(parsed.narrative);
            } catch(e) {}
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed memory compression engine:", e.message);
    }
    return themes;
}

/**
 * 7. Deep Focus Monitor
 * Checks focus duration depth.
 */
function getDeepFocusStats(userId = 'local_user') {
    try {
        const completedFocus = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text, duration_min, date 
            FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND calendar = 'focus' 
            ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 3
        `).all();
        return completedFocus;
    } catch(e) {
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * 8. Values Alignment Layer
 * Matches completed tasks count with core value parameters.
 */
function getValuesAlignment(userId = 'local_user') {
    const alignment = [];
    try {
        const tasks = db.prepare("SELECT calendar, COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY calendar").all();
        let total = 0;
        const counts = {};
        tasks.forEach(t => {
            total += t.count;
            counts[t.calendar] = t.count;
        });

        const defaultValues = [
            { name: 'Learning', calendars: ['study', 'focus'] },
            { name: 'Family', calendars: ['family'] },
            { name: 'Career & Projects', calendars: ['project'] },
            { name: 'Health & Mindfulness', calendars: ['routine'] }
        ];

        defaultValues.forEach(val => {
            let valCount = 0;
            val.calendars.forEach(c => {
                valCount += (counts[c] || 0);
            });
            const alignmentScore = total > 0 ? Math.round((valCount / total) * 100) : 0;
            alignment.push({
                value: val.name,
                alignmentScore,
                priorityStatus: alignmentScore >= 40 ? 'High Alignment' : 'Neutral'
            });
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Values alignment failed:", e.message);
    }
    return alignment;
}

/**
 * 9. Weekly Continuity Audit
 * Returns continuity audit vectors.
 */
function getWeeklyAudit(userId = 'local_user') {
    const audit = {
        whatMattered: [],
        whatChanged: [],
        whatProgressed: [],
        whatStalled: [],
        whatPreserved: [],
        whatReleased: []
    };

    const now = Date.now();
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(now - 7 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

    try {
        // What Mattered: Completed tasks with importance >= 7
        const mattered = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND importance_score >= 7 AND date >= ?
        `).all(sevenDaysAgo);
        audit.whatMattered = mattered.map(m => m.text);

        // What Changed: Mastery changes in last 7 days
        const changed = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.mastery 
            FROM subjects s
            JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            WHERE m.mastery > 0.1
            LIMIT 3
        `).all();
        audit.whatChanged = changed.map(c => `Mastered "${c.name}" to ${Math.round(c.mastery * 100)}%`);

        // What Progressed: Completed tasks linked to active projects/goals
        const progressed = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND goal_id IS NOT NULL AND date >= ?
        `).all(sevenDaysAgo);
        audit.whatProgressed = progressed.map(p => p.text);

        // What Stalled: Overdue/slipped tasks (pending tasks with date < today)
        const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        const stalled = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text, date FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND date < ?
        `).all(todayStr);
        audit.whatStalled = stalled.map(s => `Overdue: "${s.text}" (scheduled ${s.date})`);

        // What Preserved: Routines completed in last 7 days
        const preserved = db.prepare(`
            SELECT text FROM tasks 
            WHERE calendar = 'routine' AND completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND date >= ?
        `).all(sevenDaysAgo);
        audit.whatPreserved = preserved.map(p => p.text);

        // What Released: Goals completed or inactive
        const released = db.prepare(`
            SELECT title FROM goals WHERE status = 'completed' OR status = 'released'
        `).all();
        audit.whatReleased = released.map(r => r.title);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Weekly audit compilation failed:", e.message);
    }
    return audit;
}

/**
 * 10. Communication Assistant
 * Evaluates complexity, emotional intensity, and length of user draft entries.
 */
function evaluateDraftCommunication(text) {
    if (!text || !text.trim()) {
        return { rating: 'Empty', action: 'N/A' };
    }
    const len = text.length;
    const wordCount = text.split(/\s+/).length;

    // Intensity keywords
    const intensityWords = ['urgent', 'must', 'angry', 'terrible', 'hate', 'stupid', 'love', 'fantastic', 'essential', 'immediately', 'fail', 'bad', 'wrong'];
    let intensityCount = 0;
    intensityWords.forEach(w => {
        const matches = text.toLowerCase().match(new RegExp(`\\b${w}\\b`, 'g'));
        if (matches) intensityCount += matches.length;
    });

    let action = 'Send';
    let emotionalIntensity = 'Calm';

    if (intensityCount >= 3) {
        emotionalIntensity = 'High';
        action = 'Save Draft & Re-read';
    } else if (intensityCount >= 1) {
        emotionalIntensity = 'Moderate';
    }

    if (len > 800) {
        action = 'Compress or Convert to Note';
    } else if (wordCount > 60 && action === 'Send') {
        action = 'Compress';
    }

    return {
        characterCount: len,
        wordCount,
        emotionalIntensity,
        action
    };
}

/**
 * 11. Continuity State Machine
 */
function getContinuityState(userId = 'local_user') {
    let state = 'Maintaining';
    let explanation = 'Stable cycle. Routine and project outputs are balanced.';
    
    try {
        const now = Date.now();
        const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(now - 7 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
        
        const newProj = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM projects WHERE created_at >= ?").get(now - 7 * 86400000);
        const newProjCount = newProj ? newProj.count : 0;
        
        const studySec = db.prepare("SELECT SUM(duration_min) as total FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND date >= ? AND (calendar = 'study' OR calendar = 'focus')").get(sevenDaysAgo);
        const studyMin = studySec && studySec.total ? studySec.total : 0;
        
        const pendingCount = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed = 0 AND deleted = 0").get().count;
        
        const fronts = getCognitiveFronts(userId);
        const highLoad = fronts.highLoadFrontsCount;

        const notesCount = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM notes WHERE created_at >= ?").get(now - 7 * 86400000).count;

        if (highLoad >= 2 || pendingCount >= 15) {
            state = 'Overloaded';
            explanation = 'High load signals across multiple fronts. Action recommended: defer tasks and enter focus block pacing.';
        } else if (newProjCount >= 2 && studyMin >= 120) {
            state = 'Building';
            explanation = 'Elevated creation and execution velocity. Protecting peak slots is high priority.';
        } else if (notesCount >= 4 && newProjCount >= 1) {
            state = 'Exploring';
            explanation = 'Generative phase with increased conceptual note connections and values research.';
        } else if (studyMin === 0 && pendingCount <= 5) {
            state = 'Recovering';
            explanation = 'Low execution density. Prioritizing routine preservation and cognitive decompression.';
        }
        
        db.prepare("DELETE FROM memory_behavior WHERE type = 'continuity_state'").run();
        db.prepare("INSERT INTO memory_behavior (type, value, timestamp) VALUES ('continuity_state', ?, ?)").run(state, now);
        
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("State machine failed:", e.message);
    }
    
    return { state, explanation };
}

function performBackupRotation() {
    const fs = require('fs');
    const path = require('path');
    try {
        const dbPath = mainDb.dbPath;
        const dbDir = path.dirname(dbPath);
        
        if (!fs.existsSync(dbDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(dbDir, { recursive: true });
        }

        if (!fs.existsSync(dbPath)) {
            console.warn("Database file does not exist, skipping backup rotation.");
            return;
        }

        const timestamp = Date.now();
        const backupName = `chrono_backup_${timestamp}.db`;
        const backupPath = path.join(dbDir, backupName);

        fs.copyFileSync(dbPath, backupPath);
        console.log(`Backup created: ${backupPath}`);

        const files = fs.readdirSync(dbDir);
        const backups = files
            .filter(f => f.startsWith('chrono_backup_') && f.endsWith('.db'))
            .map(f => {
                const parts = f.split('_');
                const tsString = parts[parts.length - 1].replace('.db', '');
                const ts = parseInt(tsString, 10) || 0;
                return { name: f, path: path.join(dbDir, f), ts };
            })
            .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts);

        if (backups.length > 7) {
            const excess = backups.slice(7);
            excess.forEach(b => {
                try {
                    fs.unlinkSync(b.path);
                    console.log(`Deleted stale backup: ${b.name}`);
                } catch (unlinkErr) {
                    console.error(`Failed to delete stale backup ${b.name}:`, unlinkErr.message);
                }
            });
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Backup rotation failed:", err.message);
    }
}

function checkAndTriggerBackup() {
    try {
        const lastBackup = mainDb.getSyncMeta('last_backup_time');
        const now = Date.now();
        const oneDayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        
        if (!lastBackup || (now - parseInt(lastBackup, 10)) >= oneDayMs) {
            performBackupRotation();
            mainDb.setSyncMeta('last_backup_time', String(now));
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to check and trigger backup:", err.message);
    }
}

/**
 * 15. Trust & Reliability dashboard metrics
 */
function getTrustReliability(userId = 'local_user') {
    let dataIntegrity = 'Healthy';
    let syncHealth = 'Synched';
    let backupStatus = 'Available';
    let memoryCoverage = 100;
    let readLatencyMs = 0;
    let writeLatencyMs = 0;

    try {
        // Trigger automated backup check
        checkAndTriggerBackup();

        // Measure execution latency of read and write
        const startRead = process.hrtime.bigint();
        db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_meta").get();
        const endRead = process.hrtime.bigint();
        readLatencyMs = Number(endRead - startRead) / 1000000;

        const startWrite = process.hrtime.bigint();
        db.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_meta (key, value) VALUES ('_telemetry_ping', ?)").run(String(Date.now()));
        const endWrite = process.hrtime.bigint();
        writeLatencyMs = Number(endWrite - startWrite) / 1000000;

        const check = db.prepare("PRAGMA integrity_check").get();
        if (check && check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
            dataIntegrity = 'Compromised';
        }

        const unsyncedTasks = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE synced = 0").get().count;
        if (unsyncedTasks > 0) {
            syncHealth = 'Pending Sync';
        }

        const fs = require('fs');
        const path = require('path');
        const dbDir = path.dirname(mainDb.dbPath);
        const files = fs.readdirSync(dbDir);
        const backupExists = files.some(f => f.startsWith('chrono_backup_') && f.endsWith('.db'));
        backupStatus = backupExists ? 'Secured' : 'No Backup Found';

        const totalTasks = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks").get().count;
        const totalNotes = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM notes").get().count;
        const totalChats = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM memory_chat").get().count;
        const indexedCount = totalTasks + totalNotes + totalChats;
        memoryCoverage = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, indexedCount * 5));

    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Trust dashboard compilation failed:", e.message);
    }

    return {
        dataIntegrity,
        syncHealth,
        backupStatus,
        memoryCoverage,
        readLatencyMs: parseFloat(readLatencyMs.toFixed(2)),
        writeLatencyMs: parseFloat(writeLatencyMs.toFixed(2))
    };
}

/**
 * 16. Human Continuity Index
 */
function getContinuityIndex(userId = 'local_user') {
    let goalsScore = 50;
    let relationshipsScore = 50;
    let learningScore = 50;
    let healthScore = 50;
    let valuesScore = 50;
    let reflectionScore = 50;

    try {
        const completedGoals = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM goals WHERE status = 'completed'").get().count;
        const totalGoals = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM goals").get().count;
        goalsScore = totalGoals > 0 ? Math.round((completedGoals / totalGoals) * 100) : 50;

        const peers = getRelationshipContinuity(userId);
        const activePeers = peers.filter(p => p.status === 'Active' || p.status === 'Moderate').length;
        relationshipsScore = peers.length > 0 ? Math.round((activePeers / peers.length) * 100) : 50;

        const masteries = db.prepare("SELECT mastery FROM subject_mastery").all();
        if (masteries.length > 0) {
            const sum = masteries.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.mastery, 0);
            learningScore = Math.round((sum / masteries.length) * 100);
        }

        const totalRoutines = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE calendar = 'routine'").get().count;
        const completedRoutines = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE calendar = 'routine' AND completed = 1").get().count;
        healthScore = totalRoutines > 0 ? Math.round((completedRoutines / totalRoutines) * 100) : 50;

        const values = getValuesAlignment(userId);
        const alignedCount = values.filter(v => v.priorityStatus === 'High Alignment').length;
        valuesScore = values.length > 0 ? Math.round((alignedCount / values.length) * 100) : 50;

        const reflectionDays = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM cognitive_memories WHERE memory_type = 'daily_reflection' AND deleted = 0").get().count;
        reflectionScore = Math.min(100, reflectionDays * 20);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Continuity Index failed:", e.message);
    }

    const subScores = {
        goals: Math.max(10, goalsScore),
        relationships: Math.max(10, relationshipsScore),
        learning: Math.max(10, learningScore),
        health: Math.max(10, healthScore),
        values: Math.max(10, valuesScore),
        reflection: Math.max(10, reflectionScore)
    };

    const overallIndex = Math.round((subScores.goals + subScores.relationships + subScores.learning + subScores.health + subScores.values + subScores.reflection) / 6);

    return {
        overallIndex,
        subScores
    };
}

/**
 * 17. Narrative Engine
 */
function getMonthlyNarrative(userId = 'local_user') {
    try {
        const now = Date.now();
        const dateStr = new Date(now).toISOString().substring(0, 7);
        const months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        const monthNum = parseInt(dateStr.split('-')[1], 10);
        const monthName = months[monthNum - 1] || 'this month';

        const totalCompleted = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND date LIKE ?").get(`${dateStr}%`).count;
        const totalStudyMinutes = db.prepare("SELECT SUM(duration_min) as total FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND calendar = 'study' AND date LIKE ?").get(`${dateStr}%`).total || 0;
        const studyHrs = Math.round(totalStudyMinutes / 60);

        // Fetch top subjects
        let subjectText = "Academic work progressed across core disciplines.";
        try {
            const tasks = db.prepare(`
                SELECT s.name as subject_name, COUNT(*) as count
                FROM tasks t
                JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id = s.id
                WHERE t.completed = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.date LIKE ?
                GROUP BY s.name
                ORDER BY count DESC
                LIMIT 1
            `).get(`${dateStr}%`);
            if (tasks) {
                subjectText = `Study efforts centered around "${tasks.subject_name}" (${tasks.count} focus sessions completed).`;
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        const interactionCount = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND date LIKE ? AND text LIKE '%Study%'").get(`${dateStr}%`).count;
        const relText = interactionCount > 0 ? "Collaborative study circles stayed stable." : "Relationship checkins thinned slightly this month.";

        return `During ${monthName}, you focused on execution and continuity. You finalized ${totalCompleted} tasks, contributing to ${studyHrs} focused study hours. ${subjectText} ${relText} A major milestone was the completion of Chrono Memory OS.`;
    } catch(e) {
        return "Steady progress was maintained this month. Protected study sessions and key relationship channels remained stable.";
    }
}

const db = mainDb.db;

/**
 * Helper to calculate and cache continuity metrics for a peer thread
 */
function computeContinuityMetrics(peerId) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const thirtyDaysAgo = now - 30 * 86400000;
    const sixtyDaysAgo = now - 60 * 86400000;

    try {
        // 1. Last interaction timestamp
        const lastIntRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT MAX(timestamp) as last_time 
            FROM relationship_interactions 
            WHERE peer_id = ?
        `).get(peerId);
        const lastInteraction = lastIntRow && lastIntRow.last_time ? lastIntRow.last_time : null;

        // 2. Count shared completed milestones
        const milRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM shared_milestones 
            WHERE peer_id = ? AND status = 'completed' AND deleted = 0
        `).get(peerId);
        const completedMilestones = milRow ? milRow.count : 0;

        // 3. Count shared projects (from shared activities)
        const projRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM shared_activities 
            WHERE relationship_id = ? AND activity_type = 'project'
        `).get(peerId);
        const sharedProjects = projRow ? projRow.count : 0;

        // 4. Count recent interactions (last 30 days)
        const recentRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM relationship_interactions 
            WHERE peer_id = ? AND timestamp >= ?
        `).get(peerId, thirtyDaysAgo);
        const countLast30 = recentRow ? recentRow.count : 0;

        // 5. Count historical interactions (30-60 days ago)
        const histRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM relationship_interactions 
            WHERE peer_id = ? AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
        `).get(peerId, sixtyDaysAgo, thirtyDaysAgo);
        const countPrev30 = histRow ? histRow.count : 0;

        // Determine trend: Growing, Stable, or Drifting (No gamified percentages!)
        let trend = 'Stable';
        if (countLast30 > countPrev30) {
            trend = 'Growing';
        } else if (countLast30 === 0 && countPrev30 > 0) {
            trend = 'Drifting';
        } else if (countLast30 < countPrev30 && countLast30 < 2) {
            trend = 'Drifting';
        }

        // Determine Continuity Score: High, Medium, Low based on weights
        const weightScore = (countLast30 * 10) + (countPrev30 * 5) + (completedMilestones * 15) + (sharedProjects * 20);
        let continuityScore = 'Low';
        if (weightScore >= 50) {
            continuityScore = 'High';
        } else if (weightScore >= 15) {
            continuityScore = 'Medium';
        }

        // Upsert cached metrics
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO continuity_metrics (
                peer_id, continuity_score, trend, last_interaction, 
                shared_projects, shared_milestones, updated_at
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(peerId, continuityScore, trend, lastInteraction, sharedProjects, completedMilestones, now);

        return {
            continuityScore,
            trend,
            lastInteraction,
            sharedProjects,
            sharedMilestones: completedMilestones
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`Failed to calculate metrics for thread ${peerId}:`, e.message);
        return {
            continuityScore: 'Medium',
            trend: 'Stable',
            lastInteraction: null,
            sharedProjects: 0,
            sharedMilestones: 0
        };
    }
}

/**
 * Fetch all continuity threads (peers)
 */
function getThreads(userId) {
    try {
        const peers = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE user_id = ?").all(userId);
        return peers.map(peer => {
            const metrics = computeContinuityMetrics(peer.id);
            return {
                ...peer,
                metrics
            };
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("continuityThreads: Failed to fetch threads:", e.message);
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Fetch detailed thread information for a peer,
 * compiling shared events, goals, projects, notes, milestones, and memories.
 */
function getThreadDetails(userId, peerId) {
    const details = {
        peer: null,
        metrics: null,
        sharedEvents: [],
        sharedGoals: [],
        sharedProjects: [],
        sharedNotes: [],
        milestones: [],
        sharedMemories: []
    };

    try {
        // Fetch basic profile
        details.peer = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE id = ?").get(peerId);
        if (!details.peer) return details;

        // Calculate and attach fresh metrics
        details.metrics = computeContinuityMetrics(peerId);

        // Fetch shared activities mapped in shared_activities
        const activities = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM shared_activities 
            WHERE relationship_id = ?
        `).all(peerId);

        for (const act of activities) {
            if (act.activity_type === 'event') {
                const event = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0").get(act.target_id);
                if (event) details.sharedEvents.push(event);
            } else if (act.activity_type === 'goal') {
                const goal = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM goals WHERE id = ?").get(act.target_id);
                if (goal) details.sharedGoals.push(goal);
            } else if (act.activity_type === 'project') {
                const project = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ?").get(act.target_id);
                if (project) details.sharedProjects.push(project);
            } else if (act.activity_type === 'note') {
                const note = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ?").get(act.target_id);
                if (note) details.sharedNotes.push(note);
            }
        }

        // Fetch direct shared notes matching peer ID or group visibility
        const peerNotes = db.prepare(`
            SELECT n.*, g.title as goal_title, p.title as project_title, s.name as subject_name
            FROM notes n
            LEFT JOIN goals g ON n.linked_goal_id = g.id
            LEFT JOIN projects p ON n.linked_project_id = p.id
            LEFT JOIN subjects s ON n.linked_subject_id = s.id
            WHERE n.visibility = 'shared_group' 
               OR (n.visibility = 'shared_specific' AND n.shared_with LIKE ?)
        `).all(`%"${peerId}"%`);
        
        peerNotes.forEach(n => {
            try {
                n.shared_with = n.shared_with ? JSON.parse(n.shared_with) : [];
            } catch(e) {
                n.shared_with = [];
            }
            if (!details.sharedNotes.find(exist => exist.id === n.id)) {
                details.sharedNotes.push(n);
            }
        });

        // Fetch direct shared tasks matching peer ID or group visibility
        const peerEvents = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM tasks
            WHERE deleted = 0 
              AND (visibility = 'shared_group' 
                   OR (visibility = 'shared_specific' AND shared_with LIKE ?))
        `).all(`%"${peerId}"%`);

        peerEvents.forEach(e => {
            try {
                e.shared_with = e.shared_with ? JSON.parse(e.shared_with) : [];
            } catch(err) {
                e.shared_with = [];
            }
            if (!details.sharedEvents.find(exist => exist.id === e.id)) {
                details.sharedEvents.push(e);
            }
        });

        // Fetch Milestones associated with this peer
        details.milestones = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM shared_milestones 
            WHERE peer_id = ? AND deleted = 0 
            ORDER BY target_date DESC, created_at DESC
        `).all(peerId);

        // Fetch Shared Memories associated with this peer
        details.sharedMemories = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM shared_memories 
            WHERE peer_id = ?
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
        `).all(peerId);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("continuityThreads: Failed to fetch thread details:", e.message);
    }

    return details;
}

/**

function getSharedMilestones(peerId) {

        if (!peerId) {
            // Get all user milestones (both personal and peer connected ones)

function addSharedMilestone({ title, description, targetDate, peerId, projectId, goalId, importanceScore }) {

            now
        );

}

/**
 * Schedule a joint study session in task list and link to peer
 */
async function scheduleJointSession(peerId, title, date, startTime, durationMin) {
    const taskUuid = mainDb.generateUUID();
    const seedTime = Date.now();
    const deviceId = mainDb.getDeviceId();

    try {
        // Insert task with 'shared_specific' visibility and map to peer
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO tasks (id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted, visibility, shared_with)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'study', 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 'shared_specific', ?)
        `).run(taskUuid, title, date, startTime, durationMin, seedTime, deviceId, JSON.stringify([peerId]));

        // Link in shared activities
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO shared_activities (id, relationship_id, activity_type, target_id, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, 'event', ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(mainDb.generateUUID(), peerId, taskUuid, seedTime, seedTime);

        // Log interaction as study session scheduled
        logInteraction(peerId, 'study');

        // Fetch peer to see if we can share on Supabase
        const peer = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE id = ?").get(peerId);

        // Ensure study calendar exists locally
        const studyCal = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM calendars WHERE id = 'study'").get();
        if (!studyCal) {
            const authUserId = mainDb.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id') || 'local_user';
            db.prepare(`
                INSERT INTO calendars (id, name, owner_id, layer_type, updated_at, device_id)
                VALUES ('study', 'Study Calendar', ?, ?, ?)
            `).run(authUserId, seedTime, deviceId);
        }

        const useCloud = mainDb.getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
        const authUserId = mainDb.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
        const authToken = mainDb.getSyncMeta('auth_token');
        const cloudDb = require('./cloudDb');

        if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
            // Ensure study calendar is on Supabase
            await cloudDb.from('calendars').upsert({
                id: 'study',
                name: 'Study Calendar',
                owner_id: authUserId,
                layer_type: 'shared',
                updated_at: seedTime,
                device_id: deviceId
            });

            // Owner member
            await cloudDb.from('calendar_members').upsert({
                calendar_id: 'study',
                user_id: authUserId,
                role: 'owner',
                updated_at: seedTime,
                device_id: deviceId
            });

            // Share with peer on Supabase if they have peer_user_id
            if (peer && peer.peer_user_id) {
                await cloudDb.from('calendar_members').upsert({
                    calendar_id: 'study',
                    user_id: peer.peer_user_id,
                    role: 'editor',
                    updated_at: seedTime,
                    device_id: deviceId
                });
            }

            // Insert joint session event
            await cloudDb.from('events').upsert({
                id: taskUuid,
                calendar_id: 'study',
                text: title,
                date: date,
                completed: 0,
                start_time: startTime || null,
                duration_min: durationMin || 60,
                created_by: authUserId,
                updated_at: seedTime,
                device_id: deviceId,
                deleted: 0
            });
        }

        return { success: true, taskId: taskUuid };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("continuityThreads: Failed to schedule joint session:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

module.exports = {
    getThreads,
    getThreadDetails,
    addSharedActivity,
    addThread,
    logInteraction,
    getSharedMilestones,
    addSharedMilestone,
    completeMilestone,
    deleteMilestone,
    scheduleJointSession
};

const memory = require('./memoryEngine');

// ========================================
// 📊 EMOTIONAL STATE TRACKING
// ========================================

let emotionalState = {
    // Current emotional position
    current: 'neutral',
    intensity: 0.5,
    stability: 0.8,

    // Emotional memory (trajectory)
    history: [],
    maxHistory: 50,

    // Transition rules
    lastTransition: Date.now(),
    transitionCooldown: 5000, // ms before emotion can shift significantly

    // Attachment continuity
    attachment: {
        level: 0.5,           // 0-1, how connected is Chrono to this user
        consistency: 0.7,     // 0-1, how consistent is Chrono being
        recentEmotion: null,  // what was the emotional context last session
        abandonedThemes: []   // themes that went unresolved
    }
};

const emotionMap = {
    neutral: { valence: 0, arousal: 0.3, duration: 'stable' },
    supportive: { valence: 0.6, arousal: 0.4, duration: 'medium' },
    encouraging: { valence: 0.7, arousal: 0.5, duration: 'medium' },
    calm: { valence: 0.4, arousal: 0.2, duration: 'stable' },
    energetic: { valence: 0.8, arousal: 0.8, duration: 'short' },
    concerned: { valence: 0.2, arousal: 0.6, duration: 'medium' },
    overwhelmed: { valence: -0.5, arousal: 0.9, duration: 'short' },
    frustrated: { valence: -0.3, arousal: 0.7, duration: 'medium' },
    tired: { valence: -0.2, arousal: 0.2, duration: 'long' },
    sad: { valence: -0.6, arousal: 0.3, duration: 'long' }
};

// ========================================
// 🎭 EMOTIONAL TRANSITIONS
// ========================================

/**
 * Get emotional response for current state
 * Maintains continuity and natural pacing
 */
function getEmotionalResponse(detectedEmotion, context = {}) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const timeSinceLastTransition = now - emotionalState.lastTransition;

    // Check if emotion transition is valid
    const canTransition = canEmotionTransition(
        emotionalState.current,
        detectedEmotion,
        timeSinceLastTransition
    );

    if (!canTransition) {
        // Hold current emotional state if transition too soon
        return generateEmotionalMessage(emotionalState.current, 'maintain');
    }

    // Record transition
    recordEmotionalTransition(emotionalState.current, detectedEmotion);
    emotionalState.current = detectedEmotion;
    emotionalState.lastTransition = now;

    return generateEmotionalMessage(detectedEmotion, 'transition');
}

/**
 * Determine if emotion can transition
 * Prevents emotional whiplash
 */
function canEmotionTransition(currentEmotion, targetEmotion, timeSince) {
    // Can't transition if same emotion
    if (currentEmotion === targetEmotion) {
        return true;
    }

    // Get emotional properties
    const currentProps = emotionMap[currentEmotion] || emotionMap.neutral;
    const targetProps = emotionMap[targetEmotion] || emotionMap.neutral;

    // Calculate emotional distance
    const valenceDiff = Math.abs(currentProps.valence - targetProps.valence);
    const arousalDiff = Math.abs(currentProps.arousal - targetProps.arousal);
    const distance = valenceDiff + arousalDiff;

    // Large jumps require more time
    if (distance > 1.0 && timeSince < 10000) return false;
    if (distance > 0.5 && timeSince < 5000) return false;

    return true;
}

/**
 * Record emotional transition in history
 */
function recordEmotionalTransition(from, to) {
    const entry = {
        from,
        to,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        intensity: emotionalState.intensity
    };

    emotionalState.history.push(entry);

    if (emotionalState.history.length > emotionalState.maxHistory) {
        emotionalState.history.shift();
    }

    // Update attachment if strong emotion
    const toProps = emotionMap[to];
    if (toProps && Math.abs(toProps.valence) > 0.4) {
        emotionalState.attachment.level = Math.min(1, emotionalState.attachment.level + 0.05);
    }
}

/**
 * Update emotional intensity
 * Strong input increases intensity, decay over time
 */
function updateEmotionalIntensity(input, baseIntensity = 0.5) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const timeSinceTransition = now - emotionalState.lastTransition;

    // Decay intensity over time
    let intensity = baseIntensity * (1 - (timeSinceTransition / 30000)); // decay over 30 seconds

    // Cap at current intensity (don't decrease suddenly)
    intensity = Math.max(intensity, emotionalState.intensity * 0.9);

    emotionalState.intensity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0.1, intensity));
    return emotionalState.intensity;
}

/**

function updateAttachmentLevel(consistency) {

    // Consistency affects attachment
    if (consistency > 0.85) {

    } else if (consistency < 0.6) {

/**
 * Detect unresolved emotional themes
 * Mark for continuation
 */
function detectUnresolvedTheme(input, context = {}) {
    const emotion = context.emotion || 'neutral';
    const isNegativeEmotion = ['overwhelmed', 'frustrated', 'sad'].includes(emotion);

    // If strong negative emotion was mentioned but not addressed
    if (isNegativeEmotion && !context.addressed) {
        const theme = {
            emotion,
            topic: input.slice(0, 50),
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            intensity: emotionalState.intensity
        };

        emotionalState.attachment.abandonedThemes.push(theme);

        if (emotionalState.attachment.abandonedThemes.length > 5) {

        }

        return theme;
    }

    return null;
}

/**

 */
function getAbandonedTheme() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const themes = emotionalState.attachment.abandonedThemes.filter(t => {
        // Only consider themes from last session or earlier today
        return now - t.timestamp < 86400000; // 24 hours
    });

    if (themes.length === 0) return null;

    // Return highest intensity abandoned theme
    return themes.reduce((a, b) => (b.intensity > a.intensity ? b : a));
}

/**

 */
function generateContinuationMessage() {
    const theme = getAbandonedTheme();
    if (!theme) return null;

    const continuations = {

        ]
    };

    const messages = continuations[theme.emotion] || ['I\'ve been thinking about you. How are things?'];
    return messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)];
}

/**

 */
function clearAbandonedTheme(theme) {
    const index = emotionalState.attachment.abandonedThemes.indexOf(theme);
    if (index > -1) {

    }

/**
 * Calculate emotional stability score
 * Detects if we're oscillating or consistent
 */
function getEmotionalStability() {
    if (emotionalState.history.length < 5) {
        return 0.8;
    }

    const recent = emotionalState.history.slice(-10);
    const emotions = recent.map(e => e.to);

    // Count transitions
    let transitionCount = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < emotions.length; i++) {
        if (emotions[i] !== emotions[i - 1]) {
            transitionCount++;
        }
    }

    // Stability = 1 - (transitions / max possible)
    const stability = 1 - (transitionCount / emotions.length);
    emotionalState.stability = stability;

    return stability;
}

 */
function detectEmotionalLoop() {
    if (emotionalState.history.length < 4) return false;

    const recent = emotionalState.history.slice(-4).map(e => e.to);
    const pattern = recent.slice(0, 2);

    // Check if last 4 emotions repeat the first 2
    return (
        recent[2] === pattern[0] &&
        recent[3] === pattern[1]
    );
}

```\n\n## main/executiveFunction.js\n\n- **Size:** 2267 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./main_db\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** getSlippedTasks\n\n```js\nconst mainDb = require('./main_db');

/**
 * 🧠 EXECUTIVE FUNCTION COACH ENGINE
 * Monitors task deadlines, identifies slipped tasks, and constructs
 * proactive, shame-free rescheduling structures (cognitive scaffolding).
 */

function getSlippedTasks(currentDate) {
    const db = mainDb.db;
    const today = currentDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    try {
        // Query tasks scheduled before today that are not completed and not deleted
        const slipped = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM tasks 
            WHERE date < ? AND completed = 0 AND deleted = 0
            ORDER BY date ASC, updated_at DESC
        `).all(today);

        if (slipped.length === 0) {
            return {
                hasSlipped: false,
                slippedTasks: [],
                proposal: null
            };
        }

        // Generate shame-free move proposal actions
        const actions = slipped.map(task => ({
            type: 'move',
            taskId: task.id,
            text: task.text,
            originalDate: task.date,
            newDate: today
        }));

        const taskNames = slipped.map(t => `"${t.text}"`).join(', ');

        return {
            hasSlipped: true,
            slippedTasks: slipped,
            proposal: {
                type: 'slipped_reschedule',
                confidence: 0.88,
                reason: 'Active tasks scheduled in the past detected as incomplete.',
                explanation: `I noticed that these tasks: ${taskNames} are still active from earlier days. There is absolutely no shame in shifting things around. Shall we slide them all onto today's focus queue?`,
                reasoning_bullets: [
                    "Tasks remained incomplete after their scheduled date",
                    "Cognitive anchoring recommendation to prevent task neglect",
                    "Shame-free schedule restructuring support"
                ],
                actions
            }
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("ExecutiveFunction: Failed to query slipped tasks:", e.message);
        return {
            hasSlipped: false,
            slippedTasks: [],
            proposal: null
        };
    }
}

module.exports = {
    getSlippedTasks
};

function addGoal(userId, title, description, targetDate) {
    const id = 'g_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
    const now = Date.now();
    try {
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO goals (id, user_id, title, description, target_date, status, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?, ?)
        `).run(id, userId, title, description || null, targetDate || null, now, now);
        return { success: true, goalId: id };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to add goal:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

function getGoals(userId) {
    try {
        const goals = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM goals WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'active' ORDER BY target_date ASC").all(userId);
        
        for (const goal of goals) {
            const projects = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE goal_id = ? AND status = 'active'").all(goal.id);
            for (const project of projects) {
                const subjects = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM subjects WHERE project_id = ?").all(project.id);
                for (const subject of subjects) {
                    let mastery = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM subject_mastery WHERE subject_id = ?").get(subject.id);
                    if (!mastery) {
                        db.prepare(`
                            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO subject_mastery (subject_id, mastery, quiz_scores, revision_frequency, last_recalled)
                            VALUES (?, 0.0, '[]', 0, 0)
                        `).run(subject.id);
                        mastery = { mastery: 0.0, quiz_scores: '[]', revision_frequency: 0, last_recalled: 0 };
                    } else {
                        mastery.quiz_scores = JSON.parse(mastery.quiz_scores);
                    }
                    subject.mastery = mastery;
                }
                project.subjects = subjects;
            }
            goal.projects = projects;
        }
        return goals;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to fetch goals:", e.message);
        return [];
    }
}

        return { success: true };

        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to delete goal:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO projects (id, goal_id, title, description, status, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?, ?)
        `).run(id, goalId, title, description || null, now, now);
        return { success: true, projectId: id };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to add project:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

function addSubject(projectId, name) {
    const id = 's_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
    const now = Date.now();
    try {
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO subjects (id, project_id, name, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(id, projectId, name, now, now);
        
        // Auto-initialize subject mastery row
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO subject_mastery (subject_id, mastery, quiz_scores, revision_frequency, last_recalled)
            VALUES (?, 0.1, '[]', 0, 0)
        `).run(id);

        return { success: true, subjectId: id };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to add subject:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

function getSubjectMastery(subjectId) {
    try {
        const row = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM subject_mastery WHERE subject_id = ?").get(subjectId);
        if (row) {
            return {
                ...row,
                quiz_scores: JSON.parse(row.quiz_scores)
            };
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to get subject mastery:", e.message);
    }
    return null;
}

function updateSubjectMastery(subjectId, mastery, quizScore = null) {
    try {
        const row = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM subject_mastery WHERE subject_id = ?").get(subjectId);
        let scores = [];
        let freq = 0;
        if (row) {
            scores = JSON.parse(row.quiz_scores);
            freq = row.revision_frequency;
        }

        if (quizScore !== null) {
            scores.push({
                score: quizScore,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            });
        }

        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO subject_mastery (subject_id, mastery, quiz_scores, revision_frequency, last_recalled)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(subjectId, mastery, JSON.stringify(scores), freq + 1, Date.now());

        return { success: true };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("goalIntelligence: Failed to update subject mastery:", e.message);
        return { success: false, error: e.message };
    }
}

// ========================================
// 🧠 PRIORITIZATION ALGORITHM (Jarvis Logic)
// ========================================

function getPrioritizedGoalActions(userId, today) {
    const todayStr = today || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const goals = getGoals(userId);

    if (goals.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    const flatSubjects = [];

    goals.forEach(goal => {
        let daysRemaining = 14; // Default baseline urgency
        if (goal.target_date) {
            const diffMs = new Date(goal.target_date + "T00:00:00").getTime() - Date.now();
            daysRemaining = Math.max(1, Math.round(diffMs / 86400000));
        }

        (goal.projects || []).forEach(project => {
            (project.subjects || []).forEach(subject => {
                const masteryVal = subject.mastery ? subject.mastery.mastery : 0.0;
                
                // Calculate priority score: Lower mastery and closer goal target date = higher priority
                // Urgency factor starts high for close dates
                const urgencyFactor = 100 / daysRemaining;
                const masteryGap = 1.0 - masteryVal;
                const priorityScore = urgencyFactor * masteryGap;

                flatSubjects.push({
                    goal,
                    project,
                    subject,
                    daysRemaining,
                    mastery: masteryVal,
                    lastRecalled: subject.mastery ? subject.mastery.last_recalled : 0,
                    priorityScore
                });
            });
        });
    });

    if (flatSubjects.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    // Sort by priority score descending
    flatSubjects.sort((a, b) => b.priorityScore - a.priorityScore);

    // Pick top prioritized subject to build revision block
    const top = flatSubjects[0];
    const profile = cognitiveProfile.getCognitiveProfile(userId);

    // Parse focus hour start (e.g. "09:00-11:00" -> "09:00")
    let startTime = "09:00";
    if (profile.best_focus_time) {
        const matches = profile.best_focus_time.match(/^(\d{2}:\d{2})/);
        if (matches) startTime = matches[1];
    }

    const duration = profile.preferred_session_length || 45;

    const actionText = `Active Recall: ${top.subject.name}`;
    const taskId = 'e_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);

    // Generate explainable bullets
    const reasoningBullets = [
        `Subject mastery is currently low (${Math.round(top.mastery * 100)}%)`,
        `Linked goal "${top.goal.title}" target date is in ${top.daysRemaining} days`,
        `Calculated best focus window is ${profile.best_focus_time} (scheduling at ${startTime})`
    ];

    if (top.lastRecalled === 0) {
        reasoningBullets.push("No active recall session recorded yet for this subject");
    } else {
        const daysSinceRecall = Math.round((Date.now() - top.lastRecalled) / 86400000);
        reasoningBullets.push(`${daysSinceRecall} days elapsed since your last practice session`);
    }

    return {
        type: 'spaced_study_planning',
        confidence: 0.94,
        reason: 'Priority goal execution recommended by cognitive study intelligence.',
        explanation: `Based on your upcoming goal to **"${top.goal.title}"** (in ${top.daysRemaining} days), I propose scheduling a revision block for **"${top.subject.name}"** today. Your current mastery is ${Math.round(top.mastery * 100)}%, and placing this session during your peak focus hours will optimize retention.`,
        reasoning_bullets: reasoningBullets,
        actions: [{
            type: 'add',
            id: taskId,
            text: actionText,
            date: todayStr,
            calendar: 'study',
            start_time: startTime,
            duration_min: duration,
            goal_id: top.goal.id,
            project_id: top.project.id,
            subject_id: top.subject.id
        }]
    };
}

module.exports = {
    addGoal,
    getGoals,
    deleteGoal,
    addProject,
    addSubject,
    getSubjectMastery,
    updateSubjectMastery,
    getPrioritizedGoalActions
};

async function startGoogleAuth(supabaseClient) {

                                if (accessToken) {

                                if (!accessToken) {

        timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {

        // Start listening
        server.listen(port, 'localhost', async (err) => {

            }
        });
