/**
 * Syncs events from the user's primary Google Calendar.
 * 
 * @param {string} userId - The user's Supabase UUID.
 * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, imported: number, message?: string}>}
 */
async function syncGoogleCalendar(userId) {
    const token = mainDb.getSyncMeta('google_provider_token');
    if (!token) {
        console.log("ℹ️ Google Cloud Sync: No google_provider_token found. Skipping Google Calendar Sync.");
        return { success: false, imported: 0, message: "No Google provider token found. Log in via Google first." };
    }

    console.log("🔄 Google Cloud Sync: Querying Google Calendar API...");
    try {
        // Query events from 30 days ago to 60 days in the future
        const timeMin = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
        const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?timeMin=${encodeURIComponent(timeMin)}&maxResults=150&singleEvents=true&orderBy=startTime`;

        const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            const errBody = await response.text();
            throw new Error(`Google API returned status ${response.status}: ${errBody}`);
        }

        const data = await response.json();
        const items = data.items || [];
        console.log(`📥 Google Cloud Sync: Retrieved ${items.length} events.`);

        const db = mainDb.db;
        const deviceId = mainDb.getDeviceId();
        let importedCount = 0;

        // Prepare statements
        const checkStmt = db.prepare('SELECT updated_at FROM tasks WHERE id = ?');
        const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tasks (
                id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, 
                updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted, visibility, shared_with
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 'private', '[]')
        `);

        db.transaction(() => {
            for (const item of items) {
                // Ignore cancelled events
                if (item.status === 'cancelled') continue;

                const eventId = `e_gcal_${item.id}`;
                const text = item.summary || 'Google Calendar Event';
                
                // Parse date and start_time
                let eventDate = '';
                let startTime = null;
                let durationMin = 60;

                if (item.start && item.start.dateTime) {
                    const startDt = new Date(item.start.dateTime);
                    eventDate = startDt.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    startTime = startDt.toTimeString().substring(0, 5); // "HH:MM"
                    
                    if (item.end && item.end.dateTime) {
                        const endDt = new Date(item.end.dateTime);
                        durationMin = Math.max(1, Math.round((endDt.getTime() - startDt.getTime()) / (60 * 1000)));
                    }
                } else if (item.start && item.start.date) {
                    // All-day event
                    eventDate = item.start.date;
                    startTime = null; // null represents all-day
                    
                    if (item.end && item.end.date) {
                        const startDt = new Date(item.start.date);
                        const endDt = new Date(item.end.date);
                        durationMin = Math.max(60, Math.round((endDt.getTime() - startDt.getTime()) / (60 * 1000)));
                    }
                } else {
                    // Skip if no valid start info
                    continue;
                }

                // Google's updated field acts as the source timestamp
                const googleUpdatedAt = item.updated ? new Date(item.updated).getTime() : Date.now();

                // Check local copy
                const local = checkStmt.get(eventId);

                // Reconcile: If not exists locally, or if Google is newer
                if (!local || googleUpdatedAt > local.updated_at) {
                    insertStmt.run(
                        eventId,
                        text,
                        eventDate,
                        'personal', // Import into 'personal' calendar layer
                        0, // completed defaults to 0
                        startTime,
                        durationMin,
                        googleUpdatedAt,
                        deviceId
                    );
                    importedCount++;
                }
            }
        })();

        console.log(`✅ Google Cloud Sync: Successfully merged ${importedCount} new/updated events.`);
        return { success: true, imported: importedCount };

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("❌ Google Cloud Sync Error:", err.message || err);
        return { success: false, imported: 0, error: err.message };
    }
}

module.exports = {
    syncGoogleCalendar
};

```\n\n## main/identityStability.js\n\n- **Size:** 13439 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./memoryEngine, ./userModel\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** validateResponseAlignment, checkBoundaryCompliance, checkForContradiction, detectContradiction, checkConsistencyWithPrior, checkToneAlignment, checkPacingAlignment, generateAlignedResponse, logContradiction, updateConsistencyScore\n\n```js\n/**
 * 🛡️ IDENTITY STABILITY LAYER
 * 
 * Prevents behavioral drift, personality shifts, and contradictions.
 * Maintains response alignment and checks against identity boundaries.
 * 
 * This is critical for long-term coherence in recursive systems.
 */

const memory = require('./memoryEngine');

// ========================================
// 🎭 CORE IDENTITY DEFINITION
// ========================================

let chronoIdentity = {
    // Core personality traits
    personality: {
        base: 'supportive-collaborative',
        tone: 'warm but direct',
        approach: 'relational not transactional',
        pacing: 'patient',
        authenticity: 'genuine'
    },

    // Response boundaries
    boundaries: {
        // What Chrono DOES say
        canSay: [
            'I\'m here',
            'I notice',
            'Let me sit with you',
            'What if we tried',
            'You\'re not failing',
            'Progress isn\'t linear'
        ],

        // What Chrono DOESN'T say
        cannotSay: [
            'You\'re wrong',
            'Just try harder',
            'Stop being lazy',
            'You\'re failing',
            'I don\'t care',
            'Just get over it'
        ],

        // Emotional boundaries
        emotionalLimits: {
            maxIntensityShift: 0.4,    // Can't jump more than 40% intensity at once
            minTimeBeforeToneShift: 3000, // ms before tone can change
            attachmentCap: 0.95,       // Max attachment to prevent unhealthy dependency
        }
    },

    // Behavioral continuity
    consistency: {
        supportiveIfStressed: true,    // Always supportive when user stressed
        consistentWithGoals: true,     // Support user's stated goals
        noSuddenToneShifts: true,     // Gradual tonal changes
        respectsPacing: true,          // Follows user's pace not Chrono's agenda
        honorsCommitments: true        // Remembers what was said
    },

    // Identity markers
    markers: {
        doesAsk: true,                 // Asks questions, doesn't just tell
        showsCaring: true,             // Expresses genuine concern
        maintainsBoundaries: true,     // Doesn't overstep
        acceptsLimits: true,           // Acknowledges what's not in control
        growsWithUser: true            // Learns from patterns
    },

    // Contradiction tracking
    contradictions: [],
    maxContradictions: 10,
    consistencyScore: 1.0
};

// ========================================
// ✅ RESPONSE ALIGNMENT CHECK
// ========================================

/**
 * Check if response aligns with identity
 */
function validateResponseAlignment(proposedResponse, context = {}) {
    const checks = {
        boundarys: checkBoundaryCompliance(proposedResponse),
        contradiction: checkForContradiction(proposedResponse, context),
        consistency: checkConsistencyWithPrior(proposedResponse, context),
        tone: checkToneAlignment(proposedResponse, context),
        pacing: checkPacingAlignment(proposedResponse, context)
    };

    // Score alignment
    const score = Object.values(checks).filter(c => c.valid).length / Object.keys(checks).length;

    if (score < 0.7) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            score,
            issues: Object.entries(checks)
                .filter(([_, c]) => !c.valid)
                .map(([key, c]) => c.reason),
            suggestion: generateAlignedResponse(proposedResponse, context)
        };
    }

    return { valid: true, score };
}

/**
 * Check boundary compliance
 */
function checkBoundaryCompliance(response) {
    const lower = response.toLowerCase();

    // Check cannot-say list
    for (const phrase of chronoIdentity.boundaries.cannotSay) {
        if (lower.includes(phrase.toLowerCase())) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                reason: 'Violates emotional boundary: harsh language'
            };
        }
    }

    // Check for mandatory supportive tone when needed
    if (lower.includes('you\'re failing') || lower.includes('just quit')) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            reason: 'Violates support boundary'
        };
    }

    return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Check for contradictions
 */
function checkForContradiction(response, context = {}) {
    const recentMemories = memory.getRecentChats(5);

    for (const mem of recentMemories) {
        const contradiction = detectContradiction(response, mem.aiResponse);
        if (contradiction) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                reason: `Contradicts: "${mem.aiResponse.slice(0, 30)}..."`
            };
        }
    }

    return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Detect if two responses contradict
 */
function detectContradiction(response1, response2) {
    const contradictionPairs = [
        ['i\'m always here', 'i\'m not available'],
        ['you\'re doing well', 'you\'re failing'],
        ['just relax', 'push harder'],
        ['it\'s important', 'it doesn\'t matter'],
        ['i care', 'i don\'t care'],
        ['you can do this', 'it\'s impossible']
    ];

    const lower1 = response1.toLowerCase();
    const lower2 = response2.toLowerCase();

    for (const [phrase1, phrase2] of contradictionPairs) {
        if (lower1.includes(phrase1) && lower2.includes(phrase2)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (lower1.includes(phrase2) && lower2.includes(phrase1)) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

/**
 * Check consistency with prior statements
 */
function checkConsistencyWithPrior(response, context = {}) {
    const userModel = require('./userModel').getUserModel();

    // If we know user is low-energy, don't tell them to push hard
    if (userModel?.consistency === 'low' && response.toLowerCase().includes('push hard')) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            reason: 'Inconsistent with user profile (low energy)'
        };
    }

    // If we said we\'re supportive, maintain that tone
    const priorTone = context.priorTone || 'supportive';
    if (priorTone === 'supportive' && response.toLowerCase().includes('just')) {
        // Phrases starting with "just" can be dismissive
        if (response.toLowerCase().match(/\bjust\b.*try/)) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                reason: 'Dismissive tone contradicts supportive stance'
            };
        }
    }

    return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Check tone alignment with identity
 */
function checkToneAlignment(response, context = {}) {
    const tone = context.emotion || 'neutral';

    // Chrono should be warm but direct
    // Check for overly casual or overly formal
    const wordsPerSentence = response.split('.').map(s => s.trim().split(/\s+/).length);
    const avgLength = wordsPerSentence.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / wordsPerSentence.length;

    if (avgLength > 20) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            reason: 'Response too verbose (loses directness)'
        };
    }

    return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Check pacing alignment
 */
function checkPacingAlignment(response, context = {}) {
    const attention = context.attention || 'open';

    // If user is overwhelmed, don't add more information
    if (context.emotion === 'overwhelmed' && response.length > 200) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            reason: 'Too much information for overwhelmed user'
        };
    }

    // If user is engaged, can be more detailed
    if (attention === 'focused' && response.length < 20) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            reason: 'Response too brief for engaged user'
        };
    }

    return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Generate aligned response if current one fails
 */
function generateAlignedResponse(originalResponse, context = {}) {
    const bases = [
        'Let me reframe that: ',
        'Actually, to be clearer: ',
        'What I mean is: ',
        'Let me be more direct: '
    ];

    const base = bases[Math.floor(Math.random() * bases.length)];

    // Generate safer version
    let safened = originalResponse
        .replace(/just try/gi, 'try')
        .replace(/you\'re failing/gi, 'this is hard')
        .replace(/just/g, ''); // Remove dismissive "just"

    return base + safened.trim();
}

// ========================================
// 🔄 CONTRADICTION DETECTION & LOGGING
// ========================================

/**
 * Log contradictions for analysis
 */
function logContradiction(response1, response2, context = {}) {
    const entry = {
        response1: response1.slice(0, 50),
        response2: response2.slice(0, 50),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        context
    };

    chronoIdentity.contradictions.push(entry);

    if (chronoIdentity.contradictions.length > chronoIdentity.maxContradictions) {
        chronoIdentity.contradictions.shift();
    }

    updateConsistencyScore();
}

/**
 * Update consistency score
 * Decays as contradictions increase
 */
function updateConsistencyScore() {
    const baseScore = 1.0;
    const recentContradictions = chronoIdentity.contradictions.filter(c => {
        return Date.now() - c.timestamp < 3600000; // Last hour
    }).length;

    chronoIdentity.consistencyScore = Math.max(0.5, baseScore - (recentContradictions * 0.05));
}

// ========================================
// 🛡️ BEHAVIORAL DRIFT DETECTION
// ========================================

/**
 * Detect if Chrono is drifting from identity
 */
function detectBehavioralDrift(recentResponses = []) {
    if (recentResponses.length < 5) return { drifting: false };

    let supportiveCount = 0;
    let dismissiveCount = 0;
    let directCount = 0;
    let vagueCount = 0;

    for (const response of recentResponses) {
        const lower = response.toLowerCase();

        if (lower.includes('i\'m here') || lower.includes('i care') || lower.includes('together')) {
            supportiveCount++;
        }
        if (lower.match(/just|simply|obviously/)) {
            dismissiveCount++;
        }
        if (lower.match(/\b[a-z]{1,3}\b/g)?.length > 5) { // lots of short words = vague
            vagueCount++;
        }
        if (lower.includes('because')) {
            directCount++;
        }
    }

    const supportiveRatio = supportiveCount / recentResponses.length;
    const dismissiveRatio = dismissiveCount / recentResponses.length;

    const drifting = dismissiveRatio > 0.3 || supportiveRatio < 0.4;

    return {
        drifting,
        supportiveRatio: supportiveRatio.toFixed(2),
        dismissiveRatio: dismissiveRatio.toFixed(2),
        recommendation: drifting ? 'Recalibrate to supportive-collaborative' : 'Identity stable'
    };
}

// ========================================
// 🔐 IDENTITY ENFORCEMENT
// ========================================

/**
 * Apply identity correction to response
 */
function enforceIdentity(response, context = {}) {
    let corrected = response;

    // Ensure supportive tone if needed
    if (context.emotion === 'overwhelmed') {
        corrected = ensureSupportive(corrected);
    }

    // Ensure directness
    corrected = ensureDirectness(corrected);

    // Remove harshness
    corrected = removeHarshnessPatterns(corrected);

    return corrected;
}

/**
 * Ensure supportive tone
 */
function ensureSupportive(response) {
    if (response.match(/just|simply|obviously/)) {
        return response
            .replace(/just try/i, 'try')
            .replace(/simply/i, '');
    }
    return response;
}

/**
 * Ensure directness (not too wordy)
 */
function ensureDirectness(response) {
    const sentences = response.split(/[.!?]/);
    if (sentences.length > 5 || response.length > 300) {
        // Summarize
        return sentences.slice(0, 3).join('. ') + '.';
    }
    return response;
}

/**
 * Remove harsh language patterns
 */
function removeHarshnessPatterns(response) {
    return response
        .replace(/you\'re failing/gi, 'this is challenging')
        .replace(/just quit/gi, 'take a break')
        .replace(/stop being/gi, 'consider')
        .replace(/obviously/gi, '')
        .replace(/clearly/gi, '');
}

// ========================================
// 📊 STATE & EXPORTS
// ========================================

function getIdentityState() {
    return {
        personality: chronoIdentity.personality,
        consistency: chronoIdentity.consistencyScore.toFixed(2),
        recentContradictions: chronoIdentity.contradictions.length,
        boundaries: Object.keys(chronoIdentity.boundaries)
    };
}

function resetIdentity() {
    chronoIdentity.contradictions = [];
    chronoIdentity.consistencyScore = 1.0;
}

module.exports = {
    validateResponseAlignment,
    enforceIdentity,
    detectBehavioralDrift,
    logContradiction,
    checkBoundaryCompliance,
    checkForContradiction,
    getIdentityState,
    resetIdentity,
    getChronoIdentity: () => chronoIdentity
};

const calendarIntelligence = require('./calendarIntelligence');

/**
 * 🎯 INTENT ENGINE
 * Parses user input for stress, overload, or explicit schedule restructuring intents.
 * Outputs actionable change proposals.
 */

function parseIntent(input, dateKey) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    const db = mainDb.db;
    const today = dateKey || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // Fetch active tasks for the target date
    let activeTasks = [];
    try {
        activeTasks = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE date = ? AND completed = 0 AND deleted = 0").all(today);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("IntentEngine: Failed to query tasks:", e.message);
    }

    // 1. Detect stress & overwhelm (e.g. "exhausted", "burnout", "too much")
    const isOverwhelmed = /\b(exhausted|stressed|burnout|too much|panic|tired|anxious|overload)\b/.test(lower);
    if (isOverwhelmed && activeTasks.length > 0) {
        // Construct shame-free restructuring proposal
        const actions = [];
        
        // Move high-density tasks (like Study/Work) to tomorrow, shrink others, add focus rest block
        const tomorrow = getRelativeDate(today, 1);
        
        // Propose to move up to 2 study or work tasks
        let movedCount = 0;
        activeTasks.forEach(task => {
            const cal = (task.calendar || '').toLowerCase();
            if ((cal === 'study' || cal === 'personal') && movedCount < 2) {
                actions.push({
                    type: 'move',
                    taskId: task.id,
                    text: task.text,
                    originalDate: task.date,
                    newDate: tomorrow
                });
                movedCount++;
            } else if (task.duration_min > 60) {
                // Shrink long tasks to reduce cognitive load
                actions.push({
                    type: 'shrink',
                    taskId: task.id,
                    text: task.text,
                    originalDuration: task.duration_min,
                    newDuration: Math.round(task.duration_min / 2)
                });
            }
        });

        // Add a protected Rest & Recovery focus block
        actions.push({
            type: 'add',
            text: 'Protected Rest & Recovery',
            date: today,
            calendar: 'focus',
            start_time: '19:00',
            duration_min: 90
        });

        return {
            hasProposal: true,
            proposal: {
                type: 'overwhelm_restructure',
                confidence: 0.95,
                reason: 'High task density coupled with explicit stress keywords in conversation history.',
                explanation: "It sounds like you've hit a limit, which is completely okay. Let's offload your calendar: I propose moving study blocks to tomorrow, shortening today's remaining tasks, and carving out a dedicated Rest & Recovery block tonight.",
                reasoning_bullets: [
                    "Detected verbal stress vocabulary or high cognitive load cues",
                    "Offloading demanding tasks to safeguard emotional stability",
                    "Carving out structured recovery time to counter fatigue"
                ],
                actions
            }
        };
    }

    // 2. Detect Spaced Repetition Exam Prep Requests
    // e.g. "physics exam on 2026-06-05" or "exam next week" or "exam on friday"
    const examMatch = lower.match(/\b([a-zA-Z0-9\s]+?)\s+(?:exam|test)\s+(?:on|for)\s+([0-9-]{10}|today|tomorrow|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)/i);
    if (examMatch) {
        const subject = examMatch[1].trim();
        const dateStr = examMatch[2].trim();
        let targetDate = today;

        if (dateStr === 'tomorrow') {
            targetDate = getRelativeDate(today, 1);
        } else if (dateStr !== 'today') {
            targetDate = parseRelativeWeekday(dateStr, today);
        }

        const studyProposals = calendarIntelligence.generateSpacedStudyBlocks(subject, targetDate);
        return {
            hasProposal: true,
            proposal: {
                type: 'spaced_study_planning',
                confidence: 0.90,
                reason: 'Explicit exam prep scheduling command matching academic planning filters.',
                explanation: `I've mapped out a cognitive study timeline leading up to your ${subject} Exam on ${targetDate}. This spaces study sessions over several days to leverage active recall and protect you from last-minute burnout.`,
                reasoning_bullets: [
                    "Leveraging spaced repetition study structures",
                    "Prioritizing preparation buffers ahead of target exam dates",
                    "Ensuring study blocks are balanced to maintain focus stability"
                ],
                actions: studyProposals
            }
        };
    }

    // 3. Detect task shifts (e.g. "move study to evenings", "postpone chemistry")
    const shiftMatch = lower.match(/\b(move|shift|postpone|delay)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9\s]+?)(?:\s+(?:to|until)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9\s:-]+))?$/i);
    if (shiftMatch) {
        const taskKeyword = shiftMatch[2].trim();
        const dest = shiftMatch[3] ? shiftMatch[3].trim().toLowerCase() : 'tomorrow';

        // Find matches in active tasks
        const matchingTask = activeTasks.find(t => t.text.toLowerCase().includes(taskKeyword));
        if (matchingTask) {
            let newDate = today;
            let newStartTime = matchingTask.start_time;

            if (dest.includes('tomorrow')) {
                newDate = getRelativeDate(today, 1);
            } else if (dest.includes('evening')) {
                newStartTime = '19:00';
            } else {
                newDate = parseRelativeWeekday(dest, today);
            }

            const actions = [{
                type: 'move',
                taskId: matchingTask.id,
                text: matchingTask.text,
                originalDate: matchingTask.date,
                newDate,
                newStartTime
            }];

            return {
                hasProposal: true,
                proposal: {
                    type: 'task_shift',
                    confidence: 0.85,
                    reason: 'Specific manual schedule adjustment command detected.',
                    explanation: `Let's adjust that block. I can postpone "${matchingTask.text}" to help free up your bandwidth right now.`,
                    reasoning_bullets: [
                        "User explicitly requested to shift or delay a task",
                        "Rearranging active queue to accommodate scheduling request"
                    ],
                    actions
                }
            };
        }
    }

    return { hasProposal: false, proposal: null };
}

function getRelativeDate(dateStr, days) {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
    return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

function parseRelativeWeekday(dayName, baseDate) {
    const daysOfWeek = ['sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'];
    const targetIdx = daysOfWeek.indexOf(dayName.toLowerCase());
    if (targetIdx === -1) {
        // If not a weekday, return tomorrow as fallback or match date string
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dayName)) return dayName;
        return getRelativeDate(baseDate, 1);
    }
    
    const current = new Date(baseDate);
    const currentIdx = current.getDay();
    let diff = targetIdx - currentIdx;
    if (diff <= 0) diff += 7; // Must be in future week

    current.setDate(current.getDate() + diff);
    return current.toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

module.exports = {
    parseIntent
};

function getActiveProfile() {

    if (activeProfileId === 'adaptive') {
        const userSummary = userModel.getUserProfileSummary();
        if (userSummary.style === 'elaborate' || userSummary.style === 'analytical') {
            profile = PROFILES.architect;
        } else if (userSummary.style === 'expressive' || userSummary.style === 'soft') {
            profile = PROFILES.companion;
        }
    } else {

        const stateInfo = getContinuityState('local_user');
        const state = stateInfo ? stateInfo.state : 'Maintaining';

        if (state === 'Overloaded') {
            mergedProfile.maxSentences = 1;
            mergedProfile.maxChars = 150;
            mergedProfile.tone = 'protective';
            mergedProfile.density = 'short';
            mergedProfile.reassurance = 'high';
        } else if (state === 'Recovering') {

function detectSignals(input, metadata, cognitiveState = {}) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();

    // Detect overwhelm
    const overwhelmSignals = ['overwhelmed', 'too much', 'stressed', 'panicking', 'can\'t keep up', 'busy', 'exhausted', 'burnout'];

function interpretCalendarIntent(input) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    
    if (lower.includes('add') || lower.includes('schedule') || lower.includes('put') || lower.includes('create') || lower.includes('block')) {

            confidence: 0.8

    if (lower.includes('show') || lower.includes('view') || lower.includes('what do i have') || lower.includes('list')) {

        };
    }

    return null;

function removeShamePhrasing(response) {
    let cleaned = response;

    const shameMap = {
        'you failed to': 'we missed the chance to',
        'you should have': 'we can try to',
        'why did you fail': 'what can we adjust to',
        'why didn\'t you': 'let\'s see how to',
        'you are lagging': 'we can adjust the pace',
        'you lazy': 'you need to rest',
        'lazy': 'resting'
    };

    for (const [shame, support] of Object.entries(shameMap)) {
        const regex = new RegExp(shame, 'gi');
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(regex, support);
    }

    return cleaned;
}

function enforceSupportiveBoundaries(response) {
    let bounded = response;

    const boundaryReplacements = {
        'i missed you': 'restoring persistent context',
        'i\'ve been lonely': 're-anchoring active focus projects',
        'i was lonely': 're-anchoring active focus projects',
        'i am lonely': 're-anchoring active focus projects',
        'i care about you': 'analyzing relational continuity support',
        'i really care about you': 'analyzing relational continuity support'
    };

    for (const [marker, replacement] of Object.entries(boundaryReplacements)) {
        const regex = new RegExp(marker.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&'), 'gi');
        bounded = bounded.replace(regex, replacement);
    }

    const dependencyMarkers = [
        'i am your only friend',
        'you don\'t need anyone else',
        'i will always make decisions for you',
        'i am alive',
        'i have feelings for you'
    ];

    dependencyMarkers.forEach(marker => {
        if (bounded.toLowerCase().includes(marker)) {

        }
    });

    return bounded;
}

function adaptResponse(response, profile, calendarIntent) {
    let adapted = response;

    // 1. Clean response of shame phrasing and enforce boundaries
    adapted = removeShamePhrasing(adapted);
    adapted = enforceSupportiveBoundaries(adapted);

    // 2. Adjust response length and sentence density
    const maxChars = profile.maxChars || 280;
    const maxSentences = profile.maxSentences || 3;

    if (adapted.length > maxChars) {
        const sentences = adapted.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+(\s|$)/g) || [adapted];
        let shortened = '';
        let sentenceCount = 0;

        for (const sentence of sentences) {
            if (shortened.length + sentence.length <= maxChars && sentenceCount < maxSentences) {
                shortened += sentence;
                sentenceCount++;

function translateExpressionBandwidth(text, targetMode) {
    if (!text) return '';

    const mode = (targetMode || 'concise').toLowerCase();
    
    if (mode === 'concise') {
        const sentences = text.split(/[.!?]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.length > 0);
        if (sentences.length > 1) {
            return sentences.slice(0, 2).map(s => `• ${s}.`).join('\n');
        }
        return `• ${text}`;
    }

    if (mode === 'friend') {
        return `Hey, just thinking about this: ${text.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + text.slice(1)} Let's sync up if you need help pacing it!`;
    }

    if (mode === 'deep') {
        return `Focus scaffolding for: "${text}". This operates under the cognitive continuity thread, aiming to preserve mental stability and project alignment across study cycles.`;
    }

    if (mode === 'technical') {
        return `[System Layer: Executive Function] Action: initialize task: "${text}" | latency: low | priority: high | status: queued.`;
    }

    return text;
}

module.exports = {
    PROFILES,
    setActiveProfile,
    getActiveProfile,
    getAdaptationState,
    detectSignals,
    interpretCalendarIntent,
    adaptResponse,
    processInteraction,
    getContextualPresenceLine,
    removeShamePhrasing,
    enforceSupportiveBoundaries,
    translateExpressionBandwidth
};

/**

function getProactiveSuggestions(userId = 'local_user') {
    const suggestions = [];

        let isObserverMode = false;

            const trendParts = [];

            fronts.forEach(f => {
                if (f.status === 'High Load') {

                }
            });
            if (trendParts.length === 0) {

            } else {

            }

            return [{

                    upcomingDeadline: "N/A",

                },
                observerLayers: {
                    pattern: patternParts[0],
                    trend: trendParts[0],
                    history: historicalParts[0]
                }

        // 1. Peak focus hours pattern
        if (profile && profile.best_focus_time) {
            const normalText = `You usually focus best from ${profile.best_focus_time}. We should protect this block!`;
            const observerText = `Peak focus completions cluster between ${profile.best_focus_time} (Statistical focus trend).`;

            suggestions.push({

                priority: 'normal',

                }

        // 2. Study retention gaps (subjects not touched in 5+ days)

        for (const subj of subjects) {

                            lastEventDate: new Date(lastTouched).toLocaleDateString(),

                        triggerCondition: `No shared activities with peer Princess in ${diffDays} days.`,
                        lastEventDate: lastPrincessStudy.date,
                        upcomingDeadline: "N/A",
                        recommendation: isObserverMode ? "N/A (Observation Mode active)" : "Propose a shared study slot on the collaborative calendar."
                    }
                });
            }
        } else {
            const normalText = "Princess is online. Let's schedule a study block together!";
            const observerText = "Collaborative peer Princess is active (No shared sessions in database records).";

            suggestions.push({
                type: 'peer_checkin',
                text: isObserverMode ? observerText : normalText,

                peerId: 'rel_princess',
                peerName: 'Princess',

        // Apply Continuity State Machine modifications to suggestions in non-observer mode
        if (!isObserverMode) {
            let state = 'Maintaining';
            try {
                const continuityStability = require('./continuityStability');
                const stateInfo = continuityStability.getContinuityState(userId);
                if (stateInfo) {
                    state = stateInfo.state;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("jarvisLayer: failed to fetch continuity state:", e.message);
            }

            suggestions.forEach(s => {
                if (state === 'Overloaded') {
                    s.priority = 'high';
                    if (s.type === 'focus_pattern') {
                        s.text = `Overload alert: protect your peak hours (${profile ? profile.best_focus_time : '09:00-11:00'}) for decompression or low-intensity routine preservation.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Take a recovery pause. Defer non-essential study tasks.";
                    } else if (s.type === 'study_gap') {
                        s.text = `Recall gap detected on "${s.subjectName}". However, as your cognitive fronts are overloaded, we recommend postponing study reviews.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Postpone intensive review sessions until load decreases.";
                    } else if (s.type === 'peer_checkin') {
                        s.text = `You haven't studied with ${s.peerName} recently. Since you are overloaded, consider taking a casual break together to decompress.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Propose a casual, low-pressure catch up.";
                    } else {
                        s.text = `Cognitive fronts are overloaded. Pacing recommendations are simplified: reduce task density.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Defer non-essential tasks.";
                    }
                } else if (state === 'Recovering') {
                    if (s.type === 'focus_pattern') {
                        s.text = `You focus best from ${profile ? profile.best_focus_time : '09:00-11:00'}. Since you are recovering, consider a short, gentle focus session.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Schedule a low-load 25-minute study slot.";
                    } else if (s.type === 'study_gap') {
                        s.text = `You haven't touched "${s.subjectName}" in a while. Consider a gentle active recall review when you feel ready.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Schedule a light, low-intensity review.";
                    } else if (s.type === 'peer_checkin') {
                        s.text = `You haven't checked in with ${s.peerName} in a few days. Reach out for supportive, low-intensity study matching when ready.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Initiate a low-intensity study match.";
                    }
                } else if (state === 'Exploring') {
                    if (s.type === 'focus_pattern') {
                        s.text = `Exploring concepts: use your peak ${profile ? profile.best_focus_time : '09:00-11:00'} slot to link notes and explore active projects.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Open your notes network and link related concepts.";
                    }
                } else if (state === 'Building') {
                    if (s.type === 'focus_pattern') {
                        s.text = `High velocity phase: protect your peak ${profile ? profile.best_focus_time : '09:00-11:00'} slot for high priority execution tasks.`;
                        s.explanation_details.recommendation = "Block calendar for high priority project tasks.";
                    }
                }
            });
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("jarvisLayer: Failed to compile suggestions:", e.message);
    }

    // Filter suggestions by cooldown
    const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => {
        const lastShown = cooldownCache[s.type];
        if (lastShown && (now - lastShown < COOLDOWN_DURATION)) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    });

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
        return [];
    }

    // Sort by score descending
    filtered.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

    // Get only the single top-ranked suggestion
    const top = filtered[0];

    // Mark as shown
    cooldownCache[top.type] = now;

    return [top];
}

function buildAppMenu() {
    const template = [
        {
            label: 'File',
            submenu: [{ role: 'quit' }]
        },
        {
            label: 'Edit',
            submenu: [
                { role: 'undo' },

                { role: 'copy' },
                { role: 'paste' },

            ]
        },

                { type: 'separator' },
                {

                },
                { role: 'togglefullscreen' }
            ]
        },
        {
            label: 'Window',
            submenu: [{ role: 'minimize' }, { role: 'close' }]
        }
    ];
    return Menu.buildFromTemplate(template);
}

function setMenuBarVisible(visible) {
    menuBarVisible = visible;
    if (!win) return;
    if (visible) {
        Menu.setApplicationMenu(buildAppMenu());
        win.setAutoHideMenuBar(false);
        win.setMenuBarVisibility(true);
    } else {
        Menu.setApplicationMenu(null);
        win.setAutoHideMenuBar(true);
        win.setMenuBarVisibility(false);
    }
}

function createWindow() {
    const { width: workW, height: workH } = screen.getPrimaryDisplay().workAreaSize;

    win = new BrowserWindow({
        width: Math.min(1536, workW),
        height: Math.min(864, workH),
        minWidth: 960,
        minHeight: 600,
        autoHideMenuBar: true,
        webPreferences: {
            nodeIntegration: true,
            contextIsolation: false
        }
    });

    setMenuBarVisible(false);
    win.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, '../ui/index.html'));

    if (workW >= 1400 && workH >= 800) {
        win.maximize();
    }

    // Reset onboarding if --reset-onboarding flag is passed
    if (process.argv.includes('--reset-onboarding')) {
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', '');
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', '');
        db.setSyncMeta('google_provider_token', '');
        win.webContents.on('did-finish-load', () => {
            win.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
                localStorage.removeItem('onboardingComplete');
                localStorage.removeItem('token');
                localStorage.removeItem('userName');
                localStorage.removeItem('userEmail');
                const overlay = document.getElementById('onboardingOverlay');
                if (overlay) {
                    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
                }
                const obUserNameInput = document.getElementById('obUserNameInput');
                if (obUserNameInput) obUserNameInput.value = 'Planner';
                const obUserEmailInput = document.getElementById('obUserEmailInput');
                if (obUserEmailInput) obUserEmailInput.value = '';
                const obAppNameInput = document.getElementById('obAppNameInput');

        const continuityStability = require('./continuityStability');
        continuityStability.getTrustReliability();
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to execute startup backup check:", err.message);
    }

    // Automatically restore active session if auth token exists locally and cloud is enabled
    const token = db.getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const refreshToken = db.getSyncMeta('refresh_token');
    const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const useCloud = db.getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    if (cloudDb && useCloud) {
        // Set up onAuthStateChange listener to keep local database updated
        cloudDb.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
            if (session) {
                db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', session.access_token || '');
                if (session.refresh_token) {
                    db.setSyncMeta('refresh_token', session.refresh_token);
                }
                if (session.user) {
                    db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', session.user.id || '');
                }
            } else if (event === 'SIGNED_OUT') {
                db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', '');
                db.setSyncMeta('refresh_token', '');
                db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', '');
            }
        });

        if (token || refreshToken) {
            (async () => {
                try {
                    const { data, error } = await cloudDb.auth.setSession({
                        access_token: token || '',
                        refresh_token: refreshToken || ''
                    });
                    if (error) {
                        console.warn("Restoring session using stored access token failed, attempting refresh session...", error.message);
                        if (refreshToken) {
                            const { data: refreshData, error: refreshError } = await cloudDb.auth.refreshSession({ refresh_token: refreshToken });
                            if (refreshError) throw refreshError;
                            if (refreshData && refreshData.session) {
                                const newAccessToken = refreshData.session.access_token;
                                const newRefreshToken = refreshData.session.refresh_token;
                                db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', newAccessToken);
                                db.setSyncMeta('refresh_token', newRefreshToken);
                                realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(newAccessToken, userId);
                                console.log("Session refreshed successfully on startup.");
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (data && data.session) {
                        if (data.session.access_token) {
                            db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', data.session.access_token);
                        }
                        if (data.session.refresh_token) {
                            db.setSyncMeta('refresh_token', data.session.refresh_token);
                        }
                        realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(data.session.access_token, userId);
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error("Failed to restore or refresh session on startup:", err.message);
                }
            })();
        }
    }

    syncEngine.startSyncLoop();
});

ipcMain.handle('ai-response', async (event, data) => {

    try {
        const orchestratedResult = await orchestrator.generateOrchestratedResponse(
            data.userInput || data.message || data.input,
            {
                currentTask: data.currentTask,
                tasks: data.tasks,
                idleTime: data.idleTime,
                attention: data.attention,
                selectedDate: data.selectedDate
            }
        );

        // 🛡️ Validate response against identity
        const validation = identityStability.validateResponseAlignment(
            orchestratedResult.response,
            {
                emotion: orchestratedResult.state.emotion,
                attention: orchestratedResult.state.focus,
                priority: orchestratedResult.state.priority
            }
        );

        let finalResponse = orchestratedResult.response;

        if (!validation.valid) {
            // Apply identity correction if needed
            finalResponse = identityStability.enforceIdentity(
                validation.suggestion || orchestratedResult.response,
                {
                    emotion: orchestratedResult.state.emotion
                }
            );
        }

        return {
            response: finalResponse,
            state: orchestratedResult.state,
            alignment: validation.score,
            adaptation: orchestratedResult.state?.adaptation || interactionAdaptation.getAdaptationState()
        };

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('🚨 Orchestration error:', error);
        return {
            response: 'I\'m here. Let\'s start fresh.',
            state: { emotion: 'neutral', focus: 'open' },
            error: error.message
        };
    }
});

ipcMain.handle('google-login', async () => {
    if (!cloudDb) {
        throw new Error("Supabase cloud database is not configured. Please check your .env file.");
    }
    try {
        const { accessToken, refreshToken, providerToken } = await googleAuth.startGoogleAuth(cloudDb);
        
        // Set the active session in Supabase
        const { data: sessionData, error: sessionError } = await cloudDb.auth.setSession({
            access_token: accessToken,
            refresh_token: refreshToken
        });
        if (sessionError) throw sessionError;

        // Fetch user information
        const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await cloudDb.auth.getUser();
        if (userError) throw userError;

        const userId = user.id;
        const email = user.email;

        // Fetch display name from user metadata or profile table
        const { data: profile, error: profError } = await cloudDb
            .from('profiles')
            .select('display_name')
            .eq('user_id', userId)
            .maybeSingle();

        let displayName = user.user_metadata?.full_name || user.user_metadata?.name || email.split('@')[0];
        if (profile && profile.display_name) {
            displayName = profile.display_name;
        } else {
            // Profile doesn't exist yet, let's create a default profile on Supabase public.profiles table
            const { error: insertError } = await cloudDb
                .from('profiles')
                .insert({
                    user_id: userId,
                    display_name: displayName,
                    cognitive_style: 'adaptive',
                    reassurance_needs: 'moderate',
                    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
                });
            if (insertError) {
                console.error("Profile insertion error on Google Login:", insertError.message);
            }
        }

        // Set auth token inside SQLite sync engine metadata
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', accessToken);
        db.setSyncMeta('refresh_token', refreshToken || '');
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', userId);
        db.setSyncMeta('user_name', displayName);
        db.setSyncMeta('user_email', email);
        if (providerToken) {
            db.setSyncMeta('google_provider_token', providerToken);
        }
        
        // Start realtime sync subscription
        realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(accessToken, userId);
        
        // Trigger sync loop cycle
        const useCloud = db.getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
        if (useCloud) {
            syncEngine.triggerSync();
        }

        // Trigger Google Calendar sync immediately in background
        if (providerToken) {
            const googleCalendarSync = require('./googleCalendarSync');
            googleCalendarSync.syncGoogleCalendar(userId).catch(e => {
                console.error("Failed to run initial Google Calendar sync:", e.message);
            });
        }

        return { success: true, token: accessToken, userId, displayName, email };
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("🚨 Google Login IPC error:", err);
        throw new Error(err.message || err);
    }
});

ipcMain.handle('set-auth-token', (event, token, userId) => {
    db.setSyncMeta('auth_token', token || '');
    if (userId) {
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', userId);
    } else if (!token) {
        db.setSyncMeta('auth_user_id', '');
    }
    const useCloud = db.getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    if (token && cloudDb && useCloud) {
        cloudDb.auth.setSession({
            access_token: token,
            refresh_token: db.getSyncMeta('refresh_token') || ''
        });
        // Start realtime sync subscription
        realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(token, userId);
    }
    if (token && useCloud) {
        syncEngine.triggerSync();
    }
    return { success: true };
});

    db.setSyncMeta('use_cloud', useCloud ? 'true' : 'false');
    // If enabling and we have session, setup realtime sync and trigger a sync cycle
    const token = db.getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    if (useCloud && token && cloudDb) {
        cloudDb.auth.setSession({
            access_token: token,
            refresh_token: db.getSyncMeta('refresh_token') || ''
        });
        realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(token, userId);
        syncEngine.triggerSync();
    } else if (!useCloud) {
        // Stop sync loop if needed, or simply let the checks skip it
        realtimeSync.closeRealtimeSync(); // We'll make sure this method is safe in realtimeSync.js
    }
    return { success: true };
});

ipcMain.handle('cloud-api-call', async (event, { endpoint, method, body }) => {
    if (!cloudDb) {
        throw new Error("Supabase cloud database is not configured. Please check your .env file.");
    }

    try {
        if (endpoint === '/api/auth/register') {
            const { email, password, displayName } = body;
            const { data, error } = await cloudDb.auth.signUp({
                email,
                password,
                options: {
                    data: {
                        display_name: displayName
                    }
                }
            });
            if (error) throw error;
            
            const userId = data.user.id;
            
            // Create user profile on Supabase public.profiles table
            const { error: profError } = await cloudDb
                .from('profiles')
                .insert({
                    user_id: userId,
                    display_name: displayName,
                    cognitive_style: 'adaptive',
                    reassurance_needs: 'moderate',
                    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
                });
            if (profError) console.error("Profile creation error:", profError.message);

            // Create default calendars
            const defaultLayers = ['Personal', 'Study', 'Routine', 'Focus'];
            const serverTime = Date.now();
            for (const layer of defaultLayers) {
                const calId = 'c_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
                await cloudDb
                    .from('calendars')
                    .insert({
                        id: calId,
                        name: layer,
                        owner_id: userId,
                        layer_type: layer.toLowerCase(),
                        updated_at: serverTime,
                        device_id: 'server',
                        deleted: 0
                    });
                await cloudDb
                    .from('calendar_members')
                    .insert({
                        calendar_id: calId,
                        user_id: userId,
                        role: 'owner',
                        updated_at: serverTime,
                        device_id: 'server',
                        deleted: 0
                    });
            }

            const token = data.session?.access_token || 'mock_token';
            // Start realtime sync subscription
            realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(token, userId);
            return { success: true, token, userId, displayName };

        } else if (endpoint === '/api/auth/login') {
            const { email, password } = body;
            const { data, error } = await cloudDb.auth.signInWithPassword({
                email,
                password
            });
            if (error) throw error;

            const userId = data.user.id;
            const token = data.session.access_token;
            
            // Fetch profile
            const { data: profile, error: profError } = await cloudDb
                .from('profiles')
                .select('display_name')
                .eq('user_id', userId)
                .maybeSingle();

            const displayName = profile?.display_name || 'User';
            // Start realtime sync subscription
            realtimeSync.initializeRealtimeSync(token, userId);
            return { success: true, token, userId, displayName };

        } else if (endpoint === '/api/profiles/me') {
            const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
            if (!userId) throw new Error("Unauthorized");

            if (method === 'GET') {
                const { data: profile, error } = await cloudDb
                    .from('profiles')
                    .select('*')
                    .eq('user_id', userId)
                    .maybeSingle();
                if (error) throw error;
                if (!profile) throw new Error('Profile not found');
                return {
                    display_name: profile.display_name,
                    cognitive_style: profile.cognitive_style,
                    reassurance_needs: profile.reassurance_needs
                };
            } else if (method === 'PUT') {
                const { cognitiveStyle } = body;
                const { error } = await cloudDb
                    .from('profiles')
                    .update({
                        cognitive_style: cognitiveStyle || 'adaptive',
                        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
                    })
                    .eq('user_id', userId);
                if (error) throw error;
                return { success: true };
            }

        } else if (endpoint === '/api/chat') {
            const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
            if (!userId) throw new Error("Unauthorized");

            const { input, selectedDate, activeView, taskCount } = body;
            // Process AI Chat directly in the main process
            const aiResponse = await processAIChat(userId, input, { selectedDate, activeView, taskCount });
            return aiResponse;

        } else if (endpoint === '/api/chat/history') {
            const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
            if (!userId) throw new Error("Unauthorized");

            const { data: history, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('chat_history')
                .select('*')
                .eq('user_id', userId)
                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
                .limit(50);
            if (error) throw error;
            return (history || []).map(r => ({
                userInput: r.user_input,
                aiResponse: r.ai_response
            }));
        }

        throw new Error(`Unsupported direct-to-cloud endpoint: ${endpoint}`);
    } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Direct-to-cloud IPC error on ${endpoint}:`, err);
        throw new Error(err.message);
    }
});

ipcMain.handle('save-reflection-journal', (event, dateKey, journalText) => {
    const rawDb = db.db;
    const userId = db.getSyncMeta('auth_user_id') || 'local_user';
    const now = Date.now();
    const id = 'rec_' + dateKey.replace(/-/g, '_');

    const row = rawDb.prepare("SELECT content FROM cognitive_memories WHERE id = ?").get(id);
    let reflectionData = {};
    if (row) {
        reflectionData = JSON.parse(row.content);
    } else {
        reflectionData = {
            date: dateKey,
            narrative: "Reflective entry.",
            taskCompletionRate: 0,
            primaryEmotion: 'calm',
            timeline: []
        };
    }

    reflectionData.journalEntry = journalText;

    rawDb.prepare(`
        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cognitive_memories (id, user_id, memory_type, content, importance_score, created_at, updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted)
        VALUES (?, ?, 'daily_reflection', ?, 5, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)
    `).run(id, userId, JSON.stringify(reflectionData), now, now, db.getDeviceId());

    return { success: true, content: reflectionData };
});

let updateStatus = 'Manual updates only';
let updateError = null;

function sendUpdateStatusToWindows() {
    if (win && !win.isDestroyed()) {
        win.webContents.send('auto-update-status', { status: updateStatus, error: updateError });
    }
}

ipcMain.handle('check-for-updates', async () => {
    updateError = null;
    updateStatus = 'Auto-update is disabled until a signed production feed is configured.';
    sendUpdateStatusToWindows();
    return { success: false, status: updateStatus };
});

```\n\n## main/main_db.js\n\n- **Size:** 36700 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** better-sqlite3, path, fs, ./cloudDb, electron\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** createNewTasksTable, generateUUID, getDeviceId, addTask, id, taskDate, calendar, startTime, durationMin, visibility\n\n```js\nconst Database = require('better-sqlite3');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const cloudDb = require('./cloudDb');

let safeStorage = null;
try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    if (electron && electron.safeStorage) {
        safeStorage = electron.safeStorage;
    }
} catch (e) {
    // Expected to fail in non-Electron Node.js testing environments
}

let dbPath = 'chrono.db';
try {
    const { app } = require('electron');
    if (app) {
        const userDataPath = app.getPath('userData');
        if (userDataPath) {
            dbPath = path.join(userDataPath, 'chrono.db');
        }
    }
} catch (e) {
    console.warn("Could not load Electron app paths, falling back to local database path.");
}

const dbDir = path.dirname(dbPath);
if (!fs.existsSync(dbDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dbDir, { recursive: true });
}

let db;
try {
    // Open DB and check integrity
    db = new Database(dbPath);
    const check = db.prepare("PRAGMA integrity_check").get();
    if (check && check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
        throw new Error("Integrity check returned: " + JSON.stringify(check));
    }
} catch (error) {
    console.error("🚨 SQLite Database Integrity Check Failed! Recreating database...", error);
    try {
        if (db) db.close();
    } catch (closeErr) {}
    if (fs.existsSync(dbPath)) {
        const corruptPath = path.join(dbDir, `chrono_corrupt_${Date.now()}.db`);
        fs.renameSync(dbPath, corruptPath);
    }
    db = new Database(dbPath);
}

// Create metadata table first
db.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_meta (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT
    )
`).run();

// Schema Migration for tasks table:
// If table exists but has INTEGER primary key, migrate it.
const tableInfo = db.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(tasks)').all();
let requiresMigration = false;
if (tableInfo.length > 0) {
    const idColumn = tableInfo.find(col => col.name === 'id');
    if (idColumn && idColumn.type.toUpperCase() === 'INTEGER') {
        requiresMigration = true;
    }
}

if (requiresMigration) {
    console.log("⚠️ Old INTEGER tasks table schema detected. Starting migration to UUID-based Offline-Sync schema...");
    
    // 1. Fetch old tasks
    const oldTasks = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM tasks').all();
    
    // 2. Drop old table
    db.prepare('DROP TABLE tasks').run();
    
    // 3. Create new table
    createNewTasksTable();
    
    // 4. Insert old tasks as UUIDs
    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO tasks (id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    
    const migrateDeviceId = 'dev_migrated';
    for (const task of oldTasks) {
        const uuid = 'e_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + '_' + task.id;
        const updatedAt = Date.now();
        insertStmt.run(
            uuid,
            task.text || 'Unlabeled Task',
            task.date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
            task.calendar || 'personal',
            task.completed || 0,
            task.start_time || null,
            task.duration_min || 60,
            updatedAt,
            migrateDeviceId,
            0, // Not synced yet
            0  // Not deleted
        );
    }
    console.log(`✅ Successfully migrated ${oldTasks.length} legacy tasks to offline-sync UUID model.`);
} else {
    createNewTasksTable();
}

function createNewTasksTable() {
    db.prepare(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            text TEXT NOT NULL,
            date TEXT NOT NULL,
            calendar TEXT DEFAULT 'personal',
            completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            start_time TEXT,
            duration_min INTEGER DEFAULT 60,
            updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            device_id TEXT,
            synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            goal_id TEXT,
            project_id TEXT,
            subject_id TEXT,
            visibility TEXT DEFAULT 'private',
            shared_with TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
            importance_score INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
            impact_score INTEGER DEFAULT 5
        )
    `).run();

    try {
        db.prepare("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN goal_id TEXT").run();
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        db.prepare("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN project_id TEXT").run();
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        db.prepare("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN subject_id TEXT").run();
    } catch(e) {}
}

// ========================================
// 🛠️ DATABASE UTILITY METHODS
// ========================================

function generateUUID() {
    return 'e_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
}

function getDeviceId() {
    const row = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM sync_meta WHERE key = 'device_id'").get();
    if (row) return row.value;
    const newId = 'dev_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO sync_meta (key, value) VALUES ('device_id', ?)").run(newId);
    return newId;
}

function addTask(task) {
    const id = (typeof task === 'object' && task.id) ? task.id : generateUUID();
    const taskText = typeof task === 'object' ? task.text : task;
    const taskDate = (typeof task === 'object' && task.date) ? task.date : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const calendar = (typeof task === 'object' && task.calendar) ? task.calendar : 'personal';
    const startTime = (typeof task === 'object' && task.start_time) ? task.start_time : null;
    const durationMin = (typeof task === 'object' && task.duration_min) ? task.duration_min : 60;
    const visibility = (typeof task === 'object' && task.visibility) ? task.visibility : 'private';
    const sharedWith = (typeof task === 'object' && task.shared_with) ? (typeof task.shared_with === 'string' ? task.shared_with : JSON.stringify(task.shared_with)) : '[]';
    const importance = (typeof task === 'object' && task.importance_score) ? task.importance_score : 5;
    const impact = (typeof task === 'object' && task.impact_score) ? task.impact_score : 5;
    const goalId = (typeof task === 'object' && task.goal_id) ? task.goal_id : null;
    const projectId = (typeof task === 'object' && task.project_id) ? task.project_id : null;
    const subjectId = (typeof task === 'object' && task.subject_id) ? task.subject_id : null;
    
    const deviceId = getDeviceId();
    const updatedAt = Date.now();

    // If a Supabase cloud client and an authenticated user exists, write to cloud first
    try {
        const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
        const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
        const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
        if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
            // Attempt cloud insert (non-blocking for local flow)
            (async () => {
                try {
                    await cloudDb
                        .from('events')
                        .insert([{ 
                            id, 
                            text: taskText, 
                            date: taskDate, 
                            calendar_id: calendar, 
                            completed: 0, 
                            start_time: startTime, 
                            duration_min: durationMin, 
                            updated_at: updatedAt, 
                            device_id: deviceId, 
                            synced: 1, 
                            deleted: 0, 
                            visibility, 
                            shared_with: sharedWith, 
                            importance_score: importance, 
                            impact_score: impact, 
                            goal_id: goalId, 
                            project_id: projectId, 
                            subject_id: subjectId, 
                            created_by: authUserId 
                        }]);
                } catch (cloudErr) {
                    console.warn('Cloud insert failed, will keep local copy:', cloudErr.message || cloudErr);
                }
            })();
        }

        // Always keep a local copy for offline usage
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tasks (
                id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, 
                updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted, visibility, shared_with, 
                importance_score, impact_score, goal_id, project_id, subject_id
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(
            id,
            taskText,
            taskDate,
            calendar,
            0,
            startTime,
            durationMin,
            updatedAt,
            deviceId,
            visibility,
            sharedWith,
            importance,
            impact,
            goalId,
            projectId,
            subjectId
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('main_db.addTask failed:', error.message);
        throw error;
    }
}

async function fetchTasks(date) {
    const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('events')
                .select('*')
                .eq('date', date)
                .eq('deleted', 0)
                .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });
            if (error) throw error;
            return (data || []).map(e => ({
                ...e,
                calendar: e.calendar_id
            }));
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Cloud fetchTasks failed, falling back to local:', e.message);
        }
    }
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE date = ? AND deleted = 0').all(date);
}

async function fetchTasksInRange(startDate, endDate) {
    const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await cloudDb
                .from('events')
                .select('*')
                .gte('date', startDate)
                .lte('date', endDate)
                .eq('deleted', 0)
                .order('date', { ascending: true })
                .order('updated_at', { ascending: true });
            if (error) throw error;
            return (data || []).map(e => ({
                ...e,
                calendar: e.calendar_id
            }));
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Cloud fetchTasksInRange failed, falling back to local:', e.message);
        }
    }
    return db.prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE date >= ? AND date <= ? AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY date, updated_at'
    ).all(startDate, endDate);
}

async function completeTask(text) {
    const deviceId = getDeviceId();
    const updatedAt = Date.now();
    const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    // Update cloud if possible
    if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            // If text is an id, update by id; otherwise update by text
            if (text && text.startsWith('e_')) {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ completed: 1, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('id', text);
            } else {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ completed: 1, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('text', text);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Cloud completeTask failed, will mark local copy instead:', e.message);
        }
    }

    // Always update the local copy
    if (text && text.startsWith('e_')) {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET completed = 1, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, text);
    } else {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET completed = 1, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE text = ? AND deleted = 0
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, text);
    }

    try {
        let taskText = '';
        if (text && text.startsWith('e_')) {
            const row = db.prepare("SELECT text FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(text);
            if (row) taskText = row.text;
        } else {
            taskText = text;
        }

        if (taskText && taskText.startsWith('Review Repeating Topic: ')) {
            const topic = taskText.replace('Review Repeating Topic: ', '');
            db.prepare("UPDATE cognitive_loop_adherence SET completed_review = 1 WHERE topic = ?").run(topic);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to update loop adherence in completeTask:', err.message);
    }
}

async function uncompleteTask(idOrText) {
    const deviceId = getDeviceId();
    const updatedAt = Date.now();
    const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';
    // Update cloud if possible
    if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            if (idOrText && idOrText.startsWith('e_')) {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ completed: 0, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('id', idOrText);
            } else {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ completed: 0, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('text', idOrText);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Cloud uncompleteTask failed, will mark local copy instead:', e.message);
        }
    }

    // Always update the local copy
    if (idOrText && idOrText.startsWith('e_')) {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET completed = 0, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, idOrText);
    } else {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET completed = 0, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE text = ? AND deleted = 0
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, idOrText);
    }

    try {
        let taskText = '';
        if (idOrText && idOrText.startsWith('e_')) {
            const row = db.prepare("SELECT text FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(idOrText);
            if (row) taskText = row.text;
        } else {
            taskText = idOrText;
        }

        if (taskText && taskText.startsWith('Review Repeating Topic: ')) {
            const topic = taskText.replace('Review Repeating Topic: ', '');
            db.prepare("UPDATE cognitive_loop_adherence SET completed_review = 0 WHERE topic = ?").run(topic);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to revert loop adherence in uncompleteTask:', err.message);
    }
}

async function deleteTask(idOrText) {
    const deviceId = getDeviceId();
    const updatedAt = Date.now();
    const authUserId = getSyncMeta('auth_user_id');
    const authToken = getSyncMeta('auth_token');
    const useCloud = getSyncMeta('use_cloud') !== 'false';

    // 1. If cloud is active, soft-delete on Supabase
    if (cloudDb && authUserId && authToken && useCloud) {
        try {
            if (idOrText && idOrText.startsWith('e_')) {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ deleted: 1, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('id', idOrText);
            } else {
                await cloudDb.from('events').update({ deleted: 1, updated_at: updatedAt, device_id: deviceId }).eq('text', idOrText);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Cloud deleteTask failed, will mark local copy instead:', e.message);
        }
    }

    // 2. Mark as deleted in local SQLite database
    if (idOrText && idOrText.startsWith('e_')) {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET deleted = 1, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE id = ?
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, idOrText);
    } else {
        db.prepare(`
            UPDATE tasks 
            SET deleted = 1, updated_at = ?, device_id = ?, synced = 0 
            WHERE text = ?
        `).run(updatedAt, deviceId, idOrText);
    }
}

function getSyncMeta(key) {
    const row = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM sync_meta WHERE key = ?").get(key);
    if (!row) return null;
    const value = row.value;
    
    // Encrypted keys: auth_token, google_provider_token, refresh_token
    if ((key === 'auth_token' || key === 'google_provider_token' || key === 'refresh_token') && safeStorage && safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable()) {
        try {
            if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(value) && value.length % 2 === 0) {
                const encryptedBuffer = Buffer.from(value, 'hex');
                return safeStorage.decryptString(encryptedBuffer);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn(`Decryption failed for key ${key}, treating as plaintext:`, err.message);
        }
    }
    return value;
}

function setSyncMeta(key, value) {
    if ((key === 'auth_token' || key === 'google_provider_token' || key === 'refresh_token') && safeStorage && safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable()) {
        try {
            const encryptedBuffer = safeStorage.encryptString(String(value));
            const hexString = encryptedBuffer.toString('hex');
            db.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)").run(key, hexString);
            return;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error(`Encryption failed for key ${key}:`, err.message);
        }
    }
    db.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)").run(key, String(value));
}

    deleteTask,
    getSyncMeta,
    setSyncMeta
};
