const db = mainDb.db;

// 🧠 HIERARCHICAL MEMORY STORAGE
let sessionHistory = [];
let chatHistory = [];

/**
 * Memory Hierarchy Types:
 * - CORE_IDENTITY: fundamental aspects of Chrono's personality
 * - EMOTIONAL: emotionally significant events
 * - LONG_TERM: user facts and patterns
 * - SHORT_TERM: recent conversation context
 * - EPHEMERAL: temporary, session-specific data
 */

let memoryHierarchy = {
    coreIdentity: [],      // weight: 1.0 (never decay)
    emotional: [],         // weight: 0.8 (slow decay)
    longTerm: [],          // weight: 0.6 (moderate decay)
    shortTerm: [],         // weight: 0.3 (fast decay)
    ephemeral: []          // weight: 0.1 (very fast decay)
};

let memoryMetadata = {
    totalRecall: 0,
    lastPruned: Date.now(),
    emotionalWeighting: true,
    lastDecayCalculation: Date.now()
};

// ========================================
// 📉 MEMORY DECAY CONFIGURATION
// ========================================

const decayConfig = {
    // Decay rates per memory type (per hour)
    decayRates: {
        coreIdentity: 0.0,      // Never decays
        emotional: 0.001,       // Very slow decay
        longTerm: 0.005,        // Slow decay
        shortTerm: 0.02,        // Moderate decay
        ephemeral: 0.05         // Fast decay
    },
    
    // Reinforcement multipliers
    reinforcementMultipliers: {
        recalled: 1.5,           // Boost when recalled
        referenced: 1.3,        // Boost when referenced
        emotional: 1.4,         // Boost for emotional memories
        themeMatch: 1.2         // Boost for matching current theme
    },
    
    // Decay calculation interval (ms)
    decayInterval: 3600000,     // Every hour
    
    // Minimum relevance threshold
    minRelevance: 0.1
};

/* =========================
   💬 HIERARCHICAL CHAT MEMORY
========================= */

function saveChat(userInput, aiResponse) {
    const entry = {
        userInput,
        aiResponse,
        timestamp: Date.now()
    };

    chatHistory.push(entry);

    // Determine memory type based on context
    const memoryType = classifyMemory(userInput, aiResponse);
    saveToHierarchy(userInput, aiResponse, memoryType);

    try {
        const uuid = mainDb.generateUUID();
        const deviceId = mainDb.getDeviceId();
        const updatedAt = Date.now();
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO memory_chat (id, user_input, ai_response, timestamp, updated_at, device_id, synced)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
        `).run(uuid, userInput, aiResponse, entry.timestamp, updatedAt, deviceId);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to save chat to local memory db:", e.message);
    }
}

/**
 * Save to memory with context and hierarchy
 */
function saveChatWithContext(userInput, aiResponse, context = {}) {
    const entry = {
        userInput,
        aiResponse,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        emotion: context.emotion || 'neutral',
        attention: context.attention || 'open',
        priority: context.priority || null,
        importance: calculateImportance(userInput, context)
    };

    chatHistory.push(entry);

    const memoryType = classifyMemory(userInput, aiResponse, context);
    saveToHierarchy(entry, memoryType);

    try {
        const uuid = mainDb.generateUUID();
        const deviceId = mainDb.getDeviceId();
        const updatedAt = Date.now();
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO memory_chat (id, user_input, ai_response, timestamp, updated_at, device_id, synced)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
        `).run(uuid, userInput, aiResponse, entry.timestamp, updatedAt, deviceId);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to save chat with context to local memory db:", e.message);
    }
}

/**
 * Classify memory into hierarchy
 */
function classifyMemory(userInput, aiResponse, context = {}) {
    const lower = userInput.toLowerCase();
    const emotion = context.emotion || 'neutral';

    // Emotional significance
    if (['overwhelmed', 'frustrated', 'sad', 'anxious'].includes(emotion)) {
        return 'emotional';
    }

    // Core identity questions
    if (lower.includes('who are you') || lower.includes('what\'s your name')) {
        return 'coreIdentity';
    }

    // User facts
    if (lower.includes('i ') || lower.includes('my ')) {
        if (lower.includes('always') || lower.includes('usually') || lower.includes('tend')) {
            return 'longTerm';
        }
    }

    // Recent conversation
    if (context.attention === 'focused' || context.priority) {
        return 'shortTerm';
    }

    // Default to ephemeral
    return 'ephemeral';
}

/**
 * Calculate importance score (0-1)
 */
function calculateImportance(input, context = {}) {
    let score = 0.5;

    // Emotional content increases importance
    const emotionalKeywords = ['overwhelmed', 'frustrated', 'exhausted', 'excited', 'worried'];
    if (emotionalKeywords.some(kw => input.toLowerCase().includes(kw))) {
        score += 0.3;
    }

    // Focused attention increases importance
    if (context.attention === 'focused') {
        score += 0.15;
    }

    // High priority increases importance
    if (context.priority === 'high' || context.priority === 'critical') {
        score += 0.2;
    }

    return Math.min(1, score);
}

/**
 * Save to appropriate hierarchy level
 */
function saveToHierarchy(entry, memoryType = 'shortTerm') {
    if (!memoryHierarchy[memoryType]) {
        memoryHierarchy.shortTerm.push(entry);
        return;
    }

    memoryHierarchy[memoryType].push(entry);

    // Keep bounded
    const limits = {
        coreIdentity: 50,
        emotional: 100,
        longTerm: 200,
        shortTerm: 100,
        ephemeral: 50
    };

    if (memoryHierarchy[memoryType].length > limits[memoryType]) {
        memoryHierarchy[memoryType].shift();
    }
}

function getRecentChats(limit = 5) {
    return chatHistory.slice(-limit);
}

/**
 * Retrieve memories by hierarchy (weighted recall)
 */
function getHierarchicalMemories(limit = 10) {
    const weights = {
        coreIdentity: 1.0,
        emotional: 0.8,
        longTerm: 0.6,
        shortTerm: 0.3,
        ephemeral: 0.1
    };

    const combined = [];

    for (const [type, memories] of Object.entries(memoryHierarchy)) {
        memories.forEach(mem => {
            combined.push({
                ...mem,
                type,
                weight: weights[type],
                score: (mem.importance || 0.5) * weights[type]
            });
        });
    }

    // Sort by weight and recency
    combined.sort((a, b) => {
        const scoreWeight = (b.score - a.score) * 0.6;
        const recencyWeight = (b.timestamp - a.timestamp) * 0.4;
        return scoreWeight + recencyWeight;
    });

    return combined.slice(0, limit);
}

/**
 * Prune old memories to prevent bloat
 */
function pruneMemories(maxAge = 604800000) { // 7 days default
    const now = Date.now();
    const threshold = now - maxAge;

    for (const type in memoryHierarchy) {
        memoryHierarchy[type] = memoryHierarchy[type].filter(mem => mem.timestamp > threshold);
    }

    memoryMetadata.lastPruned = now;
}

/* =========================
   🧠 BEHAVIOR MEMORY
========================= */

function saveBehavior(type, value) {
    try {
        db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO memory_behavior (type, value, timestamp)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        `).run(type, value, Date.now());
    } catch (e) {
        // safe fallback
    }
}

function logSession(task, duration) {
    const entry = {
        task,
        duration,
        time: new Date(),
        timestamp: Date.now()
    };

    sessionHistory.push(entry);

    // High-value behavior memory
    saveBehavior("session", JSON.stringify(entry));
    saveToHierarchy(entry, 'longTerm');
}

function getHistory() {
    return sessionHistory;
}

/* =========================
   📊 ANALYTICS (with hierarchy)
========================= */

function getAverageFocusTime() {
    if (sessionHistory.length === 0) return 0;

    const total = sessionHistory.reduce((sum, h) => sum + h.duration, 0);
    return total / sessionHistory.length;
}

function getMostFrequentTask() {
    if (sessionHistory.length === 0) return null;

    const taskCounts = {};
    sessionHistory.forEach(h => {
        taskCounts[h.task] = (taskCounts[h.task] || 0) + 1;
    });

    return Object.keys(taskCounts).reduce((a, b) =>
        taskCounts[a] > taskCounts[b] ? a : b
    );
}

/**
 * Get emotional memory - what made an impact?
 */
function getEmotionalMemories(limit = 5) {
    return memoryHierarchy.emotional
        .sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp)
        .slice(0, limit);
}

/**
 * Get core identity anchors
 */
function getCoreIdentity() {
    return memoryHierarchy.coreIdentity;
}

/**
 * Get pattern memory
 */
function getPatterns() {
    const longTerm = memoryHierarchy.longTerm;
    const patterns = {};

    longTerm.forEach(mem => {
        if (mem.userInput) {
            const key = mem.userInput.slice(0, 30); // summarize
            patterns[key] = (patterns[key] || 0) + 1;
        }
    });

    return Object.entries(patterns)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
        .slice(0, 5);
}

/**
 * Context compression - summarize memories for token efficiency
 */
function compressContext(memories = []) {
    if (memories.length === 0) return '';

    const summary = memories
        .sort((a, b) => (b.importance || 0) - (a.importance || 0))
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map(m => `[${m.type}] ${m.userInput.slice(0, 50)}...`)
        .join('; ');

    return summary;
}

/* =========================
   📉 MEMORY DECAY SYSTEM
========================= */

/**
 * Calculate memory decay for all memories
 * Called periodically to reduce relevance of old memories
 */
function calculateMemoryDecay() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const hoursSinceLastCalc = (now - memoryMetadata.lastDecayCalculation) / 3600000;
    
    if (hoursSinceLastCalc < 1) {
        return; // Only calculate once per hour
    }
    
    for (const type in memoryHierarchy) {
        const decayRate = decayConfig.decayRates[type] || 0.02;
        
        memoryHierarchy[type] = memoryHierarchy[type].map(memory => {
            const ageInHours = (now - memory.timestamp) / 3600000;
            const currentRelevance = memory.relevance || 1.0;
            
            // Apply exponential decay
            const decayedRelevance = currentRelevance * Math.pow(1 - decayRate, ageInHours);
            
            return {
                ...memory,
                relevance: Math.max(decayConfig.minRelevance, decayedRelevance),
                lastDecayed: now
            };
        });
    }
    
    memoryMetadata.lastDecayCalculation = now;
    
    // Remove memories below relevance threshold
    pruneByRelevance();
}

/**
 * Reinforce a memory (boost its relevance)
 */
function reinforceMemory(memoryId, reason = 'recalled') {
    const multiplier = decayConfig.reinforcementMultipliers[reason] || 1.2;
    
    for (const type in memoryHierarchy) {
        const memory = memoryHierarchy[type].find(m => m.id === memoryId);
        if (memory) {
            memory.relevance = Math.min(1.0, (memory.relevance || 1.0) * multiplier);
            memory.reinforcedAt = Date.now();
            memory.reinforcedReason = reason;
            break;
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Recalculate emotional relevance of memories
 * Emotional memories may gain/lose relevance based on current emotional state
 */
function recalculateEmotionalRelevance(currentEmotion) {
    const emotionalMemories = memoryHierarchy.emotional;
    
    emotionalMemories.forEach(memory => {
        if (memory.emotion === currentEmotion) {
            // Boost relevance if emotion matches current state
            memory.relevance = Math.min(1.0, (memory.relevance || 0.5) * decayConfig.reinforcementMultipliers.emotional);
        } else {
            // Slightly reduce if emotion doesn't match
            memory.relevance = Math.max(decayConfig.minRelevance, (memory.relevance || 0.5) * 0.95);
        }
    });
}

/**
 * Prune memories by relevance threshold
 */
function pruneByRelevance() {
    for (const type in memoryHierarchy) {
        const originalLength = memoryHierarchy[type].length;
        
        memoryHierarchy[type] = memoryHierarchy[type].filter(
            memory => (memory.relevance || 1.0) >= decayConfig.minRelevance
        );
        
        const prunedCount = originalLength - memoryHierarchy[type].length;
        if (prunedCount > 0) {
            console.log(`Pruned ${prunedCount} ${type} memories below relevance threshold`);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Symbolic consolidation - merge similar memories
 */
function consolidateMemories() {
    for (const type in memoryHierarchy) {
        if (type === 'coreIdentity') continue; // Don't consolidate core identity
        
        const memories = memoryHierarchy[type];
        const consolidated = [];
        const seen = new Set();
        
        memories.forEach(memory => {
            const signature = generateMemorySignature(memory);
            
            if (seen.has(signature)) {
                // Merge with existing
                const existing = consolidated.find(m => generateMemorySignature(m) === signature);
                if (existing) {
                    existing.relevance = Math.max(existing.relevance || 0.5, memory.relevance || 0.5);
                    existing.referenceCount = (existing.referenceCount || 0) + 1;
                }
            } else {
                seen.add(signature);
                memory.referenceCount = 1;
                consolidated.push(memory);
            }
        });
        
        memoryHierarchy[type] = consolidated;
    }
}

/**
 * Generate signature for memory consolidation
 */
function generateMemorySignature(memory) {
    if (!memory.userInput) return 'empty';
    return memory.userInput
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^\w\s]/g, '')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .sort()
        .join(' ')
        .slice(0, 50); // First 50 chars of sorted words
}

/**
 * Theme abstraction - extract higher-level themes from memories
 */
function abstractThemes(memories = []) {
    const themes = {};
    
    memories.forEach(memory => {
        if (memory.userInput) {
            const words = memory.userInput.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/);
            words.forEach(word => {
                if (word.length > 3) { // Only meaningful words
                    themes[word] = (themes[word] || 0) + (memory.relevance || 1.0);
                }
            });
        }
    });
    
    // Return top themes
    return Object.entries(themes)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
        .slice(0, 10)
        .map(([theme, weight]) => ({ theme, weight }));
}

/**
 * Adaptive retrieval prioritization
 * Returns memories sorted by relevance, recency, and context match
 */
function getAdaptiveMemories(limit = 10, context = {}) {
    const allMemories = [];
    
    for (const [type, memories] of Object.entries(memoryHierarchy)) {
        memories.forEach(memory => {
            let adaptiveScore = memory.relevance || 1.0;
            
            // Boost for context match
            if (context.theme && memory.userInput?.toLowerCase().includes(context.theme.toLowerCase())) {
                adaptiveScore *= decayConfig.reinforcementMultipliers.themeMatch;
            }
            
            // Boost for emotional context match
            if (context.emotion && memory.emotion === context.emotion) {
                adaptiveScore *= decayConfig.reinforcementMultipliers.emotional;
            }
            
            // Recency factor (more recent = higher score)
            const ageInHours = (Date.now() - memory.timestamp) / 3600000;
            const recencyFactor = Math.pow(0.95, ageInHours);
            
            adaptiveScore *= recencyFactor;
            
            allMemories.push({
                ...memory,
                type,
                adaptiveScore
            });
        });
    }
    
    // Sort by adaptive score
    allMemories.sort((a, b) => b.adaptiveScore - a.adaptiveScore);
    
    return allMemories.slice(0, limit);
}

/**
 * Get memory decay statistics
 */
function getDecayStats() {
    const stats = {
        lastCalculated: new Date(memoryMetadata.lastDecayCalculation).toISOString(),
        totalMemories: 0,
        averageRelevance: 0,
        byType: {}
    };
    
    let totalRelevance = 0;
    let totalCount = 0;
    
    for (const [type, memories] of Object.entries(memoryHierarchy)) {
        const typeRelevance = memories.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.relevance || 1.0), 0);
        const typeCount = memories.length;
        
        stats.byType[type] = {
            count: typeCount,
            averageRelevance: typeCount > 0 ? typeRelevance / typeCount : 0,
            decayRate: decayConfig.decayRates[type]
        };
        
        totalRelevance += typeRelevance;
        totalCount += typeCount;
    }
    
    stats.totalMemories = totalCount;
    stats.averageRelevance = totalCount > 0 ? totalRelevance / totalCount : 0;
    
    return stats;
}

const db = mainDb.db;

/**
 * Calculate Significance Score: (Importance * Impact) / (delta_t + 1) * Frequency
 */
function calculateSignificance(memory, now = Date.now()) {
    const importance = memory.importance_score || 5;
    const impact = memory.impact_score || 5;
    const createdAt = memory.created_at || memory.timestamp || now;
    const deltaDays = Math.max(0, (now - createdAt) / 86400000);
    
    // Frequency metric: occurrences of the subject or key keywords
    let frequency = 1;
    try {
        if (memory.subject_id) {
            const subjTasks = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE subject_id = ?").get(memory.subject_id);
            frequency += (subjTasks ? subjTasks.count : 0);
        } else if (memory.text || memory.title) {
            const text = memory.text || memory.title;
            const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 4);
            if (words.length > 0) {
                const param = `%${words[0]}%`;
                const similar = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE text LIKE ?").get(param);
                frequency += (similar ? similar.count : 0);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    return ((importance * impact) / (deltaDays + 1)) * frequency;
}

/**
 * Helper to get the previous month key
 */
function getPreviousMonth(yearMonth) {
    const [year, month] = yearMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    let prevYear = year;
    let prevMonth = month - 1;
    if (prevMonth === 0) {
        prevMonth = 12;
        prevYear = year - 1;
    }
    return `${prevYear}-${String(prevMonth).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Helper to get the top subject name and count for a month
 */
function getTopSubjectForMonth(yearMonth) {
    try {
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name as subject_name, COUNT(*) as count
            FROM tasks t
            JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id = s.id
            WHERE t.completed = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.date LIKE ?
            GROUP BY s.name
            ORDER BY count DESC
            LIMIT 1
        `).get(`${yearMonth}%`);
        return tasks ? { name: tasks.subject_name, count: tasks.count } : null;
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Consolidate monthly raw study activities into themes
 */
function consolidateActivity(userId, yearMonth) {
    try {
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT t.text, t.calendar, t.date, t.duration_min, s.name as subject_name
            FROM tasks t
            LEFT JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id = s.id
            WHERE t.completed = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.date LIKE ?
        `).all(`${yearMonth}%`);

        const subjectCounts = {};
        tasks.forEach(t => {
            if (t.subject_name) {
                subjectCounts[t.subject_name] = (subjectCounts[t.subject_name] || 0) + 1;
            }
        });

        const summaries = [];
        const months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        const monthNum = parseInt(yearMonth.split('-')[1], 10);
        const monthName = months[monthNum - 1] || 'the month';

        // 1. Alert if subject count >= 5
        Object.entries(subjectCounts).forEach(([subj, count]) => {
            if (count >= 5) {
                summaries.push(`"${subj}" became a major focus during ${monthName} (completed ${count} sessions).`);
            }
        });

        // 2. Study focus transition delta
        const currTop = getTopSubjectForMonth(yearMonth);
        const prevMonth = getPreviousMonth(yearMonth);
        const prevTop = getTopSubjectForMonth(prevMonth);
        if (currTop && prevTop && currTop.name !== prevTop.name && currTop.count >= 3 && prevTop.count >= 3) {
            summaries.push(`Academic priorities transitioned from ${prevTop.name} to ${currTop.name}.`);
        }

        if (summaries.length === 0) {
            if (tasks.length > 0) {
                summaries.push(`Maintained a steady routine with ${tasks.length} tasks completed during ${monthName}.`);
            } else {
                summaries.push(`No significant study activity recorded for ${monthName}.`);
            }
        }

        return summaries.join(' ');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to consolidate activity:", e.message);
        return "Steady progress recorded.";
    }
}

/**
 * Month-over-month Identity Timeline ("Who am I becoming?") narrative compiler
 */
function getIdentityTimeline(userId, yearMonth) {
    try {
        const [year, month] = yearMonth.split('-').map(Number);
        const startTime = new Date(year, month - 1, 1).getTime();
        const endTime = new Date(year, month, 1).getTime();

        // 1. Dominated calendar layers
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT calendar, COUNT(*) as count 
            FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND date LIKE ?
            GROUP BY calendar
        `).all(`${yearMonth}%`);

        let totalTasks = 0;
        let studyCount = 0;
        let personalCount = 0;
        tasks.forEach(t => {
            totalTasks += t.count;
            if (t.calendar === 'study' || t.calendar === 'focus') studyCount += t.count;
            if (t.calendar === 'personal') personalCount += t.count;
        });

        let style = 'Balanced Integration';
        if (totalTasks > 0) {
            if (studyCount / totalTasks >= 0.6) {
                style = 'Academic Growth';
            } else if (personalCount / totalTasks >= 0.6) {
                style = 'Personal Continuity';
            }
        }

        // 2. Stress check in notes
        const notes = db.prepare(`
            SELECT title, content FROM notes 
            WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?
        `).all(startTime, endTime);

        let stressCount = 0;
        const stressWords = ['stress', 'anxious', 'tired', 'burnout', 'overwhelmed', 'exhausted', 'worry'];
        let noteSubjects = new Set();
        
        notes.forEach(n => {
            const text = `${n.title} ${n.content || ''}`.toLowerCase();
            stressWords.forEach(w => {
                if (text.includes(w)) stressCount++;
            });
            
            ['dsa', 'calculus', 'physics', 'math', 'discrete', 'chemistry'].forEach(sub => {
                if (text.includes(sub)) noteSubjects.add(sub.toUpperCase());
            });
        });

        let stressFocus = "";
        if (stressCount >= 2) {
            style = 'Recovery & Resilience Focus';
            stressFocus = " Mindfulness and fatigue management became vital.";
        }

        // 3. Peak focus window info
        let focusNarrative = "";
        try {
            const cognitiveProfile = require('./cognitiveProfile');
            const prof = cognitiveProfile.getCognitiveProfile(userId);
            if (prof && prof.best_focus_time) {
                focusNarrative = ` Protected peak focus window around ${prof.best_focus_time}.`;
            }
        } catch(err) {}

        const months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        const monthName = months[month - 1] || 'Unknown';

        let subjectsText = "";
        if (noteSubjects.size > 0) {
            subjectsText = ` with deep dives into ${Array.from(noteSubjects).join(', ')}`;
        }

        return `${monthName} ${year}: Characterized by a dominant theme of ${style}${subjectsText}.${focusNarrative}${stressFocus}`;

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to compute identity timeline:", e.message);
        return "Steady state with positive development patterns.";
    }
}

/**
 * Compile Monthly Memory Cards
 * Aggregates study session durations, task completions, goal counts, and chats.
 */
function getMemoryCards(userId) {
    const cards = [];
    try {
        // Fetch all completed tasks with dates to aggregate
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT date, calendar, duration_min 
            FROM tasks 
            WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0
        `).all();

        // Fetch all created goals
        const goals = db.prepare(`
            SELECT created_at, title 
            FROM goals
        `).all();

        // Fetch chats
        const chats = db.prepare(`
            SELECT timestamp, user_input 
            FROM memory_chat
        `).all();

        // Group by Year-Month (e.g. "2026-05")
        const monthlyGroups = {};

        // Process tasks
        tasks.forEach(t => {
            if (!t.date) return;
            const monthKey = t.date.substring(0, 7); // "YYYY-MM"
            if (!monthlyGroups[monthKey]) {
                monthlyGroups[monthKey] = {
                    studyHours: 0,
                    tasksCompleted: 0,
                    goalsCreated: [],
                    milestones: [],
                    interactions: 0
                };
            }
            monthlyGroups[monthKey].tasksCompleted++;
            if (t.calendar === 'study' || t.calendar === 'focus') {
                monthlyGroups[monthKey].studyHours += (t.duration_min || 60) / 60.0;
            }
        });

        // Process goals
        goals.forEach(g => {
            const date = new Date(g.created_at);
            const monthKey = date.toISOString().split('T')[0].substring(0, 7);
            if (!monthlyGroups[monthKey]) {
                monthlyGroups[monthKey] = {
                    studyHours: 0,
                    tasksCompleted: 0,
                    goalsCreated: [],
                    milestones: [],
                    interactions: 0
                };
            }
            monthlyGroups[monthKey].goalsCreated.push(g.title);
        });

        // Process chats for interaction counts & milestones
        chats.forEach(c => {
            if (!c.timestamp) return;
            const monthKey = new Date(c.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0].substring(0, 7);
            if (!monthlyGroups[monthKey]) {
                monthlyGroups[monthKey] = {
                    studyHours: 0,
                    tasksCompleted: 0,
                    goalsCreated: [],
                    milestones: [],
                    interactions: 0
                };
            }
            monthlyGroups[monthKey].interactions++;
            // Check if chat represents a key conversation milestone
            const inputLower = c.user_input.toLowerCase();
            if (inputLower.includes('princess') || inputLower.includes('exam') || inputLower.includes('study')) {
                if (monthlyGroups[monthKey].milestones.length < 3) {
                    let desc = '';
                    if (inputLower.includes('princess')) desc = 'Conversation with Princess';
                    else if (inputLower.includes('exam')) desc = `Prep for ${inputLower.match(/(\w+\s+exam|exam\s+\w+)/)?.[0] || 'Exam'}`;
                    else desc = 'Study session scheduling';
                    
                    if (!monthlyGroups[monthKey].milestones.includes(desc)) {
                        monthlyGroups[monthKey].milestones.push(desc);
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        // Format into list of month cards
        const months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(monthlyGroups)) {
            const [year, monthNum] = key.split('-');
            const monthName = months[parseInt(monthNum, 10) - 1] || 'Unknown';
            
            // Consolidate monthly themes & identity narratives
            const consolidationText = consolidateActivity(userId, key);
            const identityNarrative = getIdentityTimeline(userId, key);

            cards.push({
                monthKey: key,
                title: `${monthName} ${year}`,
                studyHours: Math.round(val.studyHours * 10) / 10,
                tasksCompleted: val.tasksCompleted,
                goalsCreated: val.goalsCreated,
                milestones: val.milestones.length > 0 ? val.milestones : ['Routine planning session'],
                consolidationText,
                identityNarrative
            });
        }

        // Sort chronologically descending
        cards.sort((a, b) => b.monthKey.localeCompare(a.monthKey));

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to generate memory cards:", e.message);
    }
    return cards;
}

/**
 * Search Memories across chats, notes, and tasks
 */
function searchMemories(userId, query) {
    const results = [];
    if (!query || !query.trim()) return results;
    const searchPattern = `%${query.trim()}%`;
    const now = Date.now();

    try {
        // 1. Search Notes
        const notes = db.prepare(`
            SELECT id, title, content, created_at, importance_score, impact_score, linked_subject_id as subject_id, 'note' as type 
            FROM notes 
            WHERE title LIKE ? OR content LIKE ?
        `).all(searchPattern, searchPattern);
        
        notes.forEach(n => {
            const significance = calculateSignificance({ ...n, timestamp: n.created_at }, now);
            results.push({
                id: n.id,
                title: `📝 Note: ${n.title}`,
                content: n.content || '',
                date: new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleDateString(),
                timestamp: n.created_at,
                type: 'note',
                significance
            });
        });

        // 2. Search Tasks
        const tasks = db.prepare(`
            SELECT id, text, date, calendar, completed, importance_score, impact_score, subject_id, 'task' as type 
            FROM tasks 
            WHERE text LIKE ? AND deleted = 0
        `).all(searchPattern);
        
        tasks.forEach(t => {
            const timestamp = new Date(t.date).getTime();
            const significance = calculateSignificance({ ...t, timestamp }, now);
            results.push({
                id: t.id,
                title: `📅 Task: ${t.text}`,
                content: `Calendar: ${t.calendar} | Status: ${t.completed ? 'Completed' : 'Pending'}`,
                date: t.date,
                timestamp,
                type: 'task',
                significance
            });
        });

        // 3. Search Chat History
        const chats = db.prepare(`
            SELECT id, user_input, ai_response, timestamp, 'chat' as type 
            FROM memory_chat 
            WHERE user_input LIKE ? OR ai_response LIKE ?
        `).all(searchPattern, searchPattern);
        
        chats.forEach(c => {
            const significance = calculateSignificance({ ...c, importance_score: 5, impact_score: 5 }, now);
            results.push({
                id: c.id,
                title: `🧠 Chat: "${c.user_input.substring(0, 30)}..."`,
                content: `AI: ${c.ai_response}`,
                date: new Date(c.timestamp).toLocaleDateString(),
                timestamp: c.timestamp,
                type: 'chat',
                significance
            });
        });

        // Sort by Significance score descending
        results.sort((a, b) => b.significance - a.significance);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to execute memory search:", e.message);
    }
    return results;
}

/**
 * Tokenize and find contextually linked notes, goals, or tasks
 */
function getLinkedMemories(userId, text) {
    const linked = { notes: [], goals: [], tasks: [] };
    if (!text || !text.trim()) return linked;

    const tokens = text.toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^\w\s]/g, '')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(w => w.length > 4); // Only search for longer meaningful words

    if (tokens.length === 0) return linked;

    try {
        // Query goals matching any of these tokens
        const goalQuery = `SELECT * FROM goals WHERE ` + tokens.map(() => `title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?`).join(' OR ');
        const goalParams = [];
        tokens.forEach(t => {
            goalParams.push(`%${t}%`, `%${t}%`);
        });

        linked.goals = db.prepare(goalQuery).all(...goalParams);

        // Query notes
        const noteQuery = `SELECT * FROM notes WHERE ` + tokens.map(() => `title LIKE ? OR content LIKE ?`).join(' OR ');
        const noteParams = [];
        tokens.forEach(t => {
            noteParams.push(`%${t}%`, `%${t}%`);
        });
        linked.notes = db.prepare(noteQuery).all(...noteParams);

        // Query tasks
        const taskQuery = `SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND (` + tokens.map(() => `text LIKE ?`).join(' OR ') + `)`;
        const taskParams = tokens.map(t => `%${t}%`);
        linked.tasks = db.prepare(taskQuery).all(...taskParams);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to get linked memories:", e.message);
    }

    return linked;
}

function getLifeContinuity(userId) {
    const data = {
        whatMattered: [],
        whatChanged: [],
        whatForgetting: [],
        whoMatters: [],
        whatProgress: [],
        whatFocusNext: ""
    };

    try {
        // 1. What Mattered: High importance memories & Active goals
        const activeGoals = db.prepare("SELECT title, target_date FROM goals WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 3").all();
        activeGoals.forEach(g => {
            data.whatMattered.push(`🎯 Goal: ${g.title} (Target: ${g.target_date || 'None'})`);
        });
        const memories = db.prepare("SELECT content FROM cognitive_memories WHERE memory_type = 'daily_reflection' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2").all();
        memories.forEach(m => {
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(m.content);
                if (parsed.journalEntry) {
                    data.whatMattered.push(`💭 Logged: "${parsed.journalEntry.substring(0, 50)}..."`);
                }
            } catch(err) {}
        });

        // 2. What Changed: Mastery score deltas
        const masteryList = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.mastery 
            FROM subjects s
            JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            ORDER BY m.mastery DESC LIMIT 3
        `).all();
        masteryList.forEach(m => {
            data.whatChanged.push(`📚 Mastery in "${m.name}" is now at ${Math.round(m.mastery * 100)}%`);
        });

        // 3. What Am I Forgetting: Slipped tasks & study gaps
        const slipped = db.prepare("SELECT text, date FROM tasks WHERE completed = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND date < ? LIMIT 2").all(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
        slipped.forEach(s => {
            data.whatForgetting.push(`⚠️ Slipped: "${s.text}" (Missed: ${s.date})`);
        });
        // Study gap checking
        const studyGaps = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.last_recalled 
            FROM subjects s
            LEFT JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            ORDER BY m.last_recalled ASC LIMIT 2
        `).all();
        studyGaps.forEach(g => {
            if (g.last_recalled) {
                const diffDays = Math.round((Date.now() - g.last_recalled) / 86400000);
                if (diffDays >= 5) {
                    data.whatForgetting.push(`⏰ Focus Gap: haven't reviewed "${g.name}" in ${diffDays} days`);
                }
            } else {
                data.whatForgetting.push(`⏰ Focus Gap: "${g.name}" has not been practiced yet`);
            }
        });

        // 4. Who Matters: Peers with interaction counts
        const peers = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM relationships LIMIT 3").all();
        peers.forEach(p => {
            const count = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM shared_activities WHERE relationship_id = ?").get(p.id);
            data.whoMatters.push(`${p.display_picture || '👤'} ${p.name} (${p.role}) — ${count ? count.count : 0} shared events/goals`);
        });

        // 5. What Progress: Aggregated hours & tasks
        const totalCompleted = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0").get();
        const totalStudyMinutes = db.prepare("SELECT SUM(duration_min) as total FROM tasks WHERE completed = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND calendar = 'study'").get();
        const hrs = totalStudyMinutes && totalStudyMinutes.total ? Math.round(totalStudyMinutes.total / 60) : 0;
        data.whatProgress.push(`✅ Task Completions: ${totalCompleted ? totalCompleted.count : 0} tasks completed in total`);
        data.whatProgress.push(`⏳ Active Study Time: ${hrs} hours accumulated`);

        // 6. What Should I Focus On Next: study coach recommendation
        const lowestMastery = db.prepare(`
            SELECT s.name, m.mastery 
            FROM subjects s
            JOIN subject_mastery m ON s.id = m.subject_id
            ORDER BY m.mastery ASC LIMIT 1
        `).get();
        if (lowestMastery) {
            data.whatFocusNext = `We recommend reviewing "${lowestMastery.name}" (current mastery is lowest at ${Math.round(lowestMastery.mastery * 100)}%).`;
        } else {
            data.whatFocusNext = "No active subject anchors found. Map a DSA topic under Goals to get started!";
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to compile Life Continuity dashboard stats:", e.message);
    }
    return data;
}

    getMemoryCards,
    searchMemories,
    getLinkedMemories,
    getLifeContinuity,
    calculateSignificance,
    consolidateActivity,
    getIdentityTimeline
};

const DSA_TOPICS = {
    "segment tree": {
        concept: "Segment Tree is a tree data structure used for storing intervals or segments. It allows querying which of the stored segments contain a given point, or range queries (like sum, minimum, or maximum in a subarray) in O(log N) time, and updating elements in O(log N) time.",
        breakdown: [
            "Representation: Segment Tree is represented as an array of size 4N.",
            "Construction: Built recursively from bottom-up in O(N) time.",
            "Range Query: Truncates search paths outside the query range. Merges results of overlapping intervals.",
            "Point Update: Updates a leaf node and propagates changes up to the root."
        ],
        complexity: "Build: O(N) | Query: O(log N) | Update: O(log N) | Space: O(N)"
    },
    "fenwick tree": {
        concept: "Fenwick Tree (also known as Binary Indexed Tree or BIT) is a data structure that provides efficient methods for calculation and manipulation of the prefix sums of a sequence of values in O(log N) time.",
        breakdown: [
            "Binary representation: Uses bitwise operations like `x & (-x)` to isolate the lowest set bit.",
            "Point Update: Adds value to index `i` and propagates to next index: `i += i & (-i)`.",
            "Prefix Sum: Accumulates value at `i` and moves to parent: `i -= i & (-i)`."
        ],
        complexity: "Build: O(N log N) or O(N) | Query: O(log N) | Update: O(log N) | Space: O(N)"
    },
    "avl tree": {
        concept: "AVL Tree is a self-balancing Binary Search Tree (BST) where the difference between heights of left and right subtrees (balancing factor) cannot be more than 1 for all nodes.",
        breakdown: [
            "Balance Factor: Height(Left Subtree) - Height(Right Subtree) in {-1, 0, 1}.",
            "Rotations: Balancing is restored via Single Rotations (Left-Left, Right-Right) or Double Rotations (Left-Right, Right-Left).",
            "Insertion/Deletion: Balancing factors are recalculated up to the root node."
        ],
        complexity: "Search: O(log N) | Insertion: O(log N) | Deletion: O(log N) | Space: O(N)"
    },
    "red-black tree": {
        concept: "Red-Black Tree is a self-balancing binary search tree where each node has a color attribute (Red or Black). Balance is maintained through node coloring and rotations.",
        breakdown: [
            "Root & Leaf Rule: The root and all NULL leaves are always Black.",
            "Red Rule: Red nodes cannot have Red children (no consecutive Red nodes).",
            "Black Height Rule: Every path from a node to any of its descendant NULL leaves must contain the same number of Black nodes."
        ],
        complexity: "Search: O(log N) | Insertion: O(log N) | Deletion: O(log N) | Space: O(N)"
    },
    "dynamic programming": {
        concept: "Dynamic Programming (DP) is an algorithmic paradigm that solves a complex problem by breaking it into subproblems, solving each subproblem once, and storing their solutions (memoization/tabulation) to avoid redundant computations.",
        breakdown: [
            "Optimal Substructure: The optimal solution to the problem can be constructed from optimal solutions to its subproblems.",
            "Overlapping Subproblems: Subproblems are solved repeatedly (unlike divide-and-conquer).",
            "Approaches: Memoization (Top-Down, recursive) vs Tabulation (Bottom-Up, iterative)."
        ],
        complexity: "Dependent on state representation (typically O(N) to O(N^2) time/space)."
    },
    "trie": {
        concept: "Trie (also called prefix tree) is a search tree used for storing associative arrays where keys are usually strings. Nodes store character references, enabling prefix matching.",
        breakdown: [
            "Root Node: Represents an empty string.",
            "Edge Transition: Characters represent branches to child nodes.",
            "Word End: Boolean flag marking if the node completes a word."
        ],
        complexity: "Insert: O(L) | Search: O(L) | Prefix Match: O(L) | Space: O(ALPHABET_SIZE * N * L)"
    },
    "disjoint set": {
        concept: "Disjoint Set Union (DSU / Union-Find) is a data structure that tracks elements partitioned into disjoint subsets. It provides near-constant time operations to merge sets and find representatives.",
        breakdown: [
            "Find: Determines which subset an element belongs to. Can be optimized with Path Compression.",
            "Union: Merges two subsets into a single subset. Can be optimized with Union by Rank/Size."
        ],
        complexity: "Find: O(alpha(N)) | Union: O(alpha(N)) where alpha is the inverse Ackermann function."
    },
    "dijkstra": {
        concept: "Dijkstra's Algorithm finds the shortest paths from a single source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights.",
        breakdown: [
            "Greedy Choice: Always relaxes the vertex with the minimum distance next.",
            "Data Structure: Optimized using a min-priority queue (Binary/Fibonacci Heap).",
            "Edge Relaxation: If `dist[u] + weight(u,v) < dist[v]`, update `dist[v]`."
        ],
        complexity: "Time: O((V + E) log V) with Binary Heap | Space: O(V + E)"
    },
    "sliding window": {
        concept: "Sliding Window is a problem-solving pattern used to convert a nested loop O(N^2) algorithm into a single O(N) linear scan over arrays or strings.",
        breakdown: [
            "Fixed Window: Maintains a window of constant width `K` by adding new element and discarding trailing element.",
            "Dynamic Window: Expands right pointer until condition is met, then shrinks left pointer to optimize constraints."
        ],
        complexity: "Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) or O(K) for tracking window elements."
    }
};
