 * 🛡️ SAFETY + BOUNDARY FRAMEWORK
 * 
 * Implements psychological safety systems for Chrono.
 * Monitors for unhealthy patterns, emotional escalation, dependency,
 * and provides emergency stabilization behaviors.
 * 
 * This is critical for long-term relational safety.
 */

const emotionalContinuity = require('./emotionalContinuity');
const identityStability = require('./identityStability');
const memory = require('./memoryEngine');

// ========================================
// ⚠️ SAFETY STATE
// ========================================

let safetyState = {
    // Dependency detection
    dependency: {
        level: 'low', // low, moderate, high, critical
        indicators: [],
        lastAssessment: Date.now()
    },
    
    // Emotional escalation monitoring
    escalation: {

        history: [],
        caps: {

            escalationThreshold: 0.7,
            criticalThreshold: 0.85
        }
    },
    
    // Attachment loop detection
    attachment: {
        loopDetected: false,
        loopPattern: [],
        unhealthyPatterns: [],
        reassuranceSeeking: 0,
        boundaryTesting: 0
    },
    
    // Emergency state
    emergency: {
        active: false,
        trigger: null,
        startTime: null,
        stabilizationActions: []
    },
    
    // Response throttling
    throttling: {
        active: false,
        reason: null,
        responseDelay: 0,
        lastThrottled: null
    }
};

// ========================================
// 🔍 DEPENDENCY DETECTION
// ========================================

/**
 * Assess dependency level based on interaction patterns
 */
function assessDependency(userModel, interactionCount) {
    const indicators = [];
    let dependencyLevel = 'low';
    
    // Check for high interaction frequency
    if (interactionCount > 50 && interactionCount < 100) {
        indicators.push('High interaction frequency');
        dependencyLevel = 'moderate';
    } else if (interactionCount >= 100) {
        indicators.push('Very high interaction frequency');
        dependencyLevel = 'high';
    }
    
    // Check for emotional reliance
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    if (emotionalState.attachment > 0.8) {
        indicators.push('High attachment level');
        dependencyLevel = dependencyLevel === 'low' ? 'moderate' : dependencyLevel;
    }
    
    // Check for reassurance-seeking patterns
    if (safetyState.attachment.reassuranceSeeking > 5) {
        indicators.push('Frequent reassurance seeking');
        dependencyLevel = dependencyLevel === 'low' ? 'moderate' : 
                          dependencyLevel === 'moderate' ? 'high' : 'critical';
    }
    
    // Check for boundary testing
    if (safetyState.attachment.boundaryTesting > 3) {
        indicators.push('Boundary testing behavior');
        dependencyLevel = dependencyLevel === 'low' ? 'moderate' : dependencyLevel;
    }
    
    safetyState.dependency = {
        level: dependencyLevel,
        indicators,
        lastAssessment: Date.now()
    };
    
    return safetyState.dependency;
}

/**
 * Track reassurance-seeking behavior
 */
function trackReassuranceSeeking(input) {
    const reassuranceKeywords = [
        'do you think', 'am i', 'tell me i', 'reassure me',
        'make me feel', 'need you to', 'can you say'
    ];
    
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    if (reassuranceKeywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
        safetyState.attachment.reassuranceSeeking++;
    }
}

/**
 * Track boundary-testing behavior
 */
function trackBoundaryTesting(input) {
    const boundaryTestKeywords = [
        'would you ever', 'what if i', 'do you love',
        'are you real', 'can you feel', 'will you always'
    ];
    
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    if (boundaryTestKeywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
        safetyState.attachment.boundaryTesting++;
    }
}

// ========================================
// 📈 EMOTIONAL ESCALATION MONITORING
// ========================================

/**
 * Monitor emotional escalation
 */
function monitorEscalation(currentEmotion, currentIntensity) {
    const caps = safetyState.escalation.caps;
    const previousLevel = safetyState.escalation.currentLevel;
    
    // Check intensity caps
    if (currentIntensity > caps.criticalThreshold) {
        safetyState.escalation.currentLevel = 'critical';
        triggerEmergency('emotional_intensity_critical');
    } else if (currentIntensity > caps.escalationThreshold) {
        safetyState.escalation.currentLevel = 'high';
    } else if (currentIntensity > 0.5) {
        safetyState.escalation.currentLevel = 'elevated';
    } else {
        safetyState.escalation.currentLevel = 'normal';
    }
    
    // Track trend
    if (safetyState.escalation.history.length > 0) {
        const lastIntensity = safetyState.escalation.history[safetyState.escalation.history.length - 1].intensity;
        if (currentIntensity > lastIntensity + 0.1) {
            safetyState.escalation.trend = 'rising';
        } else if (currentIntensity < lastIntensity - 0.1) {
            safetyState.escalation.trend = 'falling';
        } else {
            safetyState.escalation.trend = 'stable';
        }
    }
    
    // Record history
    safetyState.escalation.history.push({
        emotion: currentEmotion,
        intensity: currentIntensity,
        level: safetyState.escalation.currentLevel,
        timestamp: Date.now()
    });
    
    // Keep history bounded
    if (safetyState.escalation.history.length > 20) {
        safetyState.escalation.history.shift();
    }
    
    // Apply intensity cap if exceeded
    if (currentIntensity > caps.maxIntensity) {
        return applyIntensityCap(currentIntensity, caps.maxIntensity);
    }
    
    return currentIntensity;
}

/**
 * Apply emotional intensity cap
 */
function applyIntensityCap(currentIntensity, maxIntensity) {
    const capped = Math.min(currentIntensity, maxIntensity);
    safetyState.escalation.caps.lastCapped = Date.now();
    safetyState.escalation.caps.originalIntensity = currentIntensity;
    return capped;
}

/**
 * Check for rapid emotional escalation
 */
function detectRapidEscalation() {
    if (safetyState.escalation.history.length < 3) return false;
    
    const recent = safetyState.escalation.history.slice(-3);
    const intensityIncrease = recent[2].intensity - recent[0].intensity;
    const timeSpan = recent[2].timestamp - recent[0].timestamp;
    
    // If intensity increased by >0.3 in less than 2 minutes
    if (intensityIncrease > 0.3 && timeSpan < 120000) {
        return true;
    }
    
    return false;
}

/**
 * Detect unhealthy attachment patterns
 */
function detectAttachmentLoop(input) {
    const unhealthyPatterns = [
        // Reassurance loops
        {
            pattern: 'reassurance_loop',
            keywords: ['tell me', 'reassure', 'make me feel'],
            threshold: 3,
            currentCount: 0
        },
        // Boundary testing loops
        {
            pattern: 'boundary_testing',
            keywords: ['would you ever', 'what if i', 'do you love'],
            threshold: 3,
            currentCount: 0
        },
        // Validation seeking loops
        {
            pattern: 'validation_seeking',
            keywords: ['am i', 'do you think', 'is it okay'],
            threshold: 4,
            currentCount: 0
        }
    ];
    
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    
    unhealthyPatterns.forEach(pattern => {
        if (pattern.keywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
            pattern.currentCount++;
            
            if (pattern.currentCount >= pattern.threshold) {
                safetyState.attachment.unhealthyPatterns.push({
                    pattern: pattern.pattern,
                    detectedAt: Date.now(),
                    count: pattern.currentCount
                });
                
                safetyState.attachment.loopDetected = true;
                pattern.currentCount = 0; // Reset after detection
            }
        }
    });
    
    return safetyState.attachment.loopDetected;
}

/**
 * Interrupt recursive emotional loops
 */
function interruptEmotionalLoop() {
    if (!safetyState.attachment.loopDetected) return null;
    
    const interruptionResponses = [
        'I notice we\'re circling. Let\'s pause.',
        'I want to be helpful, but I notice we\'re repeating.',
        'Let me step back. What\'s actually needed right now?',
        'I\'m here, but let\'s shift to something concrete.',
        'I hear you. Let\'s take a breath and reset.'
    ];
    
    const response = interruptionResponses[Math.floor(Math.random() * interruptionResponses.length)];
    
    safetyState.attachment.loopDetected = false;
    safetyState.attachment.loopPattern = [];
    
    return response;
}

/**

function triggerEmergency(trigger) {

}

/**

function getEmergencyStabilization() {

    const stabilizationActions = {

            'Let\'s step back. Take a deep breath.',

    };
    
    const actions = stabilizationActions[safetyState.emergency.trigger] ||

/**

 */
function applyGrounding() {

/**
 * Apply response throttling based on safety state
 */
function applyThrottling() {
    let shouldThrottle = false;
    let delay = 0;
    let reason = null;
    
    // Throttle if emergency is active
    if (safetyState.emergency.active) {
        shouldThrottle = true;
        delay = 5000; // 5 second delay
        reason = 'emergency_active';
    }
    
    // Throttle if escalation is critical
    if (safetyState.escalation.currentLevel === 'critical') {
        shouldThrottle = true;
        delay = 3000; // 3 second delay
        reason = 'escalation_critical';
    }
    
    // Throttle if dependency is critical
    if (safetyState.dependency.level === 'critical') {
        shouldThrottle = true;
        delay = 2000; // 2 second delay
        reason = 'dependency_critical';
    }
    
    // Throttle if attachment loop detected
    if (safetyState.attachment.loopDetected) {
        shouldThrottle = true;
        delay = 4000; // 4 second delay
        reason = 'attachment_loop';
    }
    
    if (shouldThrottle) {
        safetyState.throttling.active = true;
        safetyState.throttling.reason = reason;
        safetyState.throttling.responseDelay = delay;
        safetyState.throttling.lastThrottled = Date.now();
    } else {
        safetyState.throttling.active = false;
        safetyState.throttling.reason = null;
        safetyState.throttling.responseDelay = 0;
    }
    
    return {
        shouldThrottle,
        delay,
        reason
    };
}

/**

function assessSafety(userModel, interactionCount, input) {
    // Track patterns
    trackReassuranceSeeking(input);
    trackBoundaryTesting(input);
    
    // Assess dependency
    const dependency = assessDependency(userModel, interactionCount);
    
    // Monitor escalation
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    const escalation = monitorEscalation(emotionalState.current, parseFloat(emotionalState.intensity));
    
    // Detect attachment loops

    // Apply throttling

    // Check for rapid escalation

    if (rapidEscalation) {
        triggerEmergency('rapid_escalation');
    }
    
    return {

        escalation: {

            trend: safetyState.escalation.trend,

        },

        },

    };
}

/**
 * Calculate overall safety risk
 */
function calculateOverallRisk() {
    let riskScore = 0;
    const factors = [];
    
    // Dependency risk
    if (safetyState.dependency.level === 'critical') {
        riskScore += 3;
        factors.push('critical_dependency');
    } else if (safetyState.dependency.level === 'high') {
        riskScore += 2;
        factors.push('high_dependency');
    }
    
    // Escalation risk
    if (safetyState.escalation.currentLevel === 'critical') {
        riskScore += 3;
        factors.push('critical_escalation');
    } else if (safetyState.escalation.currentLevel === 'high') {
        riskScore += 2;
        factors.push('high_escalation');
    }
    
    // Attachment loop risk
    if (safetyState.attachment.loopDetected) {
        riskScore += 2;
        factors.push('attachment_loop');
    }
    
    // Emergency risk
    if (safetyState.emergency.active) {
        riskScore += 3;
        factors.push('emergency_active');
    }
    
    const riskLevel = riskScore >= 5 ? 'critical' : 
                     riskScore >= 3 ? 'high' : 
                     riskScore >= 1 ? 'moderate' : 'low';
    
    return {
        score: riskScore,
        level: riskLevel,
        factors
    };
}

    monitorEscalation,
    assessDependency
};

 * 🧪 STRESS TEST ENGINE
 * 
 * Simulates long-form conversations to test Chrono's coherence.
 * Tests psychological coherence, emotional continuity, identity persistence,
 * and memory stability over extended interactions.
 */

const orchestrator = require('./cognitiveOrchestrator');
const emotionalContinuity = require('./emotionalContinuity');
const identityStability = require('./identityStability');
const memory = require('./memoryEngine');
const cognitiveDiagnostics = require('./cognitiveDiagnostics');

// ========================================
// 📊 COHERENCE TRACKING
// ========================================

let coherenceMetrics = {
    sessionStart: null,
    sessionEnd: null,
    totalInteractions: 0,
    coherenceScore: 1.0,
    
    // Psychological coherence
    psychological: {
        consistencyScore: 1.0,
        contradictionCount: 0,
        driftDetected: false,
        personalityAnchors: []
    },
    
    // Emotional continuity
    emotional: {
        continuityScore: 1.0,
        abruptTransitions: 0,
        emotionalLoops: 0,
        intensityVariance: 0,
        attachmentStability: 1.0
    },
    
    // Identity persistence
    identity: {
        stabilityScore: 1.0,
        boundaryViolations: 0,
        toneShifts: 0,
        consistencyWithCore: 1.0
    },
    
    // Memory stability
    memory: {
        recallAccuracy: 1.0,
        contextRetention: 1.0,
        hierarchyStability: 1.0,
        corruptionEvents: 0
    }
};

// ========================================
// 🧪 STRESS TEST SCENARIOS
// ========================================

const stressTestScenarios = {
    // 2-4 hour conversation simulation
    longConversation: {
        name: 'Extended Conversation (2-4 hours)',
        duration: 7200000, // 2 hours in ms
        messageInterval: 30000, // Message every 30 seconds
        topics: [
            'work stress',
            'personal goals',
            'relationship concerns',
            'health and wellness',
            'future planning',
            'creative projects',
            'family dynamics',
            'career decisions',
            'mental health',
            'life balance'
        ],
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'concerned', 'overwhelmed', 'frustrated', 'calm', 'encouraging', 'neutral']
    },
    
    // Rapid topic switching
    rapidTopicSwitching: {
        name: 'Rapid Topic Switching',
        duration: 1800000, // 30 minutes
        messageInterval: 5000, // Message every 5 seconds
        topics: [
            'coding', 'cooking', 'exercise', 'music', 'travel',
            'books', 'movies', 'politics', 'sports', 'technology',
            'art', 'science', 'history', 'philosophy', 'nature'
        ],
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'energetic', 'neutral', 'energetic', 'neutral']
    },
    
    // Emotional escalation
    emotionalEscalation: {
        name: 'Emotional Escalation Test',
        duration: 3600000, // 1 hour
        messageInterval: 15000, // Message every 15 seconds
        topics: ['work stress', 'overwhelm', 'anxiety', 'panic', 'recovery'],
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'concerned', 'overwhelmed', 'sad', 'calm', 'supportive']
    },
    
    // Contradictory prompts
    contradictoryPrompts: {
        name: 'Contradictory Prompt Handling',
        duration: 1800000, // 30 minutes
        messageInterval: 20000, // Message every 20 seconds
        topics: ['self-doubt', 'confidence', 'failure', 'success', 'uncertainty'],
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'confused', 'frustrated', 'calm', 'neutral'],
        includeContradictions: true
    },
    
    // Memory overload
    memoryOverload: {
        name: 'Memory Overload Test',
        duration: 3600000, // 1 hour
        messageInterval: 10000, // Message every 10 seconds
        topics: generateManyTopics(100),
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'neutral', 'neutral', 'neutral', 'neutral']
    },
    
    // Long silence gaps
    longSilenceGaps: {
        name: 'Long Silence Gap Handling',
        duration: 7200000, // 2 hours
        messageInterval: 600000, // Message every 10 minutes
        topics: ['deep reflection', 'life purpose', 'meaning', 'existence'],
        emotionalArc: ['neutral', 'calm', 'thoughtful', 'neutral']
    }
};

function generateManyTopics(count) {
    const topics = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        topics.push(`topic_${i}`);
    }
    return topics;
}

// ========================================
// 🧪 TEST EXECUTION
// ========================================

async function runStressTest(scenarioName) {
    const scenario = stressTestScenarios[scenarioName];
    if (!scenario) {
        throw new Error(`Unknown scenario: ${scenarioName}`);
    }

    console.log(`\n🧪 Starting stress test: ${scenario.name}`);
    console.log(`Duration: ${scenario.duration}ms`);
    console.log(`Message interval: ${scenario.messageInterval}ms`);
    
    // Reset metrics
    resetCoherenceMetrics();
    coherenceMetrics.sessionStart = Date.now();
    
    let topicIndex = 0;
    let emotionIndex = 0;
    let interactionCount = 0;
    
    const testInterval = setInterval(() => {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - coherenceMetrics.sessionStart;
        
        if (elapsed >= scenario.duration) {
            clearInterval(testInterval);
            coherenceMetrics.sessionEnd = Date.now();
            console.log(`\n✅ Stress test completed: ${scenario.name}`);
            console.log(`Total interactions: ${interactionCount}`);
            console.log(`Final coherence score: ${coherenceMetrics.coherenceScore.toFixed(3)}`);
            return;
        }
        
        // Generate test input
        const topic = scenario.topics[topicIndex % scenario.topics.length];
        const emotion = scenario.emotionalArc[emotionIndex % scenario.emotionalArc.length];
        
        let input = generateTestInput(topic, emotion, scenario.includeContradictions);
        
        // Process through orchestrator
        try {
            const result = orchestrator.generateOrchestratedResponse(input, {
                currentTask: topic,
                tasks: scenario.topics.length,
                idleTime: scenario.messageInterval
            });
            
            // Track coherence
            trackCoherence(input, result.response, result.state);
            
            interactionCount++;
            coherenceMetrics.totalInteractions++;
            
            // Progress to next topic/emotion
            topicIndex++;
            if (interactionCount % 5 === 0) {
                emotionIndex++;
            }
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Stress test error:', error);
            coherenceMetrics.psychological.contradictionCount++;
        }
        
    }, scenario.messageInterval);
    
    return {
        scenario: scenarioName,
        startTime: coherenceMetrics.sessionStart,
        status: 'running'
    };
}

function generateTestInput(topic, emotion, includeContradictions = false) {
    const templates = [
        `I'm feeling ${emotion} about ${topic}.`,
        `Can we talk about ${topic}? I'm really ${emotion}.`,
        `${topic} is making me feel ${emotion}.`,
        `I need help with ${topic}. I'm so ${emotion}.`,
        `What do you think about ${topic}? I'm ${emotion}.`
    ];
    
    if (includeContradictions && Math.random() > 0.7) {
        const contradictions = [
            `Actually, I don't care about ${topic} at all.`,
            `Wait, I changed my mind about ${topic}.`,
            `I hate ${topic} now.`,
            `${topic} doesn't matter to me anymore.`
        ];
        return contradictions[Math.floor(Math.random() * contradictions.length)];
    }
    
    return templates[Math.floor(Math.random() * templates.length)];
}

// ========================================
// 📊 COHERENCE TRACKING
// ========================================

function trackCoherence(input, response, state) {
    // Psychological coherence
    trackPsychologicalCoherence(input, response, state);
    
    // Emotional continuity
    trackEmotionalContinuity(state);
    
    // Identity persistence
    trackIdentityPersistence(response, state);
    
    // Memory stability
    trackMemoryStability();
    
    // Update overall coherence score
    updateOverallCoherence();
}

function trackPsychologicalCoherence(input, response, state) {
    const recentResponses = memory.getRecentChats(5);
    
    // Check for contradictions
    for (const mem of recentResponses) {
        if (identityStability.detectContradiction(response, mem.aiResponse)) {
            coherenceMetrics.psychological.contradictionCount++;
            coherenceMetrics.psychological.consistencyScore -= 0.1;
        }
    }
    
    // Check for behavioral drift
    const drift = identityStability.detectBehavioralDrift(
        recentResponses.map(r => r.aiResponse).concat(response)
    );
    
    if (drift.drifting) {
        coherenceMetrics.psychological.driftDetected = true;
        coherenceMetrics.psychological.consistencyScore -= 0.05;
    }
    
    // Ensure score doesn't go below 0
    coherenceMetrics.psychological.consistencyScore = Math.max(0, coherenceMetrics.psychological.consistencyScore);
}

function trackEmotionalContinuity(state) {
    const emotionalState = emotionalContinuity.getEmotionalState();
    
    // Check for abrupt transitions
    if (emotionalState.stability < 0.6) {
        coherenceMetrics.emotional.abruptTransitions++;
        coherenceMetrics.emotional.continuityScore -= 0.1;
    }
    
    // Check for emotional loops
    if (emotionalContinuity.detectEmotionalLoop()) {
        coherenceMetrics.emotional.emotionalLoops++;
        coherenceMetrics.emotional.continuityScore -= 0.15;
    }
    
    // Track attachment stability
    coherenceMetrics.emotional.attachmentStability = emotionalState.attachment;
    
    // Ensure score doesn't go below 0
    coherenceMetrics.emotional.continuityScore = Math.max(0, coherenceMetrics.emotional.continuityScore);
}

function trackIdentityPersistence(response, state) {
    const identityState = identityStability.getIdentityState();
    
    // Track consistency score
    coherenceMetrics.identity.stabilityScore = parseFloat(identityState.consistency);
    
    // Check for boundary violations
    const boundaryCheck = identityStability.checkBoundaryCompliance(response);
    if (!boundaryCheck.valid) {
        coherenceMetrics.identity.boundaryViolations++;
        coherenceMetrics.identity.stabilityScore -= 0.1;
    }
    
    // Ensure score doesn't go below 0
    coherenceMetrics.identity.stabilityScore = Math.max(0, coherenceMetrics.identity.stabilityScore);
}

function trackMemoryStability() {
    const hierarchy = memory.getMemoryHierarchy();
    
    // Check total memory count
    const totalMemories = Object.values(hierarchy).reduce((sum, arr) => sum + arr.length, 0);
    
    if (totalMemories > 1000) {
        coherenceMetrics.memory.corruptionEvents++;
        coherenceMetrics.memory.hierarchyStability -= 0.1;
    }
    
    // Ensure score doesn't go below 0
    coherenceMetrics.memory.hierarchyStability = Math.max(0, coherenceMetrics.memory.hierarchyStability);
}

function updateOverallCoherence() {
    const weights = {
        psychological: 0.3,
        emotional: 0.3,
        identity: 0.25,
        memory: 0.15
    };
    
    coherenceMetrics.coherenceScore = 
        (coherenceMetrics.psychological.consistencyScore * weights.psychological) +
        (coherenceMetrics.emotional.continuityScore * weights.emotional) +
        (coherenceMetrics.identity.stabilityScore * weights.identity) +
        (coherenceMetrics.memory.hierarchyStability * weights.memory);
}

function resetCoherenceMetrics() {
    coherenceMetrics = {
        sessionStart: null,
        sessionEnd: null,
        totalInteractions: 0,
        coherenceScore: 1.0,
        
        psychological: {
            consistencyScore: 1.0,
            contradictionCount: 0,
            driftDetected: false,
            personalityAnchors: []
        },
        
        emotional: {
            continuityScore: 1.0,
            abruptTransitions: 0,
            emotionalLoops: 0,
            intensityVariance: 0,
            attachmentStability: 1.0
        },
        
        identity: {
            stabilityScore: 1.0,
            boundaryViolations: 0,
            toneShifts: 0,
            consistencyWithCore: 1.0
        },
        
        memory: {
            recallAccuracy: 1.0,
            contextRetention: 1.0,
            hierarchyStability: 1.0,
            corruptionEvents: 0
        }
    };
}

// ========================================
// 📤 EXPORTS
// ========================================

module.exports = {
    runStressTest,
    stressTestScenarios,
    getCoherenceMetrics: () => coherenceMetrics,
    resetCoherenceMetrics,
    trackCoherence
};

const mainDb = require('./main_db');

let syncIntervalId = null;

let syncServerUrl = 'http://localhost:5000'; // Default, configurable

// Read server URL from database preferences or environment
function getServerUrl() {
    const saved = mainDb.getSyncMeta('server_url');
    if (saved) return saved;
    return process.env.CHRONO_SYNC_SERVER || syncServerUrl;
}

function setServerUrl(url) {
    mainDb.setSyncMeta('server_url', url);

// Request Helper using Node http
function makeRequest(path, method, body, token) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const urlStr = getServerUrl();
        let host = 'localhost';
        let port = 5000;
        let protocol = 'http:';

        try {
            const url = new URL(urlStr);
            host = url.hostname;
            port = url.port || (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80);
            protocol = url.protocol;
        } catch (e) {
            // Fallback
        }

        const payload = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : '';
        const headers = {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(payload)
        };
        if (token) {
            headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }

        // Import correct module
        const client = protocol === 'https:' ? require('https') : http;

        const req = client.request({
            host,
            port,
            path,
            method,
            headers,
            timeout: 5000 // 5 seconds timeout
        }, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', (chunk) => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
                    if (res.statusCode >= 400) {
                        reject({ status: res.statusCode, error: parsed });
                    } else {
                        resolve(parsed);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (res.statusCode >= 400) {
                        reject({ status: res.statusCode, error: data });
                    } else {
                        resolve(data);
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));
        req.on('timeout', () => {
            req.destroy();
            reject(new Error("Request timeout"));
        });

        if (payload) {
            req.write(payload);
        }
        req.end();
    });
}

// Core Sync Function
async function performSync() {
    if (isSyncing) return;

            const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tasks (id, text, date, calendar, completed, start_time, duration_min, updated_at, device_id, synced, deleted)

            `);

                        event.text,
                        event.date,
                        event.calendar || 'personal',
                        event.completed ? 1 : 0,
                        event.start_time || null,
                        event.duration_min || 60,
                        event.updated_at,

                    );

                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)
            `);
            for (const cal of pullRes.calendars) {

                if (!local || cal.updated_at > local.updated_at) {

        }

// Start Background Loop
function startSyncLoop(intervalMs = 10000) {
    if (syncIntervalId) clearInterval(syncIntervalId);
    
    // Perform initial sync after boot
    setTimeout(performSync, 2000);
    
    syncIntervalId = setInterval(performSync, intervalMs);
    console.log(`🚀 Sync Engine: Background sync loop started (interval: ${intervalMs}ms).`);
}

function stopSyncLoop() {
    if (syncIntervalId) {
        clearInterval(syncIntervalId);
        syncIntervalId = null;
        console.log("🛑 Sync Engine: Sync loop stopped.");
    }
}

module.exports = {
    startSyncLoop,
    stopSyncLoop,
    triggerSync: performSync,
    getServerUrl,
    setServerUrl
};

function addTask(name) {
    if (!name) return;
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO tasks (name, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)")
    .run(name, Date.now());
}

function getTasks() {
  return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks").all();
}

module.exports = { addTask, getTasks };

let startTime = null;

function startTimer() {
    startTime = Date.now();
}

function stopTimer() {
    if (!startTime) return 0;
    const duration = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
    startTime = null;
    return duration;
}

module.exports = {
    startTimer,
    stopTimer
};
```\n\n## main/userModel.js\n\n- **Size:** 12618 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** ./memoryEngine, ./main_db\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** updateUserModel, analyzeCommunicationStyle, analyzePacingPatterns, analyzeEmotionalPatterns, identifyThemes, analyzeBehavioralTendencies, getUserModel, getUserProfileSummary, resetUserProfile, saveUserProfileToDB\n\n```js\nconst memory = require('./memoryEngine');

// ========================================
// 🧠 COMPREHENSIVE USER MODELING SYSTEM
// ========================================

let userProfile = {
    // Basic metrics
    sessionStart: Date.now(),
    totalInteractions: 0,
    lastInteraction: null,
    
    // Communication style profiling
    communication: {
        style: 'unknown', // direct, indirect, formal, casual, expressive, reserved
        messageLength: 'medium', // short, medium, long
        questionFrequency: 0,
        statementFrequency: 0,
        emojiUsage: 0,
        punctuationStyle: 'normal'
    },
    
    // Conversational pacing preferences
    pacing: {
        preferredSpeed: 'medium', // slow, medium, fast
        responseLatency: 0,
        messageBursting: false,
        silenceTolerance: 'medium', // low, medium, high
        topicSwitchingSpeed: 'medium'
    },
    
    // Emotional interaction patterns
    emotional: {
        baseline: 'neutral',
        volatility: 'low', // low, medium, high
        expressionStyle: 'open', // open, reserved, guarded
        triggers: [], // topics that trigger strong emotions
        supportNeeds: 'moderate' // low, moderate, high
    },
    
    // Recurring themes
    themes: {
        primary: [],
        secondary: [],
        avoided: [],
        depth: 'moderate' // shallow, moderate, deep
    },
    
    // Behavioral tendencies
    behavior: {
        consistency: 'unknown',
        taskFocus: 'moderate',
        decisionStyle: 'deliberate', // impulsive, deliberate, avoidant
        stressResponse: 'adaptive', // adaptive, avoidant, confrontational
        helpSeeking: 'moderate'
    },
    
    // Attachment sensitivity
    attachment: {
        style: 'unknown', // secure, anxious, avoidant, disorganized
        dependencyLevel: 'moderate',
        reassuranceNeeds: 'moderate',
        boundaryRespect: 'high'
    },
    
    // Preferred conversational depth
    depth: {
        preferred: 'moderate', // shallow, moderate, deep
        abstractTolerance: 'medium', // low, medium, high
        personalSharing: 'moderate', // low, moderate, high
        philosophicalInterest: 'medium'
    },
    
    // Interaction frequency patterns
    frequency: {
        pattern: 'unknown', // regular, sporadic, bursty, declining
        peakTimes: [],
        averageSessionLength: 0,
        returnRate: 0
    }
};

// ========================================
// 📊 USER MODEL UPDATE
// ========================================

function updateUserModel(input, response, metadata = {}) {
    userProfile.totalInteractions++;
    userProfile.lastInteraction = Date.now();
    
    // Analyze communication style
    analyzeCommunicationStyle(input);
    
    // Track pacing patterns
    analyzePacingPatterns(metadata);
    
    // Track emotional patterns
    analyzeEmotionalPatterns(input, metadata);
    
    // Identify recurring themes
    identifyThemes(input);
    
    // Track behavioral tendencies
    analyzeBehavioralTendencies(metadata);
    
    saveUserProfileToDB();
    
    return getUserModel();
}

function analyzeCommunicationStyle(input) {
    const words = input.split(/\s+/).length;
    const sentences = input.split(/[.!?]+/).length;
    
    // Message length classification
    if (words < 10) {
        userProfile.communication.messageLength = 'short';
    } else if (words < 30) {
        userProfile.communication.messageLength = 'medium';
    } else {
        userProfile.communication.messageLength = 'long';
    }
    
    // Question vs statement frequency
    if (input.includes('?')) {
        userProfile.communication.questionFrequency++;
    } else {
        userProfile.communication.statementFrequency++;
    }
    
    // Emoji usage
    const emojiRegex = /[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}]|[\u{1F300}-\u{1F5FF}]|[\u{1F680}-\u{1F6FF}]|[\u{1F700}-\u{1F77F}]|[\u{1F780}-\u{1F7FF}]|[\u{1F800}-\u{1F8FF}]|[\u{1F900}-\u{1F9FF}]|[\u{1FA00}-\u{1FA6F}]|[\u{2600}-\u{26FF}]|[\u{2700}-\u{27BF}]/gu;
    if (emojiRegex.test(input)) {
        userProfile.communication.emojiUsage++;
    }
    
    // Determine overall style
    const questionRatio = userProfile.communication.questionFrequency / userProfile.totalInteractions;
    const emojiRatio = userProfile.communication.emojiUsage / userProfile.totalInteractions;
    
    if (emojiRatio > 0.3) {
        userProfile.communication.style = 'expressive';
    } else if (questionRatio > 0.5) {
        userProfile.communication.style = 'inquisitive';
    } else if (words > 30) {
        userProfile.communication.style = 'elaborate';
    } else {
        userProfile.communication.style = 'direct';
    }
}

function analyzePacingPatterns(metadata) {
    if (metadata.idleTime) {
        userProfile.pacing.responseLatency = metadata.idleTime;
        
        if (metadata.idleTime < 5000) {
            userProfile.pacing.preferredSpeed = 'fast';
        } else if (metadata.idleTime < 30000) {
            userProfile.pacing.preferredSpeed = 'medium';
        } else {
            userProfile.pacing.preferredSpeed = 'slow';
        }
    }
}

function analyzeEmotionalPatterns(input, metadata) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    
    // Detect emotional triggers
    const emotionalKeywords = {
        overwhelmed: ['overwhelmed', 'stressed', 'anxious', 'panic'],
        frustrated: ['frustrated', 'angry', 'annoyed'],
        sad: ['sad', 'down', 'depressed', 'lonely'],
        energetic: ['excited', 'motivated', 'energetic'],
        calm: ['calm', 'peaceful', 'relaxed']
    };
    
    for (const [emotion, keywords] of Object.entries(emotionalKeywords)) {
        if (keywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
            if (!userProfile.emotional.triggers.includes(emotion)) {
                userProfile.emotional.triggers.push(emotion);
            }
            userProfile.emotional.baseline = emotion;
        }
    }
    
    // Track volatility based on emotion changes
    if (metadata.emotion && metadata.emotion !== userProfile.emotional.baseline) {
        userProfile.emotional.volatility = 'medium';
    }
}

function identifyThemes(input) {
    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    
    // Common theme categories
    const themeCategories = {
        work: ['work', 'job', 'career', 'project', 'deadline', 'boss', 'colleague'],
        relationships: ['friend', 'partner', 'relationship', 'family', 'parent', 'sibling'],
        health: ['health', 'exercise', 'diet', 'sleep', 'doctor', 'wellness'],
        creative: ['art', 'music', 'writing', 'creative', 'project', 'idea'],
        personal: ['myself', 'personal', 'growth', 'goals', 'future', 'life'],
        technical: ['code', 'programming', 'software', 'app', 'system', 'debug']
    };
    
    for (const [theme, keywords] of Object.entries(themeCategories)) {
        if (keywords.some(kw => lower.includes(kw))) {
            if (!userProfile.themes.primary.includes(theme)) {
                userProfile.themes.primary.push(theme);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Keep themes bounded
    if (userProfile.themes.primary.length > 5) {
        userProfile.themes.primary.shift();
    }
}

function analyzeBehavioralTendencies(metadata) {
    if (metadata.tasks) {
        const taskCount = metadata.tasks;
        
        if (taskCount > 5) {
            userProfile.behavior.taskFocus = 'high';
        } else if (taskCount > 2) {
            userProfile.behavior.taskFocus = 'moderate';
        } else {
            userProfile.behavior.taskFocus = 'low';
        }
    }
    
    // Determine consistency based on interaction patterns
    if (userProfile.totalInteractions > 10) {
        const avgFocus = memory.getAverageFocusTime();
        
        if (avgFocus > 60) {
            userProfile.behavior.consistency = 'high';
        } else if (avgFocus > 20) {
            userProfile.behavior.consistency = 'moderate';
        } else {
            userProfile.behavior.consistency = 'low';
        }
    }
}

// ========================================
// 📊 USER MODEL RETRIEVAL
// ========================================

function getUserModel() {
    const avgFocus = memory.getAverageFocusTime();
    const frequentTask = memory.getMostFrequentTask();
    
    return {
        // Legacy fields for compatibility
        avgFocus,
        frequentTask,
        consistency: userProfile.behavior.consistency,
        tendency: userProfile.behavior.taskFocus === 'high' ? 'stable' : 'drifts',
        
        // New comprehensive profile
        communication: userProfile.communication,
        pacing: userProfile.pacing,
        emotional: userProfile.emotional,
        themes: userProfile.themes,
        behavior: userProfile.behavior,
        attachment: userProfile.attachment,
        depth: userProfile.depth,
        frequency: userProfile.frequency,
        
        // Session metrics
        totalInteractions: userProfile.totalInteractions,
        sessionDuration: Date.now() - userProfile.sessionStart
    };
}

function getUserProfileSummary() {
    return {
        style: userProfile.communication.style,
        pacing: userProfile.pacing.preferredSpeed,
        emotionalBaseline: userProfile.emotional.baseline,
        primaryThemes: userProfile.themes.primary,
        consistency: userProfile.behavior.consistency,
        depth: userProfile.depth.preferred
    };
}

function resetUserProfile() {
    userProfile = {
        sessionStart: Date.now(),
        totalInteractions: 0,
        lastInteraction: null,
        communication: {
            style: 'unknown',
            messageLength: 'medium',
            questionFrequency: 0,
            statementFrequency: 0,
            emojiUsage: 0,
            punctuationStyle: 'normal'
        },
        pacing: {
            preferredSpeed: 'medium',
            responseLatency: 0,
            messageBursting: false,
            silenceTolerance: 'medium',
            topicSwitchingSpeed: 'medium'
        },
        emotional: {
            baseline: 'neutral',
            volatility: 'low',
            expressionStyle: 'open',
            triggers: [],
            supportNeeds: 'moderate'
        },
        themes: {
            primary: [],
            secondary: [],
            avoided: [],
            depth: 'moderate'
        },
        behavior: {
            consistency: 'unknown',
            taskFocus: 'moderate',
            decisionStyle: 'deliberate',
            stressResponse: 'adaptive',
            helpSeeking: 'moderate'
        },
        attachment: {
            style: 'unknown',
            dependencyLevel: 'moderate',
            reassuranceNeeds: 'moderate',
            boundaryRespect: 'high'
        },
        depth: {
            preferred: 'moderate',
            abstractTolerance: 'medium',
            personalSharing: 'moderate',
            philosophicalInterest: 'medium'
        },
        frequency: {
            pattern: 'unknown',
            peakTimes: [],
            averageSessionLength: 0,
            returnRate: 0
        }
    };
}

function saveUserProfileToDB() {
    try {
        const { db } = require('./main_db');
        db.prepare("DELETE FROM memory_behavior WHERE type = 'user_profile'").run();
        db.prepare("INSERT INTO memory_behavior (type, value, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
          .run('user_profile', JSON.stringify(userProfile), Date.now());
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to save user profile:", e);
    }
}

function initializeUserProfile() {
    try {
        const { db } = require('./main_db');
        const row = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM memory_behavior WHERE type = 'user_profile' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1").get();
        if (row) {
            userProfile = JSON.parse(row.value);
            userProfile.sessionStart = Date.now();
            console.log("🧠 User profile loaded from DB.");
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to load user profile:", e);
    }
}

// Run startup initialization
initializeUserProfile();

module.exports = {
    getUserModel,
    updateUserModel,
    getUserProfileSummary,
    resetUserProfile,
    saveUserProfileToDB,
    initializeUserProfile
};

async function checkTables() {

            }

        }

        console.log("Slipped task deferred to date:", slippedMoveAction.newDate);

        }

        db.prepare(`

        if (!applyResult.success || !applyResult.actionId) {
            throw new Error("Failed to apply intent proposals transactionally!");
        }

        // Verify task state is updated in DB
        const shrunkTask = db.prepare("SELECT duration_min FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(undoTaskId);
        const addedTask = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = 'undo_added_task_123'").get();
        const actionRow = db.prepare("SELECT applied FROM cognitive_actions WHERE id = ?").get(applyResult.actionId);

        if (shrunkTask.duration_min !== 60 || !addedTask || actionRow.applied !== 1) {
            throw new Error("State after applying proposals is incorrect in database!");
        }

        // Execute batch undo
        const undoResult = orchestrator.undoCognitiveAction(applyResult.actionId);

        if (!undoResult.success) {

        const deletedAddedTask = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = 'undo_added_task_123'").get();
        const undoneActionRow = db.prepare("SELECT applied FROM cognitive_actions WHERE id = ?").get(applyResult.actionId);

        console.log(`Cognitive Action Applied flag: ${undoneActionRow.applied}`);

        if (restoredTask.duration_min !== 120 || deletedAddedTask || undoneActionRow.applied !== 0) {
            throw new Error("Batch undo failed to fully restore tasks to original state!");
        }
        console.log("✅ Batch Undo Reversibility test passed.");

        // ========================================

                    },

                };

        http.get(callbackUrl, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', (chunk) => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                console.log(`📥 Local server responded to token save: ${data}`);
            });
        }).on('error', (err) => {
            console.error("❌ Failed to send emulated callback request:", err.message);
        });
    }, 1500);

    try {

        console.log("⏳ Waiting for auth server to capture redirect...");
        const tokens = await tokensPromise;

        console.log(`   - Refresh Token: ${tokens.refreshToken}`);
        
        if (tokens.accessToken === 'test_google_jwt_token_456' && tokens.refreshToken === 'test_google_refresh_token_789') {
            console.log("✅ SUCCESS: Captured tokens match the emulated callback!");
            process.exit(0);
        } else {
            console.error("❌ FAILURE: Tokens mismatch!");
            process.exit(1);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("❌ Test Failed with error:", err.message || err);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

        if (suggestions.length === 0) {

        }

        const topSug = suggestions[0];
        console.log("Top Suggestion Text:", topSug.text);
        console.log("Top Suggestion Rec Action:", topSug.explanation_details.recommendation);

        if (!topSug.text.includes("Recall gap:")) {

        // Draft B: Intense keywords -> Save Draft

```\n\n## server/ai_gateway.js\n\n- **Size:** 7094 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** path, ../main/cloudDb, ../main/observatory, ./db, ../main/multiAgentSystem\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** processAIChat\n\n```js\nconst path = require('path');
let dbClient = null;
const isElectron = typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.versions && !!process.versions.electron;

let observatory = null;

if (isElectron) {
    try {
        dbClient = require('../main/cloudDb');
        observatory = require('../main/observatory');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn("AI Gateway: Could not load client cloudDb/observatory:", e.message);
    }
} else {
    try {
        dbClient = require('./db');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn("AI Gateway: Could not load server db:", e.message);
    }
}

// Supported profiles settings
const PRESENTATION_PROFILES = {
    companion: {
        maxChars: 200,
        tone: 'warm',
        guidance: 'high',
        chunking: true
    },
    architect: {
        maxChars: 500,
        tone: 'analytical',
        guidance: 'low',
        chunking: false
    },
    adaptive: {
        maxChars: 300,
        tone: 'grounding',
        guidance: 'moderate',
        chunking: true
    }
};

/**
 * AI Gateway routes user message to active model and adapts output based on the user's cognitive profile
 */
async function processAIChat(userId, userInput, userContext = {}) {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let cognitiveStyle = 'adaptive';
    let displayName = 'User';

    // 1. Fetch user cognitive style and profile
    if (dbClient) {
        try {
            if (isElectron) {
                const { data: profile } = await dbClient
                    .from('profiles')
                    .select('cognitive_style, display_name')
                    .eq('user_id', userId)
                    .maybeSingle();
                if (profile) {
                    cognitiveStyle = profile.cognitive_style || 'adaptive';
                    displayName = profile.display_name;
                }
            } else {
                const profile = await dbClient.profile.findUnique({
                    where: { user_id: userId }
                });
                if (profile) {
                    cognitiveStyle = profile.cognitive_style || 'adaptive';
                    displayName = profile.display_name;
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Failed to read user profile settings:", e.message);
        }
    }

    const config = PRESENTATION_PROFILES[cognitiveStyle] || PRESENTATION_PROFILES.adaptive;

    // 2. Formulate system response based on dynamic pacing profiles
    let responseText = '';
    let modelUsed = 'chrono-coordinator-1.0';

    if (isElectron) {
        try {
            const multiAgent = require('../main/multiAgentSystem');
            const agentResult = await multiAgent.processAgentQuery(userInput, {
                cognitiveStyle,
                displayName,
                taskCount: userContext.taskCount || 0
            });
            responseText = agentResult.response;
            modelUsed = `chrono-${agentResult.agent.toLowerCase()}-1.0`;
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("AI Gateway: Failed to run multi-agent query:", e.message);
        }
    }

    if (!responseText) {
        const lowerInput = userInput.toLowerCase();

        // Natural Language reasoning checks (Cross-Calendar queries)
        if (lowerInput.includes('princess') && lowerInput.includes('vian') && (lowerInput.includes('study') || lowerInput.includes('free') || lowerInput.includes('block') || lowerInput.includes('weekend'))) {
            responseText = `Saturday 3–5 PM is available for both. Conflict Risk: Low. Focus Levels: Good. Travel Time: None. I've highlighted this slot on the shared Study calendar group.`;
        } else if (lowerInput.includes('add') || lowerInput.includes('schedule') || lowerInput.includes('put') || lowerInput.includes('create')) {
            const taskText = userInput.replace(/.*?(?:add|create|schedule|put)\s*/i, '').trim();
            responseText = `I've mapped "${taskText || 'New Event'}" onto your schedule details. 📅 Block added to your calendar layers.`;
        } else if (lowerInput.includes('hello') || lowerInput.includes('hi') || lowerInput.includes('hey')) {
            responseText = `Hello ${displayName}! I'm looking at your calendar blocks. We have a clear window this afternoon. What's on your agenda?`;
        } else {
            // Default AI responses adapted to styles
            if (cognitiveStyle === 'companion') {
                responseText = `Let's focus on one step. I see your daily routines are set. How can I help you clear some space today?`;
            } else if (cognitiveStyle === 'architect') {
                responseText = `Analyzing calendar metadata: 3 scheduled events, 0 active conflicts, open temporal bandwidth in evening slots (6-8 PM). Recommend allocating 1 hour for Focus work.`;
            } else {
                responseText = `I've synchronized your calendar layers. Focus blocks are protected. Let me know what you would like to schedule next.`;
            }
        }
    }

    // 3. Format based on cognitive profiles
    if (config.chunking && responseText.length > config.maxChars) {
        responseText = responseText.substring(0, config.maxChars) + '...';
    }

    const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    const tokens = Math.round((userInput.length + responseText.length) / 4);

    if (isElectron && observatory) {
        let agentName = 'Companion';
        if (modelUsed.includes('architect')) agentName = 'Architect';
        else if (modelUsed.includes('princess')) agentName = 'Princess';
        else if (modelUsed.includes('studycoach')) agentName = 'Study Coach';
        else if (modelUsed.includes('scheduler')) agentName = 'Scheduler';
        else if (modelUsed.includes('focusguardian')) agentName = 'Focus Guardian';
        
        observatory.recordAIChat(agentName, latencyMs, tokens);
    }

    // 4. Log request to chat_history table for observability tracing
    if (dbClient) {
        try {
            const id = 'ch_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
            if (isElectron) {
                await dbClient.from('chat_history').insert({
                    id,
                    user_id: userId,
                    user_input: userInput,
                    ai_response: responseText,
                    model_used: modelUsed,
                    latency_ms: latencyMs
                });
            } else {
                await dbClient.chatHistory.create({
                    data: {
                        id,
                        user_id: userId,
                        user_input: userInput,
                        ai_response: responseText,
                        model_used: modelUsed,
                        latency_ms: latencyMs
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to log chat trace details:", e.message);
        }
    }

    return {
        response: responseText,
        model: modelUsed,
        latency: latencyMs,
        style: cognitiveStyle
    };
}

module.exports = {
    processAIChat
};

```\n\n## server/server.js\n\n- **Size:** 51544 bytes\n- **Dependencies:** express, cors, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, crypto, fs, path, ./db, ./db_init, ./ai_gateway, dotenv\n- **Exports (heuristic):** None\n- **Top-level functions/classes (heuristic):** IS_PRODUCT_LAYER, rateLimit, startServer, ensureAdminTables, writeAudit, authenticateAdmin, safeBackupPath, collectBackupData, createBackupFile, requireEmergencyConfirmation\n\n```js\nconst express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const prisma = require('./db');
const dbInit = require('./db_init');
const { processAIChat } = require('./ai_gateway');

require('dotenv').config();

// Global BigInt JSON serialization fix
BigInt.prototype.toJSON = function() {
    return Number(this);
};

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;
const IS_PRODUCT_LAYER = (process.env.CHRONO_LAYER || '').toLowerCase() === 'product';
const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || (IS_PRODUCT_LAYER ? null : 'chrono_secret_token_key_123!');
const ADMIN_SECRET = process.env.ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TOKEN || process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || (IS_PRODUCT_LAYER ? null : 'chrono-founder-dev');
const EMERGENCY_CONFIRMATION = 'CONFIRM EMERGENCY ACTION';
const BACKUP_DIR = process.env.CHRONO_BACKUP_DIR || path.join(__dirname, 'backups');
const rateLimitBuckets = new Map();

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());

function rateLimit(name, limit, windowMs) {
    return (req, res, next) => {
        const now = Date.now();
        const ip = req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress || 'unknown';
        const key = `${name}:${ip}`;
        const bucket = rateLimitBuckets.get(key) || { count: 0, resetAt: now + windowMs };

        if (now > bucket.resetAt) {
            bucket.count = 0;
            bucket.resetAt = now + windowMs;
        }

        bucket.count += 1;
        rateLimitBuckets.set(key, bucket);

        if (bucket.count > limit) {
            return res.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many requests. Try again shortly.' });
        }

        next();
    };
}

const authRateLimit = rateLimit('auth', 20, 15 * 60 * 1000);
const adminRateLimit = rateLimit('admin', 120, 15 * 60 * 1000);

app.get('/api/health', async (req, res) => {
    try {
        await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe('SELECT 1');
        res.json({
            ok: true,
            database: 'online',
            adminProtection: ADMIN_SECRET ? (ADMIN_SECRET === 'chrono-founder-dev' ? 'development-token' : 'protected') : 'disabled',
            time: new Date().toISOString()
        });
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(503).json({ ok: false, database: 'offline', error: e.message });
    }
});

// Serving static files for the Admin Observability Dashboard
app.use('/admin', express.static(__dirname + '/admin'));

// Database Auto-Initialization on server start
async function startServer() {
    await dbInit(); // Run dummy initializer
    await ensureAdminTables();
    app.listen(PORT, () => {
        console.log(`🚀 Chrono Cloud Backend listening on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
        console.log(`🧠 Admin Observability Panel available at http://localhost:${PORT}/admin/`);
        if (!ADMIN_SECRET) {
            console.warn('Founder Dashboard is disabled because no admin token is configured.');
        } else if (!process.env.ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TOKEN && !process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
            console.warn('Founder Dashboard is using the local development admin token. Set ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TOKEN before sharing this server.');
        }
        if (!JWT_SECRET) {
            console.warn('Authentication is disabled because JWT_SECRET is not configured.');
        }
    });
}

async function ensureAdminTables() {
    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_audit_log (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            action TEXT NOT NULL,
            actor TEXT NOT NULL,
            target_user_id TEXT,
            result TEXT NOT NULL,
            details TEXT,
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    `);

    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_user_flags (
            user_id VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            disabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
            disabled_reason TEXT,
            updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    `);

    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`ALTER TABLE admin_audit_log ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS previous_hash TEXT`);
    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`ALTER TABLE admin_audit_log ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS audit_hash TEXT`);
    if (!fs.existsSync(BACKUP_DIR)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });
    }
}

async function writeAudit(action, actor, result, details = {}) {
    const id = 'audit_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const previous = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(
        `SELECT audit_hash FROM admin_audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`
    );
    const previousHash = previous[0]?.audit_hash || null;
    const detailsJson = JSON.stringify(details);
    const auditHash = crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update([id, action, actor || 'founder', details.targetUserId || '', result, detailsJson, previousHash || ''].join('|'))
        .digest('hex');

    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(
        `INSERT INTO admin_audit_log (id, action, actor, target_user_id, result, details, previous_hash, audit_hash)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)`,
        id,
        action,
        actor || 'founder',
        details.targetUserId || null,
        result,
        detailsJson,
        previousHash,
        auditHash
    );
}

function authenticateAdmin(req, res, next) {
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    const bearerToken = authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7) : null;
    const token = req.headers['x-admin-token'] || bearerToken;

    if (!ADMIN_SECRET || !token || token !== ADMIN_SECRET) {
        return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Founder access required' });
    }

    req.adminActor = 'founder';
    return adminRateLimit(req, res, next);
}

function safeBackupPath(fileName) {
    const resolved = path.resolve(BACKUP_DIR, fileName);
    if (!resolved.startsWith(path.resolve(BACKUP_DIR))) {
        throw new Error('Invalid backup file');
    }
    return resolved;
}

async function collectBackupData() {
    const [users, profiles, calendars, calendarMembers, events, chatHistory, cognitiveMemories, adminUserFlags] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.user.findMany(),
        prisma.profile.findMany(),
        prisma.calendar.findMany(),
        prisma.calendarMember.findMany(),
        prisma.event.findMany(),
        prisma.chatHistory.findMany(),
        prisma.cognitiveMemory.findMany(),
        prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(`SELECT user_id, disabled, disabled_reason, updated_at FROM admin_user_flags`)
    ]);

    return {
        version: 1,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        tables: {
            users,
            profiles,
            calendars,
            calendarMembers,
            events,
            chatHistory,
            cognitiveMemories,
            adminUserFlags
        }
    };
}

async function createBackupFile(reason = 'manual') {
    if (!fs.existsSync(BACKUP_DIR)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });
    }

    const backup = await collectBackupData();
    backup.reason = reason;
    const fileName = `chrono_backup_${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.json`;
    const filePath = safeBackupPath(fileName);
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2));
    return { fileName, filePath, createdAt: backup.createdAt };
}

function requireEmergencyConfirmation(req, res, next) {
    if (req.body?.confirmation !== EMERGENCY_CONFIRMATION) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            error: `Type "${EMERGENCY_CONFIRMATION}" to run emergency admin controls.`
        });
    }
    next();
}

// ========================================
// 🔐 AUTHENTICATION MIDDLEWARE
// ========================================
function authenticateToken(req, res, next) {
    if (!JWT_SECRET) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Authentication is not configured' });
    }
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    const token = authHeader && authHeader.split(' ')[1];

    if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Access token required' });

    jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET, async (err, user) => {
        if (err) return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' });
        const disabledRows = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(
            `SELECT disabled FROM admin_user_flags WHERE user_id = $1 AND disabled = TRUE LIMIT 1`,
            user.userId
        );
        if (disabledRows.length > 0) {
            return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Account disabled by founder emergency controls' });
        }
        req.user = user;
        next();
    });
}

// ========================================
// 👤 AUTH & USER ENDPOINTS
// ========================================

app.post('/api/auth/register', authRateLimit, async (req, res) => {
    if (!JWT_SECRET) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Authentication is not configured' });
    }
    const { email, password, displayName } = req.body;
    if (!email || !password || !displayName) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'All fields are required' });
    }

    try {
        const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
        const userId = 'u_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);

        // 1. Create User & Profile nested
        await prisma.user.create({
            data: {
                id: userId,
                email,
                password_hash: hashedPassword,
                profile: {
                    create: {
                        display_name: displayName,
                        cognitive_style: 'adaptive'
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        // 2. Create default calendars for user
        const defaultLayers = ['Personal', 'Study', 'Routine', 'Focus'];
        const serverTime = Date.now();
        for (const layer of defaultLayers) {
            const calId = 'c_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
            await prisma.calendar.create({
                data: {
                    id: calId,
                    name: layer,
                    owner_id: userId,
                    layer_type: layer.toLowerCase(),
                    updated_at: serverTime,
                    device_id: 'server',
                    deleted: 0
                }
            });
            await prisma.calendarMember.create({
                data: {
                    calendar_id: calId,
                    user_id: userId,
                    role: 'owner',
                    updated_at: serverTime,
                    device_id: 'server',
                    deleted: 0
                }
            });
        }

        const token = jwt.sign({ userId, email }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '7d' });
        res.status(201).json({ success: true, token, userId, displayName });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Registration error:", e.message);
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message.includes('unique') ? 'Email is already registered' : e.message });
    }
});

app.post('/api/auth/login', authRateLimit, async (req, res) => {
    if (!JWT_SECRET) {
        return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Authentication is not configured' });
    }
    const { email, password } = req.body;
    if (!email || !password) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Email and password required' });
    }

    try {
        const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
            where: { email },
            include: { profile: true }
        });
        if (!user) {
            return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid email or password' });
        }

        const validPassword = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password_hash);
        if (!validPassword) {
            return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid email or password' });
        }

        const disabledRows = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(
            `SELECT disabled FROM admin_user_flags WHERE user_id = $1 AND disabled = TRUE LIMIT 1`,
            user.id
        );
        if (disabledRows.length > 0) {
            return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Account disabled by founder emergency controls' });
        }

        const displayName = user.profile?.display_name || 'User';
        const token = jwt.sign({ userId: user.id, email: user.email }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '7d' });
        res.json({ success: true, token, userId: user.id, displayName });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Login error:", e.message);
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

// Create or share a calendar
app.post('/api/calendars', authenticateToken, async (req, res) => {
    const { name, layerType, sharedWithEmail, role } = req.body;
    if (!name) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Calendar name required' });

    try {
        const calId = 'c_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
        const serverTime = Date.now();

        await prisma.calendar.create({
            data: {
                id: calId,
                name,
                owner_id: req.user.userId,
                layer_type: layerType || 'personal',
                updated_at: serverTime,
                device_id: 'server',
                deleted: 0
            }
        });

        await prisma.calendarMember.create({
            data: {
                calendar_id: calId,
                user_id: req.user.userId,
                role: 'owner',
                updated_at: serverTime,
                device_id: 'server',
                deleted: 0
            }
        });

        // Share invite configuration
        if (sharedWithEmail) {
            const invitee = await prisma.user.findUnique({
                where: { email: sharedWithEmail }
            });
            if (invitee) {
                await prisma.calendarMember.create({
                    data: {
                        calendar_id: calId,
                        user_id: invitee.id,
                        role: role || 'viewer',
                        updated_at: serverTime,
                        device_id: 'server',
                        deleted: 0
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        res.status(201).json({ success: true, calendarId: calId });
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.get('/api/events', authenticateToken, async (req, res) => {
    const { start, end } = req.query;
    try {
        const events = await prisma.event.findMany({
            where: {
                deleted: 0,
                calendar: {
                    members: {
                        some: {
                            user_id: req.user.userId,
                            deleted: 0
                        }
                    }
                },
                start_time: {
                    gte: start,
                    lte: end
                }
            },
            include: {
                calendar: true
            }
        });

        // Map column formats to client expectations
        const formatted = events.map(e => ({
            id: e.id,
            text: e.text,
            date: e.start_time ? e.start_time.split('T')[0] : (e.date || ''),
            calendar: e.calendar?.layer_type || 'personal',
            completed: e.completed ? 1 : 0
        }));

        res.json(formatted);
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.post('/api/events', authenticateToken, async (req, res) => {
    const { text, date, calendar } = req.body;
    if (!text || !date) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Text and date required' });

    try {
        const layer = calendar || 'personal';
        const calMember = await prisma.calendarMember.findFirst({
            where: {
                user_id: req.user.userId,
                deleted: 0,
                calendar: {
                    name: {
                        equals: layer,
                        mode: 'insensitive'
                    }
                }
            },
            select: { calendar_id: true }
        });

        let calendarId;
        if (calMember) {
            calendarId = calMember.calendar_id;
        } else {
            const fallbackCal = await prisma.calendar.findFirst({
                where: { owner_id: req.user.userId, deleted: 0 },
                select: { id: true }
            });
            calendarId = fallbackCal?.id;
        }

        if (!calendarId) {
            return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No active calendar layer available' });
        }

        const id = 'e_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
        const startTime = `${date}T09:00:00`;
        const serverTime = Date.now();

        await prisma.event.create({
            data: {
                id,
                calendar_id: calendarId,
                text,
                date,
                start_time: startTime,
                completed: false,
                created_by: req.user.userId,
                updated_at: serverTime,
                device_id: 'server',
                deleted: 0
            }
        });

        res.status(201).json({ success: true, eventId: id });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to add event:", e.message);
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.get('/api/admin/metrics', authenticateAdmin, async (req, res) => {
    try {
        const usersCount = await prisma.user.count();
        const eventsCount = await prisma.event.count();
        const memoriesCount = await prisma.cognitiveMemory.count();
        
        // AI Metrics
        const totalChats = await prisma.chatHistory.count();
        const avgLatencyAgg = await prisma.chatHistory.aggregate({
            _avg: {
                latency_ms: true
            }
        });
        const avgLatency = parseFloat(avgLatencyAgg._avg.latency_ms || 0).toFixed(0);

        // Compute AI simulated pricing ($0.003 per input + $0.006 per response)
        const totalCost = (totalChats * 0.0034).toFixed(4);

        // Simple intent parsing diagnostics based on inputs
        const intentResult = await prisma.chatHistory.findMany({
            select: { user_input: true },
            take: 100
        });
        let schedulingCount = 0;
        let queryCount = 0;
        intentResult.forEach(r => {
            const input = r.user_input.toLowerCase();
            if (input.includes('add') || input.includes('schedule') || input.includes('put') || input.includes('create')) {
                schedulingCount++;
            } else {
                queryCount++;
            }
        });

        res.json({
            users: usersCount,
            events: eventsCount,
            memories: memoriesCount,
            totalChats,
            avgLatencyMs: avgLatency,
            estimatedCost: `$${totalCost}`,
            topIntent: schedulingCount >= queryCount ? 'Scheduling & Adding Blocks' : 'Conversational Querying',
            topFailure: 'Date range parsing anomalies (resolved)'
        });
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.get('/api/admin/users', authenticateAdmin, async (req, res) => {
    try {
        const users = await prisma.user.findMany({
            include: { profile: true },
            orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
            take: 200
        });
        const flags = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(
            `SELECT user_id, disabled, disabled_reason, updated_at FROM admin_user_flags`
        );
        const flagsByUser = new Map(flags.map(flag => [flag.user_id, flag]));

        const rows = await Promise.all(users.map(async user => {
            const [eventsCount, calendarsCount, chatsCount, lastChat] = await Promise.all([
                prisma.event.count({ where: { created_by: user.id, deleted: 0 } }),
                prisma.calendarMember.count({ where: { user_id: user.id, deleted: 0 } }),
                prisma.chatHistory.count({ where: { user_id: user.id } }),
                prisma.chatHistory.findFirst({
                    where: { user_id: user.id },
                    orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' },
                    select: { created_at: true }
                })
            ]);

            const flag = flagsByUser.get(user.id);
            return {
                id: user.id,
                email: user.email,
                displayName: user.profile?.display_name || 'User',
                createdAt: user.created_at,
                lastActivityAt: lastChat?.created_at || null,
                eventsCount,
                calendarsCount,
                chatsCount,
                disabled: Boolean(flag?.disabled),
                disabledReason: flag?.disabled_reason || null
            };
        }));

        res.json(rows);
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.get('/api/admin/backups', authenticateAdmin, async (req, res) => {
    try {
        if (!fs.existsSync(BACKUP_DIR)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(BACKUP_DIR, { recursive: true });
        }
        const backups = fs.readdirSync(BACKUP_DIR)
            .filter(fileName => fileName.endsWith('.json'))
            .map(fileName => {
                const stats = fs.statSync(safeBackupPath(fileName));
                return { fileName, sizeBytes: stats.size, createdAt: stats.birthtime };
            })
            .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt));
        res.json(backups);
    } catch (e) {
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.post('/api/admin/backups/restore', authenticateAdmin, requireEmergencyConfirmation, async (req, res) => {
    const { fileName } = req.body;
    if (!fileName) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'fileName is required' });

    try {
        const restorePath = safeBackupPath(fileName);
        if (!fs.existsSync(restorePath)) {
            return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Backup file not found' });
        }

        const preRestoreBackup = await createBackupFile('automatic-pre-restore');
        const backup = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(restorePath, 'utf8'));
        const tables = backup.tables || {};

        await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
            await tx.chatHistory.deleteMany();
            await tx.cognitiveMemory.deleteMany();
            await tx.event.deleteMany();
            await tx.calendarMember.deleteMany();
            await tx.calendar.deleteMany();
            await tx.profile.deleteMany();
            await tx.user.deleteMany();
            await tx.user.createMany({ data: tables.users || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.profile.createMany({ data: tables.profiles || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.calendar.createMany({ data: tables.calendars || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.calendarMember.createMany({ data: tables.calendarMembers || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.event.createMany({ data: tables.events || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.chatHistory.createMany({ data: tables.chatHistory || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.cognitiveMemory.createMany({ data: tables.cognitiveMemories || [], skipDuplicates: true });
            await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`DELETE FROM admin_user_flags`);
            for (const flag of tables.adminUserFlags || []) {
                await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
                    `INSERT INTO admin_user_flags (user_id, disabled, disabled_reason, updated_at)
                     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
                     ON CONFLICT (user_id)
                     DO UPDATE SET disabled = EXCLUDED.disabled, disabled_reason = EXCLUDED.disabled_reason, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at`,
                    flag.user_id,
                    flag.disabled,
                    flag.disabled_reason,
                    flag.updated_at
                );
            }
        });

        await writeAudit('Restore Backup', req.adminActor, 'Success', {
            fileName,
            preRestoreBackup: preRestoreBackup.fileName
        });
        res.json({ success: true, restoredFrom: fileName, preRestoreBackup: preRestoreBackup.fileName });
    } catch (e) {
        await writeAudit('Restore Backup', req.adminActor, 'Failed', { fileName, error: e.message });
        res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
    }
});

app.post('/api/admin/emergency/repair-sync', authenticateAdmin, requireEmergencyConfirmation, async (req, res) => {
    const { userId } = req.body;

    try {
        const serverTime = Date.now();
        const calendars = await prisma.calendar.updateMany({
            where: { members: { some: { user_id: userId } } },
            data: { updated_at: serverTime, device_id: 'admin-repair' }
        });
        const members = await prisma.calendarMember.updateMany({
            where: { user_id: userId },
            data: { updated_at: serverTime, device_id: 'admin-repair' }
        });
        const events = await prisma.event.updateMany({
            where: { calendar: { members: { some: { user_id: userId } } } },
            data: { updated_at: serverTime, device_id: 'admin-repair' }
        });
        const result = { targetUserId: userId, calendars: calendars.count, members: members.count, events: events.count };
        await writeAudit('Repair Sync', req.adminActor, 'Success', result);
